title.zh: 卷三百十四 列傳第二百〇二 雲南土司二
title.raw: 卷三百十四 列傳第二百〇二 雲南土司二 Volume 314 Biographies 202: Yunnan Tribal Headmen 2

sentences.zh: 姚安鶴慶武定尋甸麗江元江永昌新化威遠北勝灣甸鎮康大侯瀾滄衛麓川

translations.literal: Yao'an, Heqing, Wuding, Xundian, Lijiang, Yuanjiang, Yongchang, Xinhua, Weiyuan, Beisheng, Wandian, Zhenkang, Dahou, Lancang Guard, Luchuan
translations.idiomatic: Yao'an, Heqing, Wuding, Xundian, Lijiang, Yuanjiang, Yongchang, Xinhua, Weiyuan, Beisheng, Wandian, Zhenkang, Dahou, Lancang Guard, and Luchuan

sentences.zh: 姚安，本漢弄棟、蜻蛉二縣地。

translations.literal: Yao'an was originally the territory of the two Han counties Nongdong and Qingling.
translations.idiomatic: Yao'an comprised the lands of the Han-era counties of Nongdong and Qingling.

sentences.zh: 唐置姚州都督府，以民多姚姓也。

translations.literal: The Tang established the Yaozhou Area Command, because the people were largely of the Yao surname.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it was made the Yaozhou Area Command, so named because many of the inhabitants bore the surname Yao.

sentences.zh: 天寶間，南詔蒙氏改為弄棟府。

translations.literal: During the Tianbao era, the Nanzhao Meng clan changed it to Nongdong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tianbao reign, the Meng clan of Nanzhao redesignated it as Nongdong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宋時，段氏改姚州。

translations.literal: In Song times, the Duan clan changed it to Yaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song, the Duan regime restored the name Yaozhou.

sentences.zh: 元立統矢千戶所，天歷間，升姚安路。

translations.literal: The Yuan established the Tongshi chiliarchy; in the Tianli era it was promoted to Yao'an Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan first set up a Tongshi chiliarchy, which in the Tianli period was elevated to Yao'an Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年定雲南，改為府。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu Yunnan was pacified, and it was changed to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Yunnan was brought under control in Hongwu 15, the area was converted into a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十六年，姚安土官自久作亂。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, the Yao'an native official Zijiu rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the Yao'an tribal commissioner Zijiu rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 官兵往討，師次九十九莊，自久遁去。

translations.literal: Government troops went to suppress him; the army halted at Ninety-Nine Villages, and Zijiu fled.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial forces marched against him but halted at Ninety-Nine Villages while Zijiu escaped.

sentences.zh: 明年復寇品甸。

translations.literal: The next year he again raided Pindian.
translations.idiomatic: He raided Pindian again the year after.

sentences.zh: 西平侯沐英奏以土官高保為姚安府同知、高惠為姚安州同知。

translations.literal: The Prince of Xiping, Mu Ying, memorialized appointing the native official Gao Bao as vice prefect of Yao'an Prefecture and Gao Hui as vice magistrate of Yao'an Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Ying, Marquis of Xiping, recommended the native officers Gao Bao and Gao Hui as vice prefect of Yao'an and vice magistrate of Yao'an Subprefecture respectively.

sentences.zh: 保、惠從英擊自久，平之。

translations.literal: Bao and Hui followed Ying to attack Zijiu and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: Bao and Hui accompanied Mu Ying in the campaign against Zijiu and brought the rebellion to an end.

sentences.zh: 二十年命普定侯陳桓、靖寧侯葉升往雲南總制諸軍，於定邊、姚安等處立營屯種。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Chen Huan, Marquis of Puding, and Ye Sheng, Marquis of Jingning, were ordered to Yunnan to command all armies, and camps were established at Dingbian, Yao'an, and elsewhere for garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 20 Chen Huan of Puding and Ye Sheng of Jingning were sent to Yunnan to take overall command of the forces and to establish garrison colonies at Dingbian, Yao'an, and other posts.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，保以襲職，遣其弟貢馬謝恩。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year Bao succeeded to his office and sent his younger brother to present horses in gratitude.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 26 Bao inherited his post and dispatched his brother to court with horses as a token of thanks.

sentences.zh: 宣德九年，姚安土知府高賢遣使貢馬。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Xuande, the Yao'an native prefect Gao Xian sent envoys to present horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 9 the native prefect of Yao'an, Gao Xian, sent tribute horses to court.

sentences.zh: 弘治中，土官高棟與普安叛賊戰，死於板橋驛。

translations.literal: During Hongzhi, the native official Gao Dong fought rebel bandits of Pu'an and died at Banqiao Post.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hongzhi era the native commissioner Gao Dong died fighting Pu'an rebels at Banqiao Post.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三十年，土官高鵠當元江之變布政司徐樾遇害，奮身赴救，死之。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Jiajing, when during the Yuanjiang uprising the provincial administration commissioner Xu Yue was killed, the native official Gao Hu rushed to the rescue and died.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 30, when Provincial Commissioner Xu Yue was killed in the Yuanjiang disturbance, the native officer Gao Hu threw himself into the rescue and perished.

sentences.zh: 萬歷中，同知高金以征緬功，賜四品服。

translations.literal: During Wanli, Vice Prefect Gao Jin, for merit in the Burma campaign, was granted fourth-rank dress.
translations.idiomatic: In the Wanli reign Vice Prefect Gao Jin was awarded fourth-rank court dress for his service in the campaign against Burma.

sentences.zh: 所屬大姚縣，有鐵索箐者，本倮種。

translations.literal: Within its jurisdiction in Dayao County there was Tiesuo Ravine, originally of the Luo tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In subordinate Dayao County lay Tiesuo Ravine, inhabited by Luo tribesmen.

sentences.zh: 依山險，以剽掠為業，旁郡皆受其害。

translations.literal: Relying on mountainous terrain, they made plunder their trade, and neighboring prefectures all suffered from them.
translations.idiomatic: They held the mountain passes and lived by raiding, to the harm of every neighboring commandery.

sentences.zh: 弘治間，稍有歸命者，分隸於姚安、姚州。

translations.literal: During Hongzhi some gradually submitted, and were divided between Yao'an and Yaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hongzhi period those who began to submit were apportioned between Yao'an and Yaozhou.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖中，乃專屬姚安。

translations.literal: In Jiajing they came under Yao'an exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: By the Jiajing era they were placed solely under Yao'an.

sentences.zh: 其渠羅思者，有幻術，造偽印稱亂。

translations.literal: Their chieftain Luosi had sorcery and forged a seal to proclaim rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Their leader Luosi practiced occult arts and counterfeited an official seal to raise a revolt.

sentences.zh: 萬歷元年，巡撫鄒應龍與總兵官沐昌祚討平之，諸郡乃安。

translations.literal: In the first year of Wanli, Grand Coordinator Zou Yinglong and Regional Commander Mu Changzuo suppressed them, and the various prefectures were then at peace.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 1 Grand Coordinator Zou Yinglong and Regional Commander Mu Changzuo pacified the rebels, and the region was quieted.

sentences.zh: 鶴慶，唐時名鶴川，南詔置謀統郡。

translations.literal: Heqing was called Hechuan in Tang times; Nanzhao established the Moutong Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Heqing, known as Hechuan under the Tang, was made the Moutong Commandery by Nanzhao.

sentences.zh: 元初，置鶴州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuan, Hezhou was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Yuan period Hezhou was established there.

sentences.zh: 至元中，升鶴慶府，尋改為路。

translations.literal: In the Zhiyuan era it was promoted to Heqing Prefecture, and soon after changed to a circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhiyuan it was raised to Heqing Prefecture and shortly afterward converted into a circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武中，大軍平雲南，分兵拔三營、萬戶砦，獲偽參政寶山帖木兒等六十七人。

translations.literal: During Hongwu the great army pacified Yunnan; detachments took Sanying and Wanhuzhai and captured sixty-seven persons including the false administrator Baoshan Timur.
translations.idiomatic: When the main forces pacified Yunnan in the Hongwu era, columns seized Sanying and Wanhuzhai and took sixty-seven captives, among them the puppet administrator Baoshan Timur.

sentences.zh: 置鶴慶府，以土官高隆署府事。

translations.literal: Heqing Prefecture was established, with the native official Gao Long acting as prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Heqing Prefecture was then founded, with the native officer Gao Long placed in charge.

sentences.zh: 十七年以董賜為知府、高仲為同知、賜子節為安寧知州、楊權為劍川知州。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Dong Ci was made prefect, Gao Zhong vice prefect, Ci's son Jie magistrate of Anning, and Yang Quan magistrate of Jianchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 17 Dong Ci was appointed prefect, Gao Zhong vice prefect, Ci's son Jie magistrate of Anning, and Yang Quan magistrate of Jianchuan.

sentences.zh: 賜率其屬來朝，貢馬及方物，詔賜冠帶並織金文綺、布帛、鈔錠。

translations.literal: Ci led his followers to court, presenting horses and local products; an edict granted him cap and belt, brocade with woven gold patterns, cloth, silk, and paper money.
translations.idiomatic: Ci came to court with his retainers, offering horses and regional goods; the throne rewarded him with cap and belt, gold-woven brocades, textiles, and banknotes.

sentences.zh: 十八年以賜為雲南前衛世襲指揮僉事。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Ci was made hereditary assistant commander of the Yunnan Forward Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 18 Ci was granted the hereditary post of assistant commander in the Yunnan Forward Guard.

sentences.zh: 賜，安寧州人，世為酋長。

translations.literal: Ci was a man of Anning Subprefecture and for generations had been a tribal chief.
translations.idiomatic: A native of Anning, Ci came from a long line of tribal chiefs.

sentences.zh: 大軍入滇，率眾來降，復從軍討賊有功，故與子節並有世襲知府、知州之命。

translations.literal: When the great army entered Yunnan he led his people to surrender, then followed the army to suppress bandits with merit; therefore he and his son Jie both received hereditary appointments as prefect and magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial army entered Yunnan he submitted with his followers and later distinguished himself in suppressing rebels, for which both he and his son Jie received hereditary prefectural and magisterial appointments.

sentences.zh: 及賜來朝，以父子俱受顯榮，無以仰報，子幼沖，不達政治，乞還父子所授官，而自為安寧知州。

translations.literal: When Ci came to court, because father and son had both received great honor and he had no way to repay it upward, and his son was young and immature and did not understand governance, he begged to return the offices granted to father and son and himself serve only as magistrate of Anning.
translations.idiomatic: On coming to court Ci declared that, having received such honors for both father and son, he could not worthily repay them; his son was still a child and unfit for office, so he asked to relinquish their appointments and hold only the magistracy of Anning himself.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「爾能綏靖邊鄙，授爾官以酬爾勛。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "You have been able to pacify the border regions; offices were granted you to reward your merit.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "You have brought peace to the frontier; these offices were given to reward your service.

sentences.zh: 今辭尊居卑，奈何？

translations.literal: Now you decline the lofty and take the humble—how can this be?
translations.idiomatic: Why now renounce rank for a lesser post?"

sentences.zh: 」命潁國公傅友德及諸大臣議之。

translations.literal: " He ordered the Duke of Ying, Fu Youde, and the various ministers to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the Duke of Ying, Fu Youde, and the ministers to consider the matter.

sentences.zh: 皆以賜既有功，不可聽其辭，而節之官則可免。

translations.literal: All held that since Ci already had merit, his resignation could not be accepted, but Jie's office could be waived.
translations.idiomatic: They agreed that Ci's merits forbade accepting his resignation, though his son Jie's appointment might be withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 乃改賜明威將軍雲南前衛世襲指揮僉事，諭曰：「雲南前衛密邇安寧，特命爾是職。

translations.literal: Ci was then changed to Bright Might General, hereditary assistant commander of the Yunnan Forward Guard, with instruction: "The Yunnan Forward Guard lies close to Anning; you are specially appointed to this post.
translations.idiomatic: Ci was reassigned as Bright Might General and hereditary assistant commander of the Yunnan Forward Guard, with the instruction: "That guard lies adjacent to Anning, and this post is entrusted to you for that reason.

sentences.zh: 爾其綏輯遠人，以安邊鄙，其毋再辭。」

translations.literal: You shall soothe and gather the distant peoples to secure the border regions; do not resign again."
translations.idiomatic: Pacify the frontier peoples and keep the borders quiet—and do not petition to resign again."

sentences.zh: 二十年，劍川土官楊奴叛。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the Jianchuan native official Yang Nu rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 20 the Jianchuan tribal officer Yang Nu rebelled.

sentences.zh: 大理衛指揮鄭祥討之，斬八十余人，楊奴遁。

translations.literal: Zheng Xiang, commander of Dali Guard, attacked him, beheaded more than eighty men, and Yang Nu fled.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xiang, commander of Dali Guard, routed him, killing more than eighty men; Yang Nu escaped.

sentences.zh: 未幾，還劍川，復聚蠻為亂，祥復以兵擊斬之。

translations.literal: Before long he returned to Jianchuan, gathered tribesmen again in rebellion, and Xiang again attacked with troops and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was back in Jianchuan stirring up another tribal revolt, and Xiang marched out once more and killed him.

sentences.zh: 二十四年置鶴慶衛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Heqing Guard was established.
translations.idiomatic: Heqing Guard was established in Hongwu 24.

sentences.zh: 三十年改鶴慶府為軍民府。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year Heqing Prefecture was changed to a military-civilian prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 30 Heqing Prefecture was redesignated a military-civilian prefecture.

sentences.zh: 永樂十五年，順州知州王義言：「沾被聖化三十余年，聲教所屆，言語漸通，子弟亦有俊秀，請建學教育。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Yongle, Shunzhou Magistrate Wang Yi said: "Having been touched by sagely transformation for more than thirty years, where sound teaching reaches speech gradually becomes intelligible, and among the young there are also talented ones; I request establishing schools for education."
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 15 Wang Yi, magistrate of Shunzhou, petitioned: "For more than thirty years we have enjoyed imperial civilization; where the court's influence reaches, languages grow mutually intelligible, and our youth show promise. We ask permission to found schools."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 正統二年，副使徐訓奏鶴慶土知府高倫與弟純屢逞兇惡，屠戮士庶，與母楊氏並叔宣互相賊害。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengtong, Vice Commissioner Xu Xun memorialized that the Heqing native prefect Gao Lun and his younger brother Chun repeatedly committed violence, slaughtered officials and commoners, and with their mother Lady Yang and uncle Xuan mutually harmed one another.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 2 Vice Commissioner Xu Xun reported that the native prefect of Heqing, Gao Lun, and his brother Chun had repeatedly committed atrocities, massacred officials and commoners, and were locked in mutual slaughter with their mother Lady Yang and uncle Xuan.

sentences.zh: 敕黔國公沐昂諭使輸款，如恃強不服，即調軍擒捕。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Prince of Qian, Mu Ang, to instruct them to submit; if they relied on force and refused, troops were to be mobilized to seize them.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Ang, Prince of Qian, was ordered to summon them to submit; should they defy force, troops were to be sent to capture them.

sentences.zh: 五年復敕昂等曰：「比聞土知府高倫妻劉氏同倫弟高昌等，糾集羅羅、麼些人眾，肆行兇暴。

translations.literal: In the fifth year another edict to Ang and others said: "We have lately heard that the native prefect Gao Lun's wife Lady Liu, together with Lun's younger brother Gao Chang and others, gathered Lolo and Moso people and wantonly committed violence.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 5 a further edict to Ang and his colleagues read: "We hear that Prefect Gao Lun's wife Lady Liu, Lun's brother Gao Chang, and others have mustered Lolo and Moso bands and are committing outrages.

sentences.zh: 事發，不從逮訊。

translations.literal: When the matter arose, they did not submit to arrest and interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair came to light they refused to submit to arrest.

sentences.zh: 敕至，即委官至彼勘實，量調官軍擒捕首惡，並逮千戶王蕙及高宣等至京質問。

translations.literal: When this edict arrives, immediately dispatch officials there to investigate the facts, deploy government troops as needed to seize the chief culprits, and also bring chiliarch Wang Hui and Gao Xuan and others to the capital for questioning.
translations.idiomatic: On receipt of this edict, send officials to verify the facts, deploy such troops as are needed to seize the ringleaders, and bring Chiliarch Wang Hui, Gao Xuan, and the rest to the capital for examination.

sentences.zh: 」八年，鶴慶民楊仕潔妻阿夜珠告倫謀殺其子，復命法司移文勘驗。

translations.literal: " In the eighth year the Heqing commoner Yang Shipu's wife Ayeshu accused Lun of plotting to murder her son; the judiciary was again ordered to send documents for investigation.
translations.idiomatic: " In Zhengtong 8 Ayeshu, wife of the Heqing commoner Yang Shipu, accused Lun of plotting to kill her son, and the judiciary was again instructed to investigate.

sentences.zh: 已而大理衛千戶奏報，倫擅率軍馬欲謀害親母，又稱其母告倫不孝及私斂民財，多造兵器，殺戮軍民，支解梟令等罪。

translations.literal: Soon a chiliarch of Dali Guard memorialized that Lun had on his own authority led troops intending to murder his own mother, and also that his mother accused Lun of unfilial conduct, privately levying people's wealth, manufacturing many weapons, killing soldiers and civilians, dismembering and displaying heads, and other crimes.
translations.idiomatic: A Dali Guard chiliarch then reported that Lun had led troops without authorization intending to kill his mother, while his mother charged him with unfilial conduct, illegal levies, stockpiling arms, slaughter of soldiers and civilians, and dismembering victims for public display.

sentences.zh: 遂敕黔國公沐晟等勘覆。

translations.literal: An edict then ordered the Prince of Qian, Mu Sheng, and others to investigate and report.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Sheng, Prince of Qian, and others were ordered to conduct a full inquiry.

sentences.zh: 及奏至，言倫所犯皆實，罪應死。

translations.literal: When the memorial arrived, it said all of Lun's offenses were true and the crime deserved death.
translations.idiomatic: Their report held every charge against Lun proved and deserving of death.

sentences.zh: 倫復屢訴，因與叔宣爭襲，又與千戶王蕙爭娶妾，以致挾仇誣陷。

translations.literal: Lun repeatedly appealed, saying that because he contended with uncle Xuan over succession, and with chiliarch Wang Hui over taking a concubine, they bore grudges and falsely accused him.
translations.idiomatic: Lun appealed repeatedly, alleging that his uncle Xuan, with whom he disputed the succession, and Chiliarch Wang Hui, with whom he had quarreled over a concubine, had framed him out of spite.

sentences.zh: 所勘殺死，皆病死及強盜拒捕之人。

translations.literal: Those investigated as killed by him had all died of illness or were robbers killed resisting arrest.
translations.idiomatic: Those said to have been killed by him had in fact died of illness or been robbers slain while resisting arrest.

sentences.zh: 倫母楊亦訴倫無不孝，實由宣等陷害。

translations.literal: Lun's mother Yang also appealed that Lun was not unfilial and had in fact been framed by Xuan and others.
translations.idiomatic: Lun's mother Lady Yang likewise testified that he was not unfilial and had been victimized by Xuan and his faction.

sentences.zh: 復敕晟及御史嚴恭確訪。

translations.literal: An edict again ordered Sheng and Censor Yan Gong to investigate thoroughly.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng and Censor Yan Gong were ordered to conduct a definitive investigation.

sentences.zh: 既而奏當倫等皆伏誅。

translations.literal: Soon they memorialized that Lun and the others should all be executed.
translations.idiomatic: They soon reported back recommending execution for Lun and his associates.

sentences.zh: 高氏族人無可繼者，帝命於流官中擇人，以綏遠蠻。

translations.literal: Among the Gao clan none could succeed; the Emperor ordered selecting someone from regular officials to pacify the distant tribes.
translations.idiomatic: With no suitable heir left in the Gao clan, the emperor ordered a regular official chosen to pacify the frontier tribes.

sentences.zh: 乃擢瀘州知府林遒節為知府。

translations.literal: Lin Youjie, prefect of Luzhou, was then promoted to prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Youjie, prefect of Luzhou, was promoted to the post.

sentences.zh: 鶴慶之改流官自此始。

translations.literal: Heqing's change to regular officials began from this.
translations.idiomatic: This marked the beginning of Heqing's transition from native to regular administration.

sentences.zh: 武定，南詔三十七部之一。

translations.literal: Wuding was one of the thirty-seven divisions of Nanzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Wuding was one of the thirty-seven tribal divisions of the Nanzhao realm.

sentences.zh: 宋淳熙間，大理段氏以阿歷為羅武部長。

translations.literal: During the Chunxi era of Song, the Dali Duan clan appointed Ali as chief of the Luowu division.
translations.idiomatic: In the Chunxi era of the Song the Duan rulers of Dali installed Ali as chief of the Luowu division.

sentences.zh: 三傳至矣格，當元世祖時，為北部土官總管。

translations.literal: After three generations it passed to Yige; during Emperor Shizu of Yuan he was general administrator of northern native officials.
translations.idiomatic: Three generations later Yige served, under Kublai Khan, as general administrator of the northern native chiefs.

sentences.zh: 至元七年改武定路，置南甸縣。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Wuding Circuit and Nandian County was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 7 it became Wuding Circuit and Nandian County was created.

sentences.zh: 洪武十四年，雲南下，武定女土官商勝首先歸附。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Hongwu, when Yunnan fell, the Wuding female native official Shang Sheng was the first to submit.
translations.idiomatic: When Yunnan submitted in Hongwu 14, the female native commissioner of Wuding, Shang Sheng, was the first to declare allegiance.

sentences.zh: 十五年改為武定軍民府，以勝署府事。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year it was changed to Wuding Military-Civilian Prefecture, with Sheng acting as prefect.
translations.idiomatic: The next year it was made the Wuding Military-Civilian Prefecture with Sheng placed in charge.

sentences.zh: 十六年，勝遣人來朝，貢馬。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Sheng sent persons to court, presenting horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 16 she sent envoys to court with tribute horses.

sentences.zh: 詔賜勝誥命、朝服及錦幣、鈔錠。

translations.literal: An edict granted Sheng patent of appointment, court dress, brocade, cloth, and paper money.
translations.idiomatic: She was granted a patent of office, court robes, brocades, textiles, and banknotes.

sentences.zh: 十七年以和曲土官豆派為知州。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the Hequ native official Dou Pai was made magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 17 the Hequ native officer Dou Pai was appointed magistrate.

sentences.zh: 二十一年發內帑，令於武定、德昌、會川諸處，市馬三千匹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year funds from the inner treasury were issued to purchase three thousand horses at Wuding, Dechang, Huichuan, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 21 imperial funds were disbursed to buy three thousand horses at Wuding, Dechang, Huichuan, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年，元謀縣故土知縣吾忠子政來朝。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuande, Zheng, son of the former Yuanmou County native magistrate Wu Zhong, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 1 Zheng, son of the former native magistrate of Yuanmou, Wu Zhong, presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 正德二年四月，武定雨雹，溪水漲，決堤壞田，隕霜露殺麥。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengde, fourth month, Wuding had hail; stream waters rose, broke dikes and ruined fields; frost and dew killed wheat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Zhengde 2 Wuding was struck by hail; rivers rose, burst their dikes and ruined the fields, and frost killed the wheat.

sentences.zh: 七月廢武定所屬之南甸縣改隸和曲州，石舊縣改隸祿勸州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Nandian County subordinate to Wuding was abolished and placed under Hequ Subprefecture, and Shijiu County was placed under Luquan Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Nandian County was abolished and attached to Hequ Subprefecture, and Shijiu County to Luquan Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 三年，土知府鳳英以從征功，進秩右參政，仍知府事，請賜金帶，部議不可。

translations.literal: In the third year the native prefect Feng Ying, for merit in the campaign, was promoted in rank to Right Vice Commissioner while still administering the prefecture; he requested a gold belt, but the ministry deliberated that it could not be granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde 3 the native prefect Feng Ying was promoted to Right Vice Commissioner for campaign service while retaining his prefectural duties; he asked for a gold belt, which the ministry initially refused.

sentences.zh: 帝以英有軍功，給之。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because Ying had military merit, granted it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor overruled them and granted the belt in recognition of his military service.

sentences.zh: 明年，英貢馬謝恩，賜如例。

translations.literal: The next year Ying presented horses in gratitude; rewards followed precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Feng Ying sent tribute horses in thanks, and received the customary rewards.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖七年，土舍鳳朝文作亂。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiajing, the native clerk Feng Chaowen rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 7 the native clerk Feng Chaowen rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 殺同知以下官吏，劫州印，舉兵與尋甸賊安銓合犯雲南府，撫臣以聞。

translations.literal: He killed officials including the vice prefect, seized the subprefectural seal, raised troops and together with the Xundian bandit An Quan invaded Yunnan Prefecture; the grand coordinator reported.
translations.idiomatic: He murdered officials down to the vice prefect, seized the subprefectural seal, took up arms, and joined the Xundian rebel An Quan in an attack on Yunnan Prefecture; the grand coordinator reported the crisis.

sentences.zh: 時安銓未平，朝文復起，滇中大擾。

translations.literal: At the time An Quan was not yet pacified, and Chaowen rose again; great disturbance arose in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: An Quan's revolt was still unsettled when Chaowen rebelled again, throwing the province into turmoil.

sentences.zh: 詔以右都御史伍文定為兵部尚書，提督雲、貴、川、湖軍務，調四鎮土漢官軍討賊。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Right Censor-in-Chief Wu Wending Minister of War, to supervise military affairs in Yunnan, Guizhou, Sichuan, and Huguang, and mobilized native and Han troops of the four regions to suppress the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Wending, formerly Right Censor-in-Chief, was made Minister of War and charged with military affairs in Yunnan, Guizhou, Sichuan, and Huguang, with orders to mobilize native and regular forces from all four regions against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 五月，黔國公沐紹勛疏言：「臣奉命會同巡撫等調發官軍，分道剿撫。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the Prince of Qian, Mu Shaoxun, memorialized: "Your servant, having received orders to join the grand coordinator and others in mobilizing government troops, divided forces to suppress and pacify.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Mu Shaoxun, Prince of Qian, reported: "Having been ordered to join the grand coordinator in mobilizing government troops, I divided our forces for simultaneous suppression and pacification.

sentences.zh: 諸賊抗逆，執留所遣官軍二人，所調集各土舍，又重自疑畏。

translations.literal: The various bandits resisted; they seized and detained two government soldiers who had been sent, and the various native clerks who had been mobilized were again greatly fearful and hesitant.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels resisted fiercely, taking two of our officers hostage, while the native auxiliaries we had summoned grew deeply fearful and hung back.

sentences.zh: 臣謹以便宜榜示，先給冠帶，待後奏請承襲，眾始感奮。

translations.literal: Your servant respectfully posted notices on expedient authority, first granting caps and belts, with hereditary succession to be memorialized later; only then did the masses become inspired.
translations.idiomatic: I therefore issued proclamations on my own authority, awarding caps and belts at once and promising to memorialize hereditary succession later; only then did the men take heart.

sentences.zh: 於二月進兵，擊斬強賊十余人，賊奔回武定。

translations.literal: In the second month we advanced, struck and beheaded more than ten fierce bandits, and the bandits fled back to Wuding.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month we advanced, killing more than a dozen of the rebel leaders and driving the rest back toward Wuding.

sentences.zh: 乞敕部授臣方略，俾獲便宜行事，並宥各土舍往罪，凡有功者，俱許承襲，作其敵愾之氣。

translations.literal: I beg that the ministry be ordered to grant your servant strategy, so that I may act on expedient authority, and also pardon the past crimes of the various native clerks; all who have merit shall be permitted hereditary succession, to rouse their spirit of shared enmity.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the ministry authorize a general strategy and grant me discretionary powers, pardon the past offenses of the native auxiliaries, and confirm hereditary succession for all who distinguish themselves, so as to stir their fighting spirit.

sentences.zh: 」帝納之，賜敕獎勵。

translations.literal: " The Emperor accepted it and granted an edict of encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved and sent an edict of commendation.

sentences.zh: 賊既敗歸，其黨稍散。

translations.literal: After the bandits were defeated and returned, their followers gradually dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Once the rebels were beaten back, their followers began to scatter.

sentences.zh: 初，朝文紿其眾，謂武定知府鳳詔母子已戮，朝廷且盡剿武定蠻眾。

translations.literal: At first Chaowen deceived his followers, saying that the Wuding prefect Feng Zhao and his mother had been executed and that the court would soon exterminate all the Wuding tribesmen.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Chaowen had deceived his followers with the claim that Prefect Feng Zhao and his mother had been executed and that the court intended to exterminate every tribesman in Wuding.

sentences.zh: 至是，鳳詔同其母率眾自會城往，蠻民相顧錯愕，鹹投鳳詔降。

translations.literal: At this time Feng Zhao with his mother led their followers from the provincial capital; the tribesmen looked at one another in dismay and all submitted to Feng Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Now Feng Zhao appeared from the provincial capital with his mother at the head of their followers; the tribal people, astonished, turned to him in submission.

sentences.zh: 朝文計無所出，絕普渡而走，官兵追及，復敗之。

translations.literal: Chaowen had no plan left, crossed the Pu River ford and fled; government troops overtook him and defeated him again.
translations.idiomatic: Chaowen, at his wits' end, fled across the Pu River ford but was overtaken and defeated again.

sentences.zh: 朝文率家奴數人，取道沾益州，奔至東川之湯郎箐，為追兵所及，磔死。

translations.literal: Chaowen led a few household slaves, took the route through Zhanyi Subprefecture, fled to Tanglang Ravine in Dongchuan, was overtaken by pursuing troops, and was dismembered to death.
translations.idiomatic: With only a handful of household slaves he fled by way of Zhanyi toward Tanglang Ravine in Dongchuan, where pursuing troops caught him and executed him by dismemberment.

sentences.zh: 銓眾猶盛，遁據尋甸故巢，列寨數十。

translations.literal: Quan's forces were still strong; he fled to occupy the old Xundian lair and set up several dozen stockades.
translations.idiomatic: An Quan's forces remained formidable; he withdrew to his old Xundian stronghold and threw up dozens of stockades.

sentences.zh: 官兵分哨夾攻之，諸寨先後破，乃並力攻拔其必古老巢。

translations.literal: Government troops divided into columns and attacked from both sides; the various stockades were taken one after another, then combined force stormed and took his Bilaogu old lair.
translations.idiomatic: Government columns attacked from several directions, reducing the stockades one by one before concentrating on his main stronghold at Bilaogu.

sentences.zh: 銓奔東川，入芒部，為土舍祿慶所執，賊平。

translations.literal: Quan fled to Dongchuan, entered Mangbu, was seized by the native clerk Lu Qing, and the bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Quan fled into Mangbu in Dongchuan, where the native clerk Lu Qing captured him, and the rebellion was ended.

sentences.zh: 是役也，生擒渠賊千余人，斬首二千九百余級，俘獲男婦千二百余，撫散蠻黨二萬有奇，奪器械牛馬無算。

translations.literal: In this campaign more than a thousand chieftain bandits were captured alive, more than twenty-nine hundred heads were cut, more than twelve hundred men and women were taken captive, more than twenty thousand tribal followers were pacified and dispersed, and weapons, cattle, and horses seized were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: In this campaign over a thousand rebel leaders were taken alive, nearly three thousand heads were counted, more than twelve hundred men and women were captured, over twenty thousand tribal followers were pacified and sent home, and countless weapons, cattle, and horses were seized.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，銓、朝文皆梟示，籍其產，家屬戍邊。

translations.literal: News of victory arrived; Quan and Chaowen were both displayed by decapitation, their property was registered and confiscated, and their families were exiled to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: When word of victory arrived, Quan and Chaowen were both executed and their heads displayed in public, their estates were confiscated, and their families were sent into frontier exile.

sentences.zh: 十六年命土知府瞿氏掌印。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year the native prefect Lady Qu was ordered to hold the seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Lady Qu was appointed native prefect and entrusted with the official seal.

sentences.zh: 初，府印自洪武以來俱掌於土官，正德間有司議以畀流官同知，土知府職專巡捕、征糧而已。

translations.literal: At first the prefectural seal had since Hongwu been held entirely by native officials; during the Zhengde reign the local administration proposed giving it to the appointed associate prefect, leaving the native prefect with duties limited to patrol, arrest, and grain collection alone.
translations.idiomatic: Originally the prefectural seal had been held by native officials since the Hongwu reign; during Zhengde local authorities proposed transferring it to an appointed associate prefect, restricting the native prefect to patrol duties and tax collection.

sentences.zh: 及鳳詔死，瞿氏以母襲子官，所轄四十七馬頭阿臺等，數請以印屬瞿氏。

translations.literal: When Feng Zhao died, Lady Qu succeeded to her son's office as mother; the forty-seven matou headmen under her jurisdiction, including A Tai, repeatedly requested that the seal be entrusted to Lady Qu.
translations.idiomatic: After Feng Zhao died, Lady Qu succeeded to her son's post in her capacity as his mother, and the forty-seven matou chiefs under her rule, including A Tai, repeatedly petitioned that the seal be given to her.

sentences.zh: 吏部覆言，系舊例，宜如其請，從之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel replied that this followed established precedent and that their request should be granted; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel replied that this accorded with precedent and recommended approval; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，瞿氏老，舉鳳詔妻索林自代。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year Lady Qu, being old, recommended Feng Zhao's wife Suolin to succeed her.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year, as Lady Qu grew old, she nominated Feng Zhao's widow Suolin as her successor.

sentences.zh: 比索林襲，遂失事姑禮。

translations.literal: When Suolin took office, she failed to observe proper duty toward her mother-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: Once Suolin assumed office, she ceased to treat her mother-in-law with proper respect.

sentences.zh: 瞿氏大恚，乃收異姓兒繼祖入鳳氏宗，挾其甥婿貴州水西土舍安國亨、四川建昌土官鳳氏兵力，欲廢索林，以繼祖嗣。

translations.literal: Lady Qu was greatly enraged; she took in the unrelated child Jizu into the Feng clan, and relying on the military power of her nephew's son-in-law An Guoheng, native clerk of Shuixi in Guizhou, and the Feng clan native official of Jianchang in Sichuan, sought to depose Suolin and install Jizu as successor.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, Lady Qu adopted the unrelated boy Jizu into the Feng clan and, backed by the forces of her nephew's son-in-law An Guoheng of Shuixi in Guizhou and the Feng native officials of Jianchang in Sichuan, tried to remove Suolin and put Jizu in her place.

sentences.zh: 不克，乃具疏自稱為索林囚禁，令繼祖詣闕告之。

translations.literal: Failing in this, she submitted a memorial claiming that Suolin had imprisoned her, and sent Jizu to the capital to report it.
translations.idiomatic: When the plot failed, she filed a memorial claiming Suolin had imprisoned her and dispatched Jizu to the capital to lodge a complaint.

sentences.zh: 繼祖歸，詐稱受朝命襲職，驅目兵逼奪府印。

translations.literal: Jizu returned and falsely claimed he had received an imperial order to succeed to office; he drove tribal soldiers to seize the prefectural seal by force.
translations.idiomatic: Jizu returned home, falsely claiming he had imperial orders to succeed to office, and used tribal troops to seize the prefectural seal by force.

sentences.zh: 索林抱印奔會城，撫按官諭解之。

translations.literal: Suolin fled to the provincial capital clutching the seal; the provincial governor and censor admonished them and resolved the dispute.
translations.idiomatic: Suolin fled to the provincial capital with the seal in hand, and the provincial governor and censor intervened to settle the matter.

sentences.zh: 索林歸武定，視事如故，而復聽繼祖留瞿氏所，於是婦姑嫌隙益甚。

translations.literal: Suolin returned to Wuding and conducted affairs as before, but it was again permitted for Jizu to remain with Lady Qu; thus the rift between daughter-in-law and mother-in-law grew worse.
translations.idiomatic: Suolin returned to Wuding and resumed her duties, but Jizu was again allowed to stay with Lady Qu, and the hostility between daughter-in-law and mother-in-law only deepened.

sentences.zh: 索林謀誅繼祖，事泄，繼祖遂大發兵圍府，行劫和曲、祿勸等州縣，殺傷調至土官王心一等兵。

translations.literal: Suolin plotted to kill Jizu; when the plot leaked, Jizu raised a large force and besieged the prefectural seat, raiding the subprefectures and counties of Hequ and Luquan, killing and wounding troops mobilized under the native official Wang Xinyi and others.
translations.idiomatic: Suolin plotted to have Jizu killed, but when the plot was exposed Jizu raised a large army, besieged the prefectural seat, and raided Hequ, Luquan, and other counties, killing and wounding troops sent under the native official Wang Xinyi and others.

sentences.zh: 索林復抱印走雲南，巡撫曹忭下令收印，逮其左右鄭竤系獄，令瞿氏暫理府事；

translations.literal: Suolin again fled to Yunnan clutching the seal; Grand Coordinator Cao Bian ordered the seal confiscated, arrested her attendant Zheng Hong and imprisoned him, and had Lady Qu temporarily manage prefectural affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Suolin again fled to Yunnan with the seal; Grand Coordinator Cao Bian ordered the seal seized, had her aide Zheng Hong arrested and jailed, and put Lady Qu in temporary charge of prefectural affairs;

sentences.zh: 貸繼祖，責其自新。

translations.literal: Jizu was pardoned and charged to reform himself.
translations.idiomatic: Jizu was spared and ordered to mend his ways.

sentences.zh: 四十四年添設府通判一員。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year one additional prefectural vice-director was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year an additional prefectural vice-director was appointed.

sentences.zh: 四十五年築武定新城成，巡撫呂光洵遣鄭竤回府復業。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year construction of Wuding's new city was completed; Grand Coordinator Lü Guangxun sent Zheng Hong back to the prefecture to resume his duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year the new city of Wuding was completed, and Grand Coordinator Lü Guangxun sent Zheng Hong back to the prefecture to resume his post.

sentences.zh: 鄭竤者，前為索林謀殺繼祖者也。

translations.literal: Zheng Hong was the one who had earlier plotted with Suolin to kill Jizu.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Hong was the man who had previously plotted with Suolin to murder Jizu.

sentences.zh: 繼祖執而殺之，糾眾攻新城。

translations.literal: Jizu seized and killed him, then gathered followers to attack the new city.
translations.idiomatic: Jizu captured and killed him, then rallied his followers to assault the new city.

sentences.zh: 臨安通判胡文顯督百戶李鰲、土舍王德隆往援，至雞溪子隘，遇伏，鰲及德隆俱死。

translations.literal: Lin'an Vice-Director Hu Wenxian led Centurion Li Ao and native clerk Wang Delong to the rescue; at Jixizi Pass they met an ambush, and both Li Ao and Wang Delong were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Lin'an Vice-Director Hu Wenxian led Centurion Li Ao and native clerk Wang Delong to relieve the city, but at Jixizi Pass they walked into an ambush and both Li Ao and Wang Delong were killed.

sentences.zh: 僉事張澤督尋甸兵二千余馳救，亦敗，澤及千戶劉裕被執。

translations.literal: Commissioner Zhang Ze led more than two thousand Xundian troops in haste to the rescue but was also defeated; Zhang Ze and Battalion Commander Liu Yu were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Zhang Ze rushed to the rescue with more than two thousand Xundian troops but was defeated as well; Zhang Ze and Battalion Commander Liu Yu were taken prisoner.

sentences.zh: 鎮巡官促諸道兵並進，逼繼祖東山寨，圍之。

translations.literal: The frontier commander urged troops from all routes to advance together, pressed Jizu to Dongshan Stockade, and besieged him.
translations.idiomatic: The frontier commander ordered columns from every route to advance together, drove Jizu to Dongshan Stockade, and laid siege to him.

sentences.zh: 繼祖懼，攜澤及索林走照姑。

translations.literal: Jizu, afraid, fled with Zhang Ze and Suolin to Zhaogu.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing capture, Jizu fled with Zhang Ze and Suolin to Zhaogu.

sentences.zh: 已，復殺澤。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he killed Zhang Ze.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he killed Zhang Ze.

sentences.zh: 官軍追之急，由直勒渡過江，趨四川，依東川婦家阿科等。

translations.literal: Government troops pressed the pursuit closely; he crossed the river at Zhille Ford, headed toward Sichuan, and relied on Akke and others, his wife's kin from Dongchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Hard pressed by government troops, he crossed the river at Zhille Ford, fled toward Sichuan, and took refuge with Akke and other relatives of his wife's family in Dongchuan.

sentences.zh: 巡按劉思問以狀聞，敕雲南、四川會兵討賊。

translations.literal: Investigating Censor Liu Siwen reported the situation; an edict ordered Yunnan and Sichuan to combine forces to suppress the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating Censor Liu Siwen reported the affair to the throne, and an edict ordered Yunnan and Sichuan to join forces against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 初，繼祖之走東川也，土官鳳氏與之通。

translations.literal: At first, when Jizu fled to Dongchuan, the Feng clan native official colluded with him.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when Jizu fled into Dongchuan, the Feng native officials colluded with him.

sentences.zh: 已而見滇、蜀官軍與土舍祿紹先等兵皆會，乃背繼祖，發卒七千人來援，繼祖益窮。

translations.literal: But when he saw Yunnan and Sichuan government troops and the forces of native clerk Lu Shaoxian and others all assembling, he turned against Jizu and dispatched seven thousand men to assist; Jizu was driven to greater desperation.
translations.idiomatic: When he saw Yunnan and Sichuan government troops joining with the forces of native clerk Lu Shaoxian and others, he turned on Jizu and sent seven thousand men to aid the government, leaving Jizu more desperate than ever.

sentences.zh: 賊帥者色赴紹先營降，斬繼祖以獻。

translations.literal: The bandit chieftain Zhese went to Shaoxian's camp and surrendered, beheading Jizu to present as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel leader Zhese went to Shaoxian's camp and surrendered, presenting Jizu's severed head.

sentences.zh: 姚縣土官高繼先復擒其余黨，姚安府同知高欽及第鈞，謀主趙士傑等皆伏誅。

translations.literal: Gao Jixian, native official of Yao County, again captured the remaining followers; Yao'an Associate Prefect Gao Qin, Di Jun, chief conspirator Zhao Shijie, and others were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jixian, the native official of Yao County, captured the remaining rebels, and Yao'an Associate Prefect Gao Qin, Di Jun, the ringleader Zhao Shijie, and others were all put to death.

sentences.zh: 守臣議改設流官，猶不欲絕鳳氏，授索林支屬鳳歷子思堯經歷，給莊百余。

translations.literal: The defending officials proposed replacing native rule with appointed officials, yet still unwilling to cut off the Feng clan entirely, appointed Feng Li's son Siyao, a branch descendant of Suolin, as an intendant, and granted him more than a hundred estates.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials proposed replacing native rule with appointed magistrates but, unwilling to extinguish the Feng clan entirely, made Siyao, son of Feng Li and a collateral descendant of Suolin, an intendant and granted him more than a hundred estates.

sentences.zh: 鳳歷以不得知府怨望，陰結四川七州及水西宣慰安國亨謀作亂。

translations.literal: Feng Li, resentful at not receiving the prefecture, secretly allied with the seven prefectures of Sichuan and An Guoheng, Pacification Commissioner of Shuixi, to plot rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Li, bitter that he had not been made prefect, secretly joined with the seven Sichuan prefectures and An Guoheng, Pacification Commissioner of Shuixi, to plot rebellion.

sentences.zh: 流官知府劉宗寅遣諭之，不聽，遂聚眾稱思堯知府，夜襲府城。

translations.literal: Appointed Prefect Liu Zongyin sent envoys to admonish him, but Feng Li would not listen; he gathered followers, proclaimed Siyao prefect, and attacked the prefectural city by night.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed Prefect Liu Zongyin sent envoys to warn him, but he refused to listen, gathered his followers, proclaimed Siyao prefect, and launched a night assault on the prefectural city.

sentences.zh: 城中嚴備不能入，退屯魯墟。

translations.literal: The city was on strict guard and they could not enter; they withdrew and encamped at Luxu.
translations.idiomatic: The city was heavily defended and they could not break in, so they withdrew and encamped at Luxu.

sentences.zh: 宗寅夜出兵，砍其營，賊潰，追至馬刺山，擒鳳歷，伏誅。

translations.literal: Zongyin sent troops out by night, stormed their camp, the rebels fled, pursuit reached Maci Mountain, Feng Li was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zongyin led a night sortie against their camp; the rebels broke and fled, and pursuit as far as Maci Mountain ended with Feng Li's capture and execution.

sentences.zh: 萬歷三十五年，繼祖侄阿克久徙金沙江外，賊黨鄭舉等誘阿克作亂，陰結江外會川諸蠻，直陷武定，大肆劫掠。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year of Wanli, Jizu's nephew Ake, long resettled beyond the Jinsha River, was incited to rebel by bandit followers including Zheng Ju, secretly allied with various tribes of Huichuan beyond the river, directly seized Wuding, and looted on a great scale.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year of Wanli, Jizu's nephew Ake, who had long lived beyond the Jinsha River, was incited to rebel by followers such as Zheng Ju, secretly allied himself with the Huichuan tribes across the river, seized Wuding outright, and looted the region on a vast scale.

sentences.zh: 連破元謀、羅次諸城，索府印。

translations.literal: They successively took Yuanshe, Luoci, and other cities, seeking the prefectural seal.
translations.idiomatic: They overran Yuanshe, Luoci, and other towns in succession, demanding the prefectural seal.

sentences.zh: 會流官知府攜印會城，不能得。

translations.literal: The appointed prefect happened to be at the provincial capital with the seal, so they could not obtain it.
translations.idiomatic: The appointed prefect happened to be at the provincial capital with the seal, so they could not get it.

sentences.zh: 賊以無印難號召，劫推官，請冠帶、印信。

translations.literal: Without the seal the rebels found it hard to rally support; they seized the push official and demanded robes, headgear, and the seal.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to rally followers without the seal, the rebels seized the push official and demanded official robes, headgear, and the seal itself.

sentences.zh: 鎮撫以兵未集，懼，差人以府印授之。

translations.literal: The military pacification commissioner, fearing because troops were not yet assembled, sent someone to hand over the prefectural seal.
translations.idiomatic: The pacification commissioner, alarmed because troops had not yet assembled, sent an envoy to surrender the prefectural seal.

sentences.zh: 賊退入武定，立阿克為知府。

translations.literal: The rebels withdrew into Wuding and installed Ake as prefect.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels withdrew into Wuding and installed Ake as prefect.

sentences.zh: 鎮撫調集土兵，分五路進剿，克復武定、元謀、羅次、祿豐、嵩明等州縣，擒阿克及其黨至京師，礫於市。

translations.literal: The pacification commissioner mobilized native troops, advanced in five columns to suppress them, recovered Wuding, Yuanshe, Luoci, Lufeng, Songming, and other subprefectures and counties, captured Ake and his followers and brought them to the capital, where they were dismembered in the market.
translations.idiomatic: The pacification commissioner mobilized native troops and sent five columns against them, recapturing Wuding, Yuanshe, Luoci, Lufeng, Songming, and other counties; Ake and his followers were taken to the capital and executed by dismemberment in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 武定平，遂悉置流官。

translations.literal: Wuding was pacified, and appointed officials were installed throughout.
translations.idiomatic: Once Wuding was pacified, the prefecture was entirely placed under appointed officials.

sentences.zh: 尋甸，古滇國地，獛刺蠻居之，號仲紥溢源部，後為烏蠻裔斯丁所奪，號斯丁部。

translations.literal: Xundian was ancient Dian kingdom territory; the Pulao tribes dwelt there, called the Zhongzhayiyuan Division; later it was seized by Siding, a descendant of the Wuman, and called the Siding Division.
translations.idiomatic: Xundian was territory of the ancient Dian kingdom, inhabited by Pulao tribes under the name Zhongzhayiyuan Division; later it was seized by Siding, a descendant of the Wuman, and renamed the Siding Division.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏為尋甸，至段氏，改仁德部。

translations.literal: Under the Meng clan it was called Xundian; under the Duan clan it was renamed the Rende Division.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Meng clan it was known as Xundian; under the Duan clan it was renamed the Rende Division.

sentences.zh: 元初，置仁德萬戶，後改府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuan the Rende Ten-thousand-household office was established; later it was changed to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yuan dynasty a Rende ten-thousand-household office was established; later it was converted into a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年定雲南，仁德土官阿孔等貢馬及方物，改為尋甸軍民府。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu Yunnan was pacified; Rende native officials including A Kong presented horses and local products, and the area was reorganized as Xundian Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Yunnan was pacified in the fifteenth year of Hongwu, the Rende native officials A Kong and others presented horses and local tribute, and the region was reorganized as Xundian Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十六年，土官安陽來朝，貢馬及虎皮、氈衫等物，詔賜衣服、錦綺、鈔錠。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year native official Anyang came to court, presented horses, tiger skins, felt garments, and other goods; an edict granted him clothing, brocade silk, and paper money.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year the native official Anyang came to court with horses, tiger skins, felt coats, and other gifts; the throne responded with robes, brocade, and paper money.

sentences.zh: 十七年以尋甸土官沙琛為知府。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the Xundian native official Sha Chen was appointed prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year the Xundian native official Sha Chen was made prefect.

sentences.zh: 二十三年置木密關守禦千戶所於尋甸之甸頭易龍驛，又置屯田所於甸頭裏果馬裏，聯絡耕種，以為邊備。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the Mumiguan Guard Thousand-household station was established at Yilong Post in Xundian's Diantou, and a garrison farm station was also established at Guomali in Diantou, linked for cultivation as frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year the Mumiguan Guard thousand-household station was set up at Yilong Post in Xundian's Diantou, and a garrison farm was established at Guomali in the same district, the two linked for cultivation as a frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 是後，土官皆按期入貢。

translations.literal: After this, native officials all paid tribute on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the native officials all paid tribute on schedule.

sentences.zh: 成化十二年，兵部奏，土官舍人安宣聚眾殺掠，命鎮守官相機撫捕。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Chenghua the Ministry of War memorialized that native official clerk An Xuan gathered followers to kill and plunder; frontier garrison officials were ordered to pacify or capture him as circumstances warranted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Chenghua the Ministry of War reported that the native clerk An Xuan had gathered followers to kill and plunder; frontier officials were ordered to pacify or capture him as circumstances allowed.

sentences.zh: 十四年，土知府安晟死，兄弟爭襲，遂改置流官。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year native Prefect An Sheng died; brothers fought over succession, and appointed officials were installed instead.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year the native prefect An Sheng died; his brothers fought over the succession, and the post was given to appointed officials instead.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖六年，安銓作亂，乃土舍之失職者也，侵掠嵩明、木密、楊林等處。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Jiajing An Quan rebelled—he was a dismissed native clerk—and raided Songming, Mumi, Yanglin, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Jiajing An Quan, a dismissed native clerk, rebelled and raided Songming, Mumi, Yanglin, and other districts.

sentences.zh: 巡撫傅習檄守巡官討之，大敗，賊遂陷尋甸、嵩明，殺指揮王升、唐功等，知府馬性魯棄城走。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Fu Xi ordered frontier defense officials to suppress him; they were heavily defeated; the rebels then took Xundian and Songming, killed Commanders Wang Sheng and Tang Gong and others, and Prefect Ma Xinglu abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Fu Xi ordered frontier officials to suppress him, but they were routed; the rebels then seized Xundian and Songming, killed Commanders Wang Sheng and Tang Gong among others, and Prefect Ma Xinglu abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 時武定鳳朝文叛，銓與之合，久之伏誅，事詳前傳。

translations.literal: At that time Feng Chaowen of Wuding rebelled; Quan joined him; after a long time he was executed—the matter is detailed in the preceding biography.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Feng Chaowen of Wuding rose in rebellion; Quan joined forces with him and was eventually executed—the affair is recounted in the preceding biography.

sentences.zh: 麗江，南詔蒙氏置麗水節度。

translations.literal: Lijiang: the Nanzhao Meng clan established the Lishui Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Lijiang: the Nanzhao Meng clan established the Lishui Military Commission there.

sentences.zh: 宋時麽些蠻蒙醋據之。

translations.literal: In Song times the Mosuo tribesman Meng Cu seized it.
translations.idiomatic: During the Song dynasty the Mosuo chieftain Meng Cu took possession of it.

sentences.zh: 元初，置茶罕章宣慰司。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuan the Chahanzhang Pacification Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yuan dynasty the Chahanzhang Pacification Commission was established.

sentences.zh: 至元中，改置麗江路軍民總管府，後改宣撫司。

translations.literal: In the Zhiyuan era it was reorganized as the Lijiang Route Military-Civilian General Administration, later changed to a Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhiyuan era it was reorganized as the Lijiang Route Military-Civilian General Administration and later converted into a Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年置麗江府。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu Lijiang Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: Lijiang Prefecture was established in the fifteenth year of Hongwu.

sentences.zh: 十六年，蠻長木德來朝貢馬，以木德為知府，羅克為蘭州知州。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year tribal chieftain Mu De came to court and presented horses; Mu De was made prefect and Luo Ke was made prefect of Lanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year the tribal chieftain Mu De came to court with horses as tribute; Mu De was appointed prefect and Luo Ke was made prefect of Lan Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 十八年，巨津土酋阿奴聰叛，劫石門關，千戶浦泉戰死。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the Jujin tribal chieftain Anu Cong rebelled, raided Shimen Pass, and Thousand-household Pu Quan died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year the Jujin chieftain Anu Cong rebelled, raided Shimen Pass, and Thousand-household Pu Quan was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 吉安侯陸仲亨率指揮李榮、鄭祥討之，賊戰敗，遁入山谷，捕獲誅之。

translations.literal: Marquis of Ji'an Lu Zhongheng led Commanders Li Rong and Zheng Xiang to suppress him; the rebels were defeated in battle, fled into the mountain valleys, were captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Ji'an Lu Zhongheng led Commanders Li Rong and Zheng Xiang against him; the rebels were defeated, fled into the mountains, were captured, and were executed.

sentences.zh: 時木德從征，又從西平侯沐英征景東、定邊，皆有功，予世襲。

translations.literal: At that time Mu De followed on campaign and also followed the Earl of Xiping Mu Ying on campaigns against Jingdong and Dingbian, distinguishing himself in both; hereditary succession was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Mu De served on campaign and later followed the Earl of Xiping, Mu Ying, against Jingdong and Dingbian, distinguishing himself in both; hereditary office was granted to his line.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，木德死，子初當襲。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Mu De died; his son Chu was to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year Mu De died, and his son Chu was to succeed him.

sentences.zh: 初守巨津州石門關，與西番接境。

translations.literal: Chu guarded Shimen Pass in Jujin Subprefecture, bordering the Western Tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Chu had been stationed at Shimen Pass in Jujin Subprefecture, on the border with the Western Tribes.

sentences.zh: 既襲職，英請以初弟虧為千夫長，代守石門，從之。

translations.literal: After succeeding to office, Ying requested that Chu's younger brother Kui be made a chiliarch to guard Shimen in his stead; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: After Chu succeeded to office, Mu Ying requested that his younger brother Kui be made a chiliarch to hold Shimen Pass in his place; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 二十六年十月，西平侯沐春奏，麗江土民每歲輸白金七百六十兩，皆麽些洞所產，民以馬易金，不諳真偽，請令以馬代輸，從之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the twenty-sixth year the Earl of Xiping Mu Chun memorialized that Lijiang natives each year paid seven hundred sixty taels of white gold, all produced in Mosuo caves; the people exchanged horses for gold and could not tell genuine from false; he requested that horses be accepted in lieu of payment; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the twenty-sixth year the Earl of Xiping, Mu Chun, reported that Lijiang natives paid seven hundred sixty taels of white gold each year, all mined in Mosuo caves; because the people traded horses for gold without knowing real from counterfeit, he asked that horses be accepted instead; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 三十年改為麗江軍民府，從春請也。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year it was changed to Lijiang Military-Civilian Prefecture, following Chun's request.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year it was redesignated Lijiang Military-Civilian Prefecture, as Mu Chun had requested.

sentences.zh: 永樂十六年，檢校龐文郁言，本府及寶山、巨津、通安、蘭州四州歸化日久，請建學校，從之。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Yongle Inspector Pang Wenyu reported that this prefecture and the four subprefectures of Baoshan, Jujin, Tong'an, and Lanzhou had long been assimilated and requested schools be established; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Yongle, Inspector Pang Wenyu reported that the prefecture and the four subprefectures of Baoshan, Jujin, Tong'an, and Lanzhou had long submitted to the dynasty and asked that schools be established; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 宣德五年，麗江府奏浪滄江寨蠻者保等聚眾劫掠。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xuande Lijiang Prefecture reported that the Lancangjiang Stockade tribesman Zhebao and others had gathered followers to raid.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xuande Lijiang Prefecture reported that Zhebao of the Lancangjiang Stockade and others had gathered followers to raid and plunder.

sentences.zh: 黔國公沐晟委官撫諭，不服，部議再行招撫。

translations.literal: The Duke of Qinguo Mu Sheng dispatched officials to pacify and instruct them; they did not submit; the ministry proposed renewed persuasion.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Qinguo, Mu Sheng, sent officials to pacify them, but they refused to submit; the ministry recommended another round of persuasion.

sentences.zh: 已，蘭州土官羅牙等奏，者保拒命，請發兵討之。

translations.literal: Soon after, Lanzhou native officials including Luo Ya memorialized that Zhebao defied orders and requested troops be sent to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the Lanzhou native officials Luo Ya and others memorialized that Zhebao had defied orders and asked that troops be sent against him.

sentences.zh: 帝命黔國公及雲南三司相機行，勿緣細故激變蠻民。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the Duke of Qinguo and the three provincial offices of Yunnan to act as circumstances warranted, and not to provoke tribal uprising over minor matters.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the Duke of Qinguo and Yunnan's three provincial offices to act as circumstances required and not to provoke the tribes over minor grievances.

sentences.zh: 正統五年，賜知府木森誥命，加授大中大夫資治少尹，以征麓川功也。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhengtong Prefect Mu Sen was granted a patent of appointment and additionally invested as Grand Master of Palace Attendance with the rank of Vice Director of the Capital Magistracy, for merit in the Luchuan campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Zhengtong Prefect Mu Sen was granted a patent of appointment and additionally invested as Grand Master of Palace Attendance with the rank of Vice Director of the Capital Magistracy for his service in the Luchuan campaign.

sentences.zh: 成化十一年，知府木嵚奏，鶴慶千夫長趙賢屢糾群賊越境殺掠，乞調旁衛官軍擒剿，命移知守臣計畫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Chenghua Prefect Mu Qin memorialized that Heqing chiliarch Zhao Xian repeatedly gathered bandits to cross the border killing and looting, and begged that neighboring guard troops be mobilized to capture and suppress them; orders were sent to the defending officials to devise a plan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Chenghua Prefect Mu Qin reported that Heqing chiliarch Zhao Xian had repeatedly led bandits across the border to kill and plunder, and asked that neighboring guard troops be mobilized to capture them; orders were sent to local officials to devise a plan.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三十九年，知府木高進助殿工銀二千八百兩，詔加文職三品服色，給誥命。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year of Jiajing Prefect Mu Gao presented two thousand eight hundred taels of silver to assist palace construction; an edict granted him third-rank civil robes and issued a patent of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year of Jiajing Prefect Mu Gao contributed two thousand eight hundred taels of silver toward palace construction; an edict granted him third-rank civil robes and a patent of appointment.

sentences.zh: 四十年又進木植銀二千八百兩，詔進一級，授亞中大夫，給誥命。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year he again presented two thousand eight hundred taels of silver for timber; an edict promoted him one rank, invested him as Grand Master of Propagation, and issued a patent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year he contributed another two thousand eight hundred taels of silver for timber; an edict promoted him one rank, invested him as Grand Master of Propagation, and issued a new patent.

sentences.zh: 萬歷三十一年，巡按御史宋興祖奏：「稅使內監楊榮欲責麗江土官退地，聽采。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year of Wanli Investigating Censor Song Xingzu memorialized: "The tax envoy eunuch Yang Rong wished to compel the Lijiang native official to cede land for mining.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year of Wanli, Investigating Censor Song Xingzu memorialized: "The eunuch tax envoy Yang Rong wished to compel the Lijiang native official to surrender land for mining.

sentences.zh: 竊以麗江自太祖令木氏世官，守石門以絕西域，守鐵橋以斷吐蕃，滇南藉為屏藩。

translations.literal: I venture to observe that since the Founding Emperor ordered the Mu clan to hold hereditary office, they have guarded Shimen to block the Western Regions and guarded Iron Bridge to cut off Tibet; southern Yunnan relies on them as a screen and bulwark.
translations.idiomatic: I submit that since the Founding Emperor made the Mu clan hereditary officials, they have guarded Shimen Pass to block the Western Regions and Iron Bridge to hold back Tibet; all of southern Yunnan relies on them as a frontier bulwark.

sentences.zh: 今使退地聽采，必失遠蠻之心。

translations.literal: To make them cede land for mining would surely lose the hearts of distant tribes.
translations.idiomatic: To make them surrender land for mining would surely alienate the distant tribes.

sentences.zh: 即令聽諭，已使國家歲歲有吐藩之防；

translations.literal: Even if they were persuaded to comply, the state would still face yearly defenses against Tibet;
translations.idiomatic: Even if they could be persuaded to comply, the state would still have to maintain yearly defenses against Tibet;

sentences.zh: 倘或不聽，豈獨有傷國體。

translations.literal: and if they refused, would that not alone wound the dignity of the state.
translations.idiomatic: and if they refused, would that not by itself damage the dignity of the state.

sentences.zh: 」疏上，事得寢。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, the matter was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: " When the memorial reached the throne, the matter was dropped.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，知府木增以征蠻軍興，助餉銀二萬余兩，乞比北勝土舍高光裕例，加級。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year Prefect Mu Zeng, because of military mobilization against tribes, contributed more than twenty thousand taels of silver for provisions and requested promotion on the precedent of Beisheng native clerk Gao Guangyu.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year Prefect Mu Zeng, citing the military mobilization against the tribes, contributed more than twenty thousand taels of silver for provisions and asked for promotion on the precedent of Beisheng native clerk Gao Guangyu.

sentences.zh: 部覆賜三品服色，巡按御史劾其違越，請奪新恩，從之。

translations.literal: The ministry replied granting third-rank robes; the investigating censor impeached him for overstepping and requested the new favor be revoked; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry approved third-rank robes, but the investigating censor impeached him for overstepping his authority and asked that the new honor be revoked; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，增復輸銀一萬助遼餉。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year Zeng again contributed ten thousand taels of silver to assist Liaodong provisions.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year Mu Zeng contributed another ten thousand taels of silver to support Liaodong provisions.

sentences.zh: 泰昌元年，錄增功，賞白金表裏，其子懿及舍目各賞銀幣有差。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taichang Zeng's merit was recorded; he was rewarded with white gold and a set of robes; his son Yi and the native clerks were each rewarded with silver and silks in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taichang his service was officially recorded; he was rewarded with white gold and a set of robes, and his son Yi and the native clerks received silver and silks in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 天啟二年，增以病告，加授左參政致仕。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianqi Zeng reported illness and was additionally invested as Left Vice Commissioner and granted retirement.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianqi Mu Zeng reported illness and was additionally invested as Left Vice Commissioner and granted retirement.

sentences.zh: 五年，特給增誥命，以旌其忠。

translations.literal: In the fifth year a special patent was granted to Zeng to honor his loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year a special patent of appointment was granted to Mu Zeng to honor his loyalty.

sentences.zh: 雲南諸土官，知詩書好禮守義，以麗江木氏為首雲。

translations.literal: Among Yunnan's native officials who know poetry and the classics, honor rites, and keep faith, the Lijiang Mu clan is said to rank first.
translations.idiomatic: Among Yunnan's native officials who know the classics, honor ritual, and keep faith, the Lijiang Mu clan is said to stand first.

sentences.zh: 元江，古西南夷極邊境，曰惠籠甸，又名因遠部。

translations.literal: Yuanjiang: the ancient far frontier of the Southwestern Yi, called Huilong Dian, also known as the Yinyuan Division.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjiang lay on the ancient far frontier of the Southwestern Yi, known as Huilong Dian and also called the Yinyuan Division.

sentences.zh: 南詔蒙氏以屬銀生節度，徙白蠻蘇、張、周、段等十姓戍之。

translations.literal: The Nanzhao Meng clan attached it to the Yinsheng Military Commission and relocated ten surnames of the Bai people—Su, Zhang, Zhou, Duan, and others—to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: The Nanzhao Meng clan placed it under the Yinsheng Military Commission and relocated ten Bai clans—Su, Zhang, Zhou, Duan, and others—to garrison the region.

sentences.zh: 又開威遠等處，置威遠睒。

translations.literal: They also opened Weiyuan and other places and established the Weiyuan administrative unit.
translations.idiomatic: They also opened Weiyuan and other districts and established the Weiyuan administrative unit.

sentences.zh: 後和泥侵據其地。

translations.literal: Later the Hani people invaded and occupied the land.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Hani people invaded and took possession of the region.

sentences.zh: 宋時，儂智高之黨竄居於此，和泥又開羅槃甸居之，後為麽些、徒蠻、阿僰諸部所據。

translations.literal: In Song times followers of Nong Zhigao fled and dwelt here; the Hani again opened Luopan Dian and settled there; later it was seized by the Mosuo, Tubman, A'bo, and other divisions.
translations.idiomatic: During the Song dynasty followers of Nong Zhigao fled here; the Hani later opened Luopan Dian and settled there, and afterward the region was seized by the Mosuo, Tubman, A'bo, and other tribal divisions.

sentences.zh: 元時內附。

translations.literal: In Yuan times they submitted to internal rule.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuan dynasty they submitted to the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 至元中，置元江萬戶府。

translations.literal: In the Zhiyuan era the Yuanjiang Ten-thousand-household office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhiyuan era the Yuanjiang ten-thousand-household office was established.

sentences.zh: 後於威遠更置元江路，領羅槃、馬籠等十二部，屬臨安、廣西、元江等處宣慰司。

translations.literal: Later at Weiyuan the Yuanjiang Route was reorganized, governing twelve divisions including Luopan and Malong, subordinate to the Pacification Commissions of Lin'an, Guangxi, Yuanjiang, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Later, at Weiyuan, the Yuanjiang Route was reorganized to govern twelve divisions including Luopan and Malong, under the Pacification Commissions of Lin'an, Guangxi, Yuanjiang, and other districts.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年改元江府。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu it was changed to Yuanjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu it was redesignated Yuanjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十七年，土官那直來朝貢象，以那直為元江知府，賜襲衣冠帶。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the native official Na Zhi came to court and presented an elephant as tribute; Na Zhi was made prefect of Yuanjiang, and hereditary official robes, cap, and belt were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year the native official Na Zhi came to court with an elephant as tribute; he was appointed prefect of Yuanjiang and granted the hereditary robes, cap, and belt of office.

sentences.zh: 十八年置因遠羅必甸長官司隸之，以土酋白文玉為副長官。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the Yinyuan Luobidian Native Official Prefecture was established and subordinated to it; the tribal chieftain Bai Wenyu was made vice prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year the Yinyuan Luobidian native official prefecture was established under Yuanjiang, with the tribal chieftain Bai Wenyu as vice prefect.

sentences.zh: 二十年遣經歷楊大用往元江等府練兵，時百夷屢為邊患，帝欲發兵平之故也。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Administrator Yang Dayong was dispatched to Yuanjiang and other prefectures to drill troops; at the time the Baiyi repeatedly caused frontier troubles, and the emperor wished to send troops to pacify them—this was the reason.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Administrator Yang Dayong was sent to Yuanjiang and other prefectures to drill troops, because the Baiyi were repeatedly troubling the frontier and the emperor intended to send an army to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 二十六年置元江府儒學。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the Confucian school of Yuanjiang Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year a Confucian school was established in Yuanjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，知府那榮及白文玉等來朝貢。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Prefect Na Rong and Bai Wenyu and others came to court and presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year Prefect Na Rong, Bai Wenyu, and others came to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 永樂三年，榮復入朝貢。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongle Rong again came to court and presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongle Na Rong again came to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 帝厚加賜予，遂改為元江軍民府，給之印信。

translations.literal: The emperor richly rewarded him and then changed it to Yuanjiang Military-Civilian Prefecture, granting its seal and credentials.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor showered him with gifts and redesignated the district Yuanjiang Military-Civilian Prefecture, granting its official seal and credentials.

sentences.zh: 榮請躬率兵及饋運，往攻八百，帝嘉勞之。

translations.literal: Rong requested to personally lead troops and supply transport to attack Baibai; the emperor praised and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: Rong asked to lead troops and supply columns in person against Baibai; the emperor commended and rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 元江府又奏，石屏州洛夾橋，每歲江水沖壞，止令本府修理，民不堪，乞命石屏州協治，從之。

translations.literal: Yuanjiang Prefecture further memorialized that the Luojia Bridge in Shiping Subprefecture was washed out by the river each year, and repair had been assigned to this prefecture alone—the people could not bear it; they requested that Shiping Subprefecture share the work; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjiang Prefecture further reported that the Luojia Bridge in Shiping Subprefecture was destroyed by the river each year and that repair had fallen entirely on Yuanjiang, which the people could not sustain; they asked that Shiping share the burden, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 九年，那榮率頭目人等來朝，貢馬及金銀器，賜予如例。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Na Rong led headmen and others to court, presenting horses and gold and silver vessels; rewards were granted according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Na Rong led his headmen to court with horses and gold and silver vessels as tribute; they were rewarded according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 十二年，故土知府那直子那邦入貢方物。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Na Bang, son of the former native prefect Na Zhi, presented local products as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Na Bang, son of the former native prefect Na Zhi, came with local products as tribute.

sentences.zh: 宣德五年，黔國公沐晟奏，元江土知府那忠，被賊刀正、刀龍等焚其廨宇及經歷印信。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xuande the Duke of Qinguo Mu Sheng memorialized that the Yuanjiang native prefect Na Zhong had had his yamen and the administrator's seal and credentials burned by the bandits Dao Zheng, Dao Long, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xuande the Duke of Qinguo, Mu Sheng, reported that the Yuanjiang native prefect Na Zhong had had his yamen and the administrator's seal burned by the bandits Dao Zheng, Dao Long, and others.

sentences.zh: 今獲刀龍、刀洽赴京，乞如永樂故事，發遼東安置，以警邊夷，從之。

translations.literal: Now that Dao Long and Dao Qia had been captured and sent to the capital, he requested that, following the Yongle precedent, they be sent to Liaodong for resettlement to warn the frontier tribes; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Dao Long and Dao Qia had been captured and brought to the capital, he asked that they be resettled in Liaodong, as in the Yongle precedent, to warn the frontier tribes; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 命禮部鑄印給之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites was ordered to cast a seal and grant it to him.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites was ordered to cast a new seal and grant it to him.

sentences.zh: 正統元年，因遠羅必甸長官司遣人來朝貢馬。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengtong the Yinyuan Luobidian Native Official Prefecture dispatched envoys to court presenting horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhengtong the Yinyuan Luobidian native official prefecture sent envoys to court with horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 正德二年以那端襲土知府。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengde Na Duan succeeded as native prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhengde Na Duan inherited the post of native prefect.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十五年，土舍那鑒殺其侄土知府那憲，奪其印，並收因遠驛印記。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Jiajing the native clerk Na Jian killed his nephew the native prefect Na Xian, seized his seal, and also took the seal of Yinyuan Post.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year of Jiajing the native clerk Na Jian killed his nephew, the native prefect Na Xian, seized his seal, and also took the seal of Yinyuan Post.

sentences.zh: 巡撫應大猷以聞，命鎮巡官發兵剿之。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Ying Dayou reported it; frontier garrison officials were ordered to dispatch troops to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Ying Dayou reported the affair, and frontier officials were ordered to send troops against him.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，那鑒懼，密約交蠻武文淵謀亂。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Na Jian grew fearful and secretly allied with the Jiaoman Wu Wenyuan to plot rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Na Jian, fearing capture, secretly colluded with the Jiao tribesman Wu Wenyuan to raise a rebellion.

sentences.zh: 撫按官胡奎、林應箕，總兵官沐朝弼以聞，請以副使李維、參政胡堯時督兵剿之，制可。

translations.literal: The grand coordinator and censor Hu Kui and Lin Yingji, and Regional Commander Mu Chaobi reported it, requesting that Vice Commissioner Li Wei and Administrative Commissioner Hu Yaoshi supervise troops to suppress him; the order was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Hu Kui, Censor Lin Yingji, and Regional Commander Mu Chaobi reported the plot and asked that Vice Commissioner Li Wei and Administrative Commissioner Hu Yaoshi lead the suppression; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 那鑒益縱兵攻掠村寨。

translations.literal: Na Jian all the more unleashed troops to attack and plunder stockades and villages.
translations.idiomatic: Na Jian redoubled his raids on stockades and villages.

sentences.zh: 沐朝弼與巡撫石簡調武定、北勝、亦佐等土、漢兵，分五哨。
