translations.literal: Mu Chaobi and Grand Coordinator Shi Jian mobilized native and Han troops from Wuding, Beisheng, Yizuo, and other places, dividing them into five outposts.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Chaobi and Grand Coordinator Shi Jian mustered native and Han troops from Wuding, Beisheng, Yizuo, and elsewhere, organizing them into five columns.

sentences.zh: 調兵既集，朝弼與簡駐臨安，分部進兵。

translations.literal: Once the mobilized troops were assembled, Chaobi and Jian stationed themselves at Lin'an and advanced in separate divisions.
translations.idiomatic: When the troops had gathered, Mu Chaobi and Shi Jian established headquarters at Lin'an and advanced in separate divisions.

sentences.zh: 破木龍寨，降甘莊，賊勢漸蹙。

translations.literal: They broke Mulong Stockade, received the surrender of Ganzhuang, and the rebels' strength gradually tightened.
translations.idiomatic: They took Mulong Stockade, accepted the surrender of Ganzhuang, and the rebels' position steadily weakened.

sentences.zh: 那鑒遣經歷張維及生儒數人詣南羨監督王養浩所乞降。

translations.literal: Na Jian sent Administrator Zhang Wei and several student scholars to Supervisor Wang Yanghao at Nanyang to beg surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Na Jian sent Administrator Zhang Wei and several local scholars to Supervisor Wang Yanghao at Nanyang to sue for surrender.

sentences.zh: 時左布政徐樾以督餉至南羨，樾迂暗，聞維言，謂鑒誠計窮，乃約翼日今鑒面縛出城來降。

translations.literal: At the time Left Provincial Administrator Xu Yue had arrived at Nanyang to supervise supplies; Yue was obtuse and dull-witted; hearing Zhang Wei's words, he said Jian was truly at his wit's end, and arranged for the next day that Jian should come out of the city bound to surrender in person.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Left Provincial Administrator Xu Yue had arrived at Nanyang to supervise supplies. Xu Yue was slow and credulous; hearing Zhang Wei's plea, he decided Na Jian was truly desperate and arranged for him to come out of the city the next day, bound, to surrender in person.

sentences.zh: 左右鹹謂夷詐不可信，樾不聽，如期親率百人往城下受降。

translations.literal: Those around him all said the tribesmen's trickery could not be trusted; Yue would not listen, and on the appointed day personally led a hundred men to the foot of the city wall to accept surrender.
translations.idiomatic: His advisers all warned that the tribesmen were treacherous and could not be trusted, but Xu Yue refused to listen and, on the appointed day, personally led a hundred men to the city wall to accept the surrender.

sentences.zh: 鑒縱象馬夷兵突出沖之，樾及左右皆死。

translations.literal: Jian unleashed elephant-and-horse tribal troops in a sudden rush against them; Yue and those around him all died.
translations.idiomatic: Na Jian sent elephant and cavalry troops in a sudden charge; Xu Yue and all who accompanied him were killed.

sentences.zh: 巡按趙炳然以聞，並參朝弼、簡及養浩等失事罪。

translations.literal: Touring Censor Zhao Bingran reported it and also impeached Chaobi, Jian, Yanghao, and others for the failure.
translations.idiomatic: Touring Censor Zhao Bingran reported the disaster and also impeached Mu Chaobi, Shi Jian, Wang Yanghao, and others for their failures.

sentences.zh: 帝降敕切責，褫簡職，養浩等各住俸，克期捕賊贖罪。

translations.literal: The emperor issued a stern edict of rebuke, stripped Jian of office, ordered Yanghao and others each to forfeit salary, and set a deadline to capture the rebels to redeem their guilt.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent down a stern rebuke, dismissed Shi Jian from office, suspended the salaries of Wang Yanghao and the others, and set a deadline for them to capture the rebels and redeem their fault.

sentences.zh: 朝弼與簡乃督集五哨兵，環元江而壁。

translations.literal: Chaobi and Jian then supervised the assembly of the five outpost troops and encircled Yuanjiang with camps.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Chaobi and Shi Jian then mustered the five columns and laid siege camps around Yuanjiang.

sentences.zh: 令南羨哨督兵渡江攻城，選路通哨、甘莊哨各精卒二千佐之。

translations.literal: They ordered the Nanyang outpost commander to lead troops across the river to attack the city, selecting two thousand elite soldiers each from the Lutong and Ganzhuang outposts to assist.
translations.idiomatic: They ordered the Nanyang column to cross the river and attack the city, with two thousand picked troops from each of the Lutong and Ganzhuang columns in support.

sentences.zh: 那鑒知二哨精卒悉歸南羨，潛遣兵象乘虛沖路通哨。

translations.literal: Na Jian knew the elite soldiers of the two outposts had all gone to Nanyang; he secretly dispatched troops and elephants to take advantage of the opening and charge the Lutong outpost.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that the elite troops of the two columns had all been sent to Nanyang, Na Jian secretly launched troops and elephants in a surprise attack on the Lutong column.

sentences.zh: 官兵不意賊至，倉猝燒營走。

translations.literal: The government troops did not expect the rebels to arrive; in haste they burned their camp and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The government troops were caught unawares; they burned their camp in panic and fled.

sentences.zh: 監督郝維嶽奔入甘莊哨，甘莊亦大潰，督哨李維亦遁，惟余南羨逼城而軍。

translations.literal: Supervisor Hao Weiyue fled into the Ganzhuang outpost; Ganzhuang also collapsed in rout; outpost commander Li Wei also fled; only Nanyang pressed the city with troops.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisor Hao Weiyue fled into the Ganzhuang column, which then collapsed in rout; column commander Li Wei also fled, leaving only the Nanyang force pressing the city.

sentences.zh: 武定女土官瞿氏、寧州土舍祿紹先、廣南儂兵頭目陸友仁鹹恨那鑒戕主奪嫡，誓死不退。

translations.literal: The female native official Qu of Wuding, the Ningzhou native clerk Lu Shaoxian, and the Guangnan Nong soldier headman Lu Youren all hated Na Jian for killing his lord and seizing succession by force, and vowed to die rather than retreat.
translations.idiomatic: The female native official Lady Qu of Wuding, the Ningzhou native clerk Lu Shaoxian, and the Guangnan Nong chieftain Lu Youren all detested Na Jian for murdering his superior and usurping the succession, and swore to fight to the death without retreating.

sentences.zh: 督哨王養浩因激獎之，翼日鼓噪攻城，賊大敗，閉門不出。

translations.literal: Outpost commander Wang Yanghao therefore roused and rewarded them; the next day they raised a battle cry and attacked the city; the rebels were heavily defeated and shut the gates and would not come out.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisor Wang Yanghao rallied and rewarded them; the next day they stormed the city with a great clamor, routed the rebels, and drove them to shut the gates.

sentences.zh: 官兵圍之，鑒乞降。

translations.literal: The government troops besieged them; Jian begged to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops invested the city, and Na Jian sued for surrender.

sentences.zh: 官兵懲徐樾之敗，不應。

translations.literal: The government troops, mindful of Xu Yue's defeat, did not respond.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of Xu Yue's death, the government troops refused to accept.

sentences.zh: 城中析屋而爨，鬥米銀三四錢。

translations.literal: Inside the city they dismantled houses for fuel; a peck of rice cost three or four qian of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Inside the city the people tore down houses for firewood; a peck of rice sold for three or four qian of silver.

sentences.zh: 時瘴毒起，大兵乃復撤，期秋末征之，朝弼以事聞。

translations.literal: At that time malarial pestilence arose; the main army then withdrew again, setting autumn's end for the campaign; Chaobi reported the matter.
translations.idiomatic: When malarial sickness spread, the main force withdrew, planning to campaign again in late autumn; Mu Chaobi reported the situation to the court.

sentences.zh: 帝定二哨失事諸臣罪，行撫臣厚賞瞿氏、祿紹先、陸友仁等，敕朝弼會同新撫臣鮑象賢鳩兵討賊。

translations.literal: The emperor fixed the guilt of the officials who failed in the two outposts, ordered the grand coordinator to richly reward Qu, Lu Shaoxian, Lu Youren, and others, and commanded Chaobi to unite with the new grand coordinator Bao Xiangxian to gather troops and suppress the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor assigned blame for the failures of the two columns, ordered rich rewards for Lady Qu, Lu Shaoxian, Lu Youren, and the others, and commanded Mu Chaobi to join the new grand coordinator Bao Xiangxian in mustering troops to suppress the rebels.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，象賢至鎮，調集土、漢兵七萬人，廣集糧運，克期分哨進剿元江，為必取計。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year Xiangxian arrived at his post, mobilized seventy thousand native and Han troops, broadly gathered grain transport, set a date to advance in outposts against Yuanjiang, and planned to take it without fail.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year Bao Xiangxian took up his post, mustered seventy thousand native and Han troops, built up grain supplies, and set a fixed date for a multi-column advance on Yuanjiang, determined to take the city.

sentences.zh: 那鑒懼，伏藥死。

translations.literal: Na Jian grew fearful and took poison and died in secret.
translations.idiomatic: Na Jian, in fear, secretly took poison and died.

sentences.zh: 象賢檄百戶汪輔入城，撫諭其眾，擒其賊首，及戕土官那憲之阿捉，殺布政徐樾之光龍、光色等，皆斬首以獻。

translations.literal: Xiangxian issued orders for Centurion Wang Fu to enter the city, pacify and instruct the people, capture the rebel chiefs, and also Azhuo who killed the native official Na Xian, and Guanglong and Guangse who killed Provincial Administrator Xu Yue—all were beheaded and presented.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Xiangxian ordered Centurion Wang Fu into the city to pacify the populace, seize the rebel leaders, and capture Azhuo, who had killed the native official Na Xian, and Guanglong and Guangse, who had killed Provincial Administrator Xu Yue—all were beheaded and their heads presented.

sentences.zh: 鑒子恕輸所占那旂、封鑾等村寨，並出所掠鎮沅府印，納象十二只，輸屢歲逋賦。

translations.literal: Jian's son Shu surrendered the stockades he occupied including Naqi and Fengluan, also produced the Zhenyuan Prefecture seal he had seized, presented twelve elephants, and paid accumulated tribute tax of several years.
translations.idiomatic: Na Jian's son Shu surrendered the villages he had seized, including Naqi and Fengluan, returned the seal of Zhenyuan Prefecture he had taken, presented twelve elephants, and paid several years of overdue tribute.

sentences.zh: 象賢命官民推那氏當立者，眾舉前土官那端從孫從仁。

translations.literal: Xiangxian ordered officials and people to recommend who among the Na clan should be established; the crowd nominated Congren, grand-nephew of the former native official Na Duan.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Xiangxian asked officials and townspeople to choose a worthy member of the Na clan; they nominated Congren, a grand-nephew of the former native official Na Duan.

sentences.zh: 象賢疏言其狀，請廢恕，貸其死，命從仁暫統其眾，加汪輔以千戶職，從之。

translations.literal: Xiangxian memorialized stating the circumstances, requested that Shu be deposed, spared death, and that Congren be ordered temporarily to command his followers; Wang Fu was additionally given the rank of chiliarch; the requests were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Bao Xiangxian memorialized on the matter, asking that Shu be deposed but spared execution, that Congren be placed temporarily in command of the people, and that Wang Fu be promoted to chiliarch; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 萬歷十三年以元江土舍那恕招降車裏功，許襲祖職，賞銀幣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Wanli, for the Yuanjiang native clerk Na Shu's merit in persuading Cheli to surrender, he was permitted to inherit his ancestral office and rewarded with silver and silk coins.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Wanli Na Shu, the Yuanjiang native clerk, was allowed to inherit his ancestral office and given silver and silk in reward for his service in inducing Cheli to surrender.

sentences.zh: 領長官司一，曰因遠羅必甸。

translations.literal: It governed one native official prefecture, called Yinyuan Luobidian.
translations.idiomatic: It governed one native official prefecture: Yinyuan Luobidian.

sentences.zh: 永昌，古哀牢固。

translations.literal: Yongchang was ancient Ailao territory.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchang was the land of ancient Ailao.

sentences.zh: 漢武帝時，置不韋縣。

translations.literal: In the time of Emperor Wu of Han Buwei County was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the reign of Emperor Wu of Han, Buwei County was established there.

sentences.zh: 東漢置瀾滄郡，尋改永昌郡。

translations.literal: In Eastern Han Lancang Commandery was established; soon it was changed to Yongchang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Eastern Han, Lancang Commandery was established and soon renamed Yongchang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 唐屬姚州，後為南詔蒙氏所據，歷段氏、高氏皆為永昌府。

translations.literal: In Tang it belonged to Yaozhou; later it was seized by the Nanzhao Meng clan; through the Duan and Gao clans it was all Yongchang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it belonged to Yaozhou; later the Nanzhao Meng clan seized it, and under the Duan and Gao clans alike it formed Yongchang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元初，於永昌立三千戶所，隸大理萬戶府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuan a three-thousand-household station was established at Yongchang, subordinate to the Dali Ten-thousand-household Office.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yuan dynasty a three-thousand-household station was established at Yongchang under the Dali ten-thousand-household office.

sentences.zh: 至元間置永昌州，尋為府，隸大理路，置金齒等處宣撫司治。

translations.literal: In the Zhiyuan era Yongchang Subprefecture was established; soon it became a prefecture, subordinate to Dali Route, with the Jinchi and Other Places Pacification Commission administering it.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhiyuan era Yongchang Subprefecture was established and soon elevated to a prefecture under Dali Route, administered by the Jinchi Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年定雲南，立金齒衛。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu Yunnan was pacified and Jinchi Guard was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu, after Yunnan was pacified, Jinchi Guard was established.

sentences.zh: 以元雲南右丞觀音保為金齒指揮使，賜姓名李觀。

translations.literal: The Yuan Yunnan Right Vice Censor-in-chief Guanyin Bao was made Jinchi Guard commander and granted the surname and personal name Li Guan.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan Yunnan Right Vice Censor-in-chief Guanyin Bao was appointed commander of Jinchi Guard and given the name Li Guan.

sentences.zh: 十六年，永昌州土官申保來朝，詔賜錦二匹、織金文綺二匹、衣一襲及钑花銀帶、鞾襪。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year the Yongchang Subprefecture native official Shen Bao came to court; an edict granted two bolts of brocade, two bolts of woven-gold patterned silk, one suit of clothing, and an embossed silver belt, boots, and socks.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year the Yongchang native official Shen Bao came to court; the throne granted him two bolts of brocade, two bolts of gold-woven patterned silk, a full suit of clothing, an embossed silver belt, boots, and socks.

sentences.zh: 十七年以申保為永昌府同知。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Shen Bao was made Vice Prefect of Yongchang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Shen Bao was appointed vice prefect of Yongchang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 四月，金齒土官段惠遣把事及其子弟來貢，賜綺帛鈔有差。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the Jinchi native official Duan Hui sent a steward and his younger relatives to present tribute; patterned silk and paper money were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the Jinchi native official Duan Hui sent a steward and his kinsmen with tribute; they were rewarded with patterned silk and paper money according to rank.

sentences.zh: 置施甸長官司，以土酋阿幹為副長官，賜冠帶。

translations.literal: The Shidian Native Official Prefecture was established; the tribal chieftain Agan was made vice prefect and granted cap and belt.
translations.idiomatic: The Shidian native official prefecture was established, with the tribal chieftain Agan as vice prefect and granted the official cap and belt.

sentences.zh: 十八年置金齒衛指揮使司。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the Jinchi Guard Command was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year the Jinchi Guard command was established.

sentences.zh: 二十年，遣使諭金齒衛指揮儲傑、嚴武、李觀曰：「金齒遠在邊僥，土民不遵禮法。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year envoys were dispatched to instruct Jinchi Guard Commanders Chu Jie, Yan Wu, and Li Guan, saying: "Jinchi is far in the frontier reaches; the native people do not observe ritual and law.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year envoys were sent to instruct Jinchi Guard Commanders Chu Jie, Yan Wu, and Li Guan, saying: "Jinchi lies far on the frontier; the native people do not observe ritual and law.

sentences.zh: 爾指揮李觀處事寬厚，名播蠻中，為諸蠻所愛。

translations.literal: Your commander Li Guan is generous in conduct, his fame spreads among the tribes, and he is loved by all the tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Your commander Li Guan is generous in his dealings, his name is known throughout the tribal lands, and he is beloved by the tribes.

sentences.zh: 然其下多恃功放恣，有乖軍律，故特命傑、武輔之。

translations.literal: Yet many under him rely on merit to act unrestrainedly, contrary to military regulations; therefore Jie and Wu have been specially appointed to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: Yet many of his subordinates rely on their achievements to act with impunity, in violation of military discipline; therefore Chu Jie and Yan Wu have been specially appointed to assist him.

sentences.zh: 觀之寬，可以綏遠；

translations.literal: Guan's generosity can pacify the distant;
translations.idiomatic: Li Guan's leniency can soothe distant peoples;

sentences.zh: 傑、武之嚴，可以馭下。

translations.literal: Jie and Wu's severity can control subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: Chu Jie and Yan Wu's severity can control the ranks below.

sentences.zh: 敕至，其整練諸軍，以觀外變。」

translations.literal: When the edict arrives, drill all troops, with Guan handling external affairs."
translations.idiomatic: When this edict arrives, drill the troops thoroughly and leave external affairs to Li Guan."

sentences.zh: 宣德五年設金齒軍民指揮司騰沖州，置土知州一員。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xuande Tengchong Prefecture was established under the Jinchi Military-Civilian Command, and one native prefect was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xuande Tengchong Prefecture was established within the Jinchi Military-Civilian Command district, and one native prefect was appointed.

sentences.zh: 時騰沖守禦所土官副千戶張銘言，其地遠在極邊，麓川宣慰思任發不時侵擾，乞設州治。

translations.literal: At the time Tengchong Guard native deputy chiliarch Zhang Ming reported that the place was far at the extreme frontier, that Luchuan Pacification Commissioner Si Renfa disturbed it from time to time, and requested a prefectural administration be established.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhang Ming, native deputy chiliarch of Tengchong Guard, reported that the region lay at the farthest frontier and suffered periodic raids from Luchuan Pacification Commissioner Si Renfa, and asked that a prefecture be established.

sentences.zh: 帝從之，即以銘為騰沖知州。

translations.literal: The emperor agreed and immediately made Ming Tengchong Prefect.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed and appointed Zhang Ming prefect of Tengchong.

sentences.zh: 八年置騰沖州庫扛關、庫刀關、庫勒關、古湧二關。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the Tengchong Subprefecture passes Kuogang, Kudao, Kule, and the two passes of Guyong were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year four passes were established under Tengchong: Kuogang, Kudao, Kule, and the two Guyong passes.

sentences.zh: 先是，騰沖州奏，本州路通麓川、緬甸諸處，人民逃徙者多，有誤差發貢獻。

translations.literal: Earlier Tengchong Prefecture memorialized that routes from this prefecture connected to Luchuan, Burma, and other places; many people had fled and moved away, causing errors in dispatching tribute contributions.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Tengchong Prefecture had reported that its routes linked Luchuan, Burma, and other regions, that many inhabitants had fled, and that tribute levies were therefore being misassigned.

sentences.zh: 舊四百夫長隸騰沖千戶所，其庫扛關等五處，皆軍民兼守。

translations.literal: Formerly the four-hundred chiliarchs were subordinate to Tengchong Thousand-household station; the five places including Kuogang Pass were all jointly guarded by military and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the four-hundred chiliarchs had belonged to the Tengchong thousand-household station, and the five passes including Kuogang were garrisoned jointly by soldiers and civilians.

sentences.zh: 今四百夫已隸本州，止州民守之。

translations.literal: Now the four-hundred chiliarchs are subordinate to this prefecture, and only prefectural civilians guard them.
translations.idiomatic: Now the four-hundred chiliarchs answered to the prefecture itself, and only civilian militia guarded the passes.

sentences.zh: 乞於五處置巡檢司，以土軍尹黑、張保、李輔、郭節等為巡檢。

translations.literal: They requested that inspectorates be established at the five places, with native soldiers Yin Hei, Zhang Bao, Li Fu, Guo Jie, and others as inspectors.
translations.idiomatic: They asked that inspectorates be established at all five passes, with the native soldiers Yin Hei, Zhang Bao, Li Fu, Guo Jie, and others as inspectors.

sentences.zh: 正統二年以非額革之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengtong they were abolished as beyond the quota.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhengtong they were abolished as extrastatutory posts.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年復設永昌軍民府。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiajing Yongchang Military-Civilian Prefecture was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiajing Yongchang Military-Civilian Prefecture was restored.

sentences.zh: 領州一、縣二。

translations.literal: It governed one subprefecture and two counties.
translations.idiomatic: It governed one subprefecture and two counties.

sentences.zh: 其長官司二，曰施甸，曰鳳溪。

translations.literal: Its native official prefectures numbered two: Shidian and Fengxi.
translations.idiomatic: It had two native official prefectures: Shidian and Fengxi.

sentences.zh: 新化，本馬龍、他郎二甸，阿僰諸部蠻據之。

translations.literal: Xinhua originally comprised the two districts of Malong and Talang, occupied by tribes of the A-Bo and other groups.
translations.idiomatic: Xinhua was originally the districts of Malong and Talang, held by the A-Bo and other tribal peoples.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗時內附，立為二千戶所，隸寧州萬戶府。

translations.literal: In the time of Yuan Shizu they submitted inward and were established as a two-thousand-household station, subordinate to Ningzhou Ten-thousand-household Office.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yuan Shizu they submitted to the dynasty and were organized as a two-thousand-household station under the Ningzhou ten-thousand-household office.

sentences.zh: 至元間，以馬龍等甸管民官並於他郎甸，置司，隸元江路。

translations.literal: In the Zhiyuan era the Malong and other districts' civilian administrators were merged into Talang District, an office was established, subordinate to Yuanjiang Route.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhiyuan era the civilian administrators of Malong and the other districts were merged into Talang District under a single office subordinate to Yuanjiang Route.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，改名馬龍他郎甸長官司，直隸雲南布政司。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu it was renamed the Malong Talang Native Official Prefecture, directly subordinate to the Yunnan Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Hongwu it was renamed the Malong Talang native official prefecture and placed directly under the Yunnan Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 後升為新化州。

translations.literal: Later it was promoted to Xinhua Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It was later promoted to Xinhua Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 十七年以普賜為馬龍他郎甸副長官。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Pu Ci was made vice prefect of Malong Talang Native Official Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Pu Ci was appointed vice prefect of the Malong Talang native official prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宣德八年，故長官普賜弟土舍普寧等來朝，貢馬，賜鈔幣。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xuande the former prefect Pu Ci's younger brother the native clerk Pu Ning and others came to court, presented horses, and were granted paper money.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Xuande Pu Ning, younger brother of the former prefect Pu Ci, came to court with horses as tribute and was rewarded with paper money.

sentences.zh: 八月，黔國公沐晟奏，摩沙勒寨萬夫長刀甕及弟刀眷糾蠻兵侵占馬龍他郎甸長官司衙門，殺掠人民，請遣都督同知沐昂討之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Duke of Qinguo Mu Sheng memorialized that the Moshele Stockade myriarch Dao Weng and his younger brother Dao Juan had gathered tribal troops to seize the yamen of the Malong Talang Native Official Prefecture, killing and plundering the people; he requested that Vice Commissioner-in-chief Mu Ang be dispatched to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Duke of Qinguo, Mu Sheng, reported that Dao Weng, myriarch of Moshele Stockade, and his brother Dao Juan had raised tribal troops, seized the yamen of the Malong Talang native official prefecture, and killed and plundered the populace; he asked that Vice Commissioner-in-chief Mu Ang be sent against them.

sentences.zh: 帝命遣人撫諭，但得刀甕，毋擾平民。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered envoys sent to pacify and instruct them, but only to get Dao Weng, and not to disturb civilians.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered envoys to negotiate with them, targeting only Dao Weng and forbidding harm to civilians.

sentences.zh: 正統二年，晟等奏甕不服招撫，請調附近官土兵，令都督昂剿捕。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengtong Sheng and others memorialized that Weng would not submit to persuasion and requested nearby appointed and native troops be mobilized and Commissioner Ang ordered to suppress and capture him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhengtong Mu Sheng and others reported that Dao Weng had refused persuasion and asked that nearby Han and native troops be mobilized for Mu Ang to capture him.

sentences.zh: 帝以蠻眾仇殺乃其本性，可仍撫諭之，事遂不竟。

translations.literal: The emperor held that mutual slaughter among tribes was their nature, and they could still be persuaded; the matter then came to nothing.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ruled that feuding among tribes was their nature and ordered continued persuasion; the affair was therefore never pursued to the end.

sentences.zh: 其地有馬龍諸山，居摩沙勒江右。

translations.literal: The place has the Malong Mountains and lies on the right bank of the Moshele River.
translations.idiomatic: The district includes the Malong Mountains and lies on the east bank of the Moshele River.

sentences.zh: 兩岸束隘如峽，地勢極險，故改州以鎮之。

translations.literal: Both banks are narrow and confined like a gorge; the terrain is extremely perilous; therefore it was changed to a subprefecture to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: The river runs through a gorge with steep banks on both sides; because the terrain was so perilous, the district was promoted to a subprefecture to hold it.

sentences.zh: 威遠，唐南詔銀生府地，舊為濮落雜蠻所居。

translations.literal: Weiyuan was the land of the Yinsheng Prefecture of Tang Nanzhao, formerly inhabited by mixed tribes of the Pu and Luo.
translations.idiomatic: Weiyuan had been the domain of Yinsheng Prefecture under Tang Nanzhao and was formerly home to mixed Pu and Luo tribes.

sentences.zh: 大理時，為百夷所據。

translations.literal: In Dali times it was seized by the Baiyi.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Dali kingdom it was held by the Baiyi.

sentences.zh: 元至元中，置威遠州。

translations.literal: In the middle of Yuan's Zhiyuan era Weiyuan Subprefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the mid-Zhiyuan period of the Yuan dynasty Weiyuan Subprefecture was established.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年平雲南後，改威遠蠻棚府為威遠州。

translations.literal: After Yunnan was pacified in the fifteenth year of Hongwu, Weiyuan Barbarian Stockade Prefecture was changed to Weiyuan Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After Yunnan was pacified in the fifteenth year of Hongwu, the Weiyuan tribal stockade prefecture was redesignated Weiyuan Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，以土官刀算黨為威遠知州。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year the native official Dao Suandang was made Prefect of Weiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year the native official Dao Suandang was appointed prefect of Weiyuan.

sentences.zh: 永樂二年，算黨為車裏所擄，奪其地，命西平侯諭之，乃還算黨並侵地。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongle Suandang was captured by Cheli, which seized his territory; the Prince of Xiping was ordered to instruct them, and they then returned Suandang together with the encroached land.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongle, Suandang was taken captive by Cheli, which seized his territory. The Prince of Xiping was sent to admonish them, and Cheli restored Suandang along with the land it had taken.

sentences.zh: 三年，算黨進象馬方物謝，頒降敕諭金字紅牌，賜之金帶、織金文綺、襲衣及銀鈔、錦幣。

translations.literal: In the third year Suandang presented elephants, horses, and local products in thanks; an imperial edict of instruction and red plaques inscribed with golden characters were issued, and he was granted a gold belt, brocade woven with gold patterns, ceremonial robes, paper money, and brocade goods.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Suandang brought elephants, horses, and local tribute in gratitude. The court issued an instructive edict and red plaques lettered in gold, and granted him a gold belt, gold-woven brocade, ceremonial robes, paper money, and brocade goods.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，土官刀慶罕等來朝，貢馬及方物，賜慶罕鈔八十錠，纻絲、羅紗，及頭目以下，皆有加。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year the native official Dao Qinghan and others came to court, presenting horses and local products; Qinghan was granted eighty ingots of paper money, ramie silk, and gauze, and those below the headmen all received additional rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year the native official Dao Qinghan and others came to court with horses and local tribute. Qinghan received eighty ingots of paper money, ramie silk, and gauze; the headmen and their subordinates were all given extra rewards.

sentences.zh: 宣德三年，刀慶罕遣頭目招剛、刀著中等來貢，賜予如例，就令賫敕及織金纻絲、紗羅賜之，仍給信符、勘合底簿。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuande Dao Qinghan sent the headmen Zhaogang and Dao Zhuzhong and others to present tribute; rewards were granted according to precedent, and they were at once ordered to carry back an edict along with ramie silk woven with gold and gauze and silk to grant him, and credential tablets and register booklets were again issued.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xuande, Dao Qinghan sent the headmen Zhaogang and Dao Zhuzhong and others to present tribute. They were rewarded according to precedent and instructed to carry back an edict with gold-woven ramie silk, gauze, and silk for him; credential tablets and tally registers were issued again.

sentences.zh: 八年，威遠州奏其地與車裏接境，累被各土官劫掠，播孟實當要沖，乞置巡檢司，以把事劉禧為巡檢，從之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Weiyuan Subprefecture memorialized that its territory bordered Cheli and had repeatedly been plundered by various native officials; Bo Meng was truly at a strategic choke point, and they requested that an inspection station be established, with the baoshi Liu Xi as inspector; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Weiyuan reported that its land bordered Cheli and had suffered repeated raids by native chiefs. Bo Meng lay on a vital pass, and the subprefecture asked that an inspection station be established under the baoshi Liu Xi. The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 正統二年，土知州刀蓋罕遣人貢馬及銀器，賜彩幣等物，並以新信符給之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengtong the native subprefect Dao Gaihan sent men to present horses and silver vessels; colored silks and other goods were granted, and new credential tablets were issued to him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhengtong the native subprefect Dao Gaihan sent tribute of horses and silver vessels. He received colored silks and other gifts, along with new credential tablets.

sentences.zh: 正統六年給威遠土知州刀蓋罕金牌，命合兵剿麓川叛寇，以捷聞。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhengtong a gold plaque was issued to Weiyuan native subprefect Dao Gaihan, who was ordered to join forces in suppressing the Luchuan rebels; his victory was reported.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Zhengtong a gold plaque was issued to Weiyuan's native subprefect Dao Gaihan, who was ordered to combine troops against the Luchuan rebels. News of his victory was received.

sentences.zh: 敕曰：「叛寇思任發侵爾境土，脅爾從逆。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The rebel Si Renfa invaded your territory and coerced you into rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: An edict read: "The rebel Si Renfa invaded your lands and forced you to join his revolt.

sentences.zh: 爾母招曩猛能秉大義，效忠朝廷，悉出金貲，分賚頭目。

translations.literal: Your mother Zhao Nangmeng upheld the great principle, loyally served the court, spent all her gold, and distributed rewards among the headmen.
translations.idiomatic: Your mother Zhao Nangmeng held to the greater duty, remained loyal to the throne, spent her gold freely, and distributed rewards among your headmen.

sentences.zh: 爾母子躬擐甲胄，賈勇殺賊，斬其頭目派罕，追逐余賊過江，溺死數千，斬首數百，得其戰艦戰象，仍留兵守賊所據江口地。

translations.literal: You mother and son personally donned armor, mustered courage to kill the enemy, beheaded their chieftain Paihan, pursued the remaining rebels across the river—thousands drowned, hundreds were beheaded; you captured their warships and war elephants and left troops to hold the river mouth the rebels had occupied.
translations.idiomatic: You and your mother yourselves buckled on armor, took the lead in battle, and slew the enemy. You cut down their chieftain Paihan, drove the survivors across the river—thousands drowned and hundreds were beheaded—and seized their warships and war elephants, then garrisoned the river mouth the rebels had held.

sentences.zh: 忠義卓然，深足嘉尚。

translations.literal: Your loyalty and righteousness were outstanding and truly merit high praise.
translations.idiomatic: Such loyalty and righteousness were conspicuous and richly deserving of praise.

sentences.zh: 今特升爾正五品，授奉政大夫、修正庶尹，封爾母為太宜人，俱錫誥命、銀帶及彩幣表裏，酬爾母子勛勞。

translations.literal: Now you are specially promoted to the fifth rank, appointed Grand Mentor for Supporting Governance and Rectifying Vice Minister of the Masses; your mother is enfeoffed as Grand Lady of Easy Grace; both of you receive patent letters of appointment, silver belts, and colored silks for outer and inner garments, in reward for your mother and son's meritorious service.
translations.idiomatic: Now you are specially raised to the fifth rank as Grand Mentor for Supporting Governance and Rectifying Vice Minister of the Masses, and your mother is enfeoffed as Grand Lady of Easy Grace. Patent letters, silver belts, and sets of colored silks are bestowed upon you both in reward for your service.

sentences.zh: 陶孟、刀孟經等亦賜賚有差。

translations.literal: Tao Meng, Dao Mengjing, and others also received rewards in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Meng, Dao Mengjing, and others were also rewarded, each according to his deserts.

sentences.zh: 爾宜益勉忠義，以副朕懷。」

translations.literal: You should further exert yourselves in loyalty and righteousness to fulfill my expectations."
translations.idiomatic: Press on still further in loyalty and righteousness, that you may answer what I hope of you."

sentences.zh: 時西南諸部多相仇殺，所給金牌、信符，燒毀不存。

translations.literal: At the time the southwestern departments were much engaged in mutual vendettas, and the gold plaques and credential tablets that had been issued were burned and destroyed, none remaining.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the southwestern tribes were locked in feuds, and the gold plaques and credential tablets previously issued had been burned and lost.

sentences.zh: 景泰六年，刀蓋罕、隨乃吾等來朝貢，因命其管屬本州人民，復給與金牌、信符、織金文綺，賜敕諭遣之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Jingtai Dao Gaihan, Sui Naiwu, and others came to court with tribute; they were ordered to govern the people of their subprefecture, were again given gold plaques, credential tablets, and brocade woven with gold patterns, and dismissed with an instructive edict.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Jingtai, Dao Gaihan, Sui Naiwu, and others came to court with tribute. They were confirmed in authority over the people of their subprefecture, given fresh gold plaques, credential tablets, and gold-woven brocade, and sent home under an instructive edict.

sentences.zh: 成化元年，威遠州土舍刀朔罕遣頭目刀昔思貢象馬並金銀器，賜予如例。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chenghua Weiyuan native chieftain Dao Shuohan sent the headman Dao Xisi to present elephants, horses, and gold and silver vessels; rewards were granted according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chenghua the Weiyuan native chieftain Dao Shuohan sent the headman Dao Xisi with elephants, horses, and gold and silver vessels. He was rewarded according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 其俗勇健，男女走險如飛。

translations.literal: Their custom is martial vigor; men and women traverse perilous terrain as if flying.
translations.idiomatic: By custom they are fierce and hardy; men and women cross dangerous ground as swiftly as birds in flight.

sentences.zh: 境內有河，汲水練炭上即成鹽。

translations.literal: Within the territory is a river; water drawn from it and poured over fired charcoal becomes salt.
translations.idiomatic: A river runs through the district; water taken from it and poured over burning charcoal turns to salt.

sentences.zh: 無秤鬥，以簍計多寡量之。

translations.literal: They have no scales or dry measures; quantities are reckoned by basket.
translations.idiomatic: They use no scales or bushel measures, counting goods instead by the basket.

sentences.zh: 北勝，唐貞元中，南詔異牟尋始開其地，名北方睒，徙瀰河白蠻及羅落、麽些諸蠻，以實其地，號成偈睒，又改名善巨郡。

translations.literal: Beisheng: in the Zhenyuan era of Tang, Nanzhao's Yi Muxun first opened the region, naming it Northern Fang shan; Mihe White Barbarians and the Luo, Lao, and Mosuo tribes were relocated to populate it; it was called Chengji shan, then renamed Shanjun Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Beisheng: in the Zhenyuan reign of Tang, Yi Muxun of Nanzhao first opened the area, calling it Beifang shan. Mihe White tribes and the Luo, Lao, and Mosuo peoples were moved in to settle the land. The place was styled Chengji shan and later renamed Shanjun Commandery.

sentences.zh: 宋時，大理段氏改為成紀鎮。

translations.literal: In Song times the Dali Duan clan changed it to Chengji Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Dali kingdom the Duan clan redesignated it Chengji Garrison.

sentences.zh: 元初，內附。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuan it submitted.
translations.idiomatic: At the outset of the Yuan dynasty it submitted to the throne.

sentences.zh: 至元中，置施州，尋改北勝州。

translations.literal: In the Zhiyuan era Shizhou was established, soon renamed Beisheng Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhiyuan period Shizhou was established and soon renamed Beisheng Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 後為府，隸麗江路軍民宣撫司。

translations.literal: Later it became a prefecture, subordinate to the Lijiang Circuit Military-Civilian Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: It was later made a prefecture under the Lijiang Circuit Military-Civilian Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年改為州，隸鶴慶府，後屬瀾滄衛。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu it was changed to a subprefecture, subordinate to Heqing Prefecture; later it came under Lancang Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu it was reduced to a subprefecture under Heqing Prefecture and later placed under Lancang Guard.

sentences.zh: 永樂五年，土官百夫長楊克即牙舊來貢馬，賜鈔幣。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongle the native centurion Yang Kejiyayou came to present horses and was granted paper money.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Yongle the native centurion Yang Kejiyayou presented horses at court and received paper money.

sentences.zh: 宣德四年，土判官高琳子瑛來貢方物，請襲父職。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xuande the native vice-director Gao Lin's son Ying came to present local products and requested to succeed to his father's post.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xuande Gao Ying, son of the native vice-director Gao Lin, brought local tribute and asked to inherit his father's office.

sentences.zh: 十年，土知府高瑛來朝貢，賜鈔幣。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the native prefect Gao Ying came to court with tribute and was granted paper money.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the native prefect Gao Ying came to court with tribute and was given paper money.

sentences.zh: 正統七年，以北勝州直隸雲南布政司，設流官吏目一員，以州蠻苦於瀾滄衛官軍侵漁也。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhengtong Beisheng Subprefecture was placed directly under the Yunnan Provincial Administration Commission and one appointed clerical officer was established, because the tribes of the subprefecture suffered from depredations by troops of Lancang Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Zhengtong Beisheng was placed directly under the Yunnan Provincial Administration Commission and given one appointed clerical officer, because its tribes suffered extortion from the garrison troops of Lancang Guard.

sentences.zh: 萬歷四十八年，北勝州土同知高世懋死，異母弟世昌襲。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year of Wanli Beisheng native vice-prefect Gao Shimao died; his younger half-brother Shichang succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year of Wanli the Beisheng native vice-prefect Gao Shimao died, and his younger half-brother Shichang inherited the post.

sentences.zh: 其族侄蘭妄稱世昌奸生，訟之官，不聽。

translations.literal: His clansman Lan falsely claimed Shichang was illegitimate and sued at court; the suit was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: His clansman Lan falsely declared that Shichang was born out of wedlock and brought suit before the authorities, but the case was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 世昌懼逼，走麗江避之。

translations.literal: Shichang, fearing persecution, fled to Lijiang to escape.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing coercion, Shichang fled to Lijiang for refuge.

sentences.zh: 尋還至瀾滄，宿客舍，蘭圍而縱火，殺其家七十余人，發其祖父墓，自稱欽授把總，大掠。

translations.literal: Soon after he returned to Lancang and lodged at an inn; Lan surrounded it and set fire, killing more than seventy of his family, exhuming his grandfather's tomb, declaring himself an imperially appointed company commander, and looting extensively.
translations.idiomatic: He soon returned to Lancang and stayed at an inn. Lan besieged the place and set it ablaze, killing more than seventy members of his household, desecrating his grandfather's tomb, proclaiming himself an imperially commissioned company commander, and launching a great raid.

sentences.zh: 麗江知府木增請討之，謂法紀弁髦，尾大不掉，不治將有隱憂。

translations.literal: Lijiang prefect Mu Zeng requested a punitive expedition, declaring that law and discipline were treated like cast-off caps and feathers, that the tail had grown too large to control, and that if left unchecked hidden troubles would follow.
translations.idiomatic: Lijiang prefect Mu Zeng asked for a punitive campaign, arguing that law and discipline had been flouted, that local power had grown beyond control, and that unchecked violence would breed deeper trouble.

sentences.zh: 上官嘉其義，調增率其部進剿，獲蘭梟之。

translations.literal: The superior praised his righteousness, ordered Mu Zeng to lead his troops in pursuit, captured Lan, and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: The superior commended his loyalty and ordered Mu Zeng to lead his forces against Lan, who was captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 灣甸，蠻名細睒。

translations.literal: Wandian—the tribal name is Xi shan.
translations.idiomatic: Wandian—the native name is Xi shan.

sentences.zh: 元中統初，內附，屬鎮康路。

translations.literal: In the early Zhongtong era of Yuan it submitted and was placed under Zhenkang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Zhongtong period of Yuan it submitted and was attached to Zhenkang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武十七年置灣甸縣。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Hongwu Wandian County was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Hongwu Wandian County was created.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年三月設灣甸長官司，以西平侯沐晟奏地近麓川，地廣人稠故也。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Yongle the Wandian Native Official Prefecture was established, because the Prince of Xiping Mu Sheng memorialized that the land was near Luchuan and both broad and densely populated.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the first year of Yongle the Wandian native official prefecture was established after the Prince of Xiping, Mu Sheng, reported that the region lay close to Luchuan and was both extensive and thickly settled.

sentences.zh: 尋仍改為灣甸州，以土官刀景發為知州，給印章、金牌並置流官吏目一員。

translations.literal: It was soon changed again to Wandian Subprefecture, with the native official Dao Jingfa as subprefect; a seal, gold plaque, and one appointed clerical officer were provided.
translations.idiomatic: It was soon redesignated Wandian Subprefecture under the native official Dao Jingfa, who received a seal and gold plaque; one appointed clerical officer was also posted there.

sentences.zh: 四年，帝以灣甸道里險遠，每歲朝貢，令自今三年一貢，著為令。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the emperor, noting that Wandian's route was perilous and distant and that tribute came every year, ordered that from then on tribute be presented once every three years, establishing this as a regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the emperor, finding Wandian's route long and dangerous and its yearly tribute burdensome, decreed that tribute should henceforth be presented once every three years, making this the standing rule.

sentences.zh: 如慶賀、謝恩之類，不拘此例。

translations.literal: Occasions such as congratulatory offerings and thanksgiving were not bound by this rule.
translations.idiomatic: Occasions such as congratulations or expressions of gratitude were exempt from this rule.

sentences.zh: 六年，刀景發遣人來朝，貢馬及方物，賜鈔幣。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Dao Jingfa sent men to court, presenting horses and local products; paper money was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Dao Jingfa sent envoys to court with horses and local tribute, and they received paper money.

sentences.zh: 七年，刀景發子景懸等來朝，貢馬，賜予如例。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Dao Jingfa's son Jingxuan and others came to court, presenting horses; rewards were granted according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Dao Jingfa's son Jingxuan and others came to court with horses and were rewarded according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 宣德八年以土官刀景項弟景辦法繼兄職。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xuande the native official Dao Jingxiang's younger brother Jingbanfa succeeded to his brother's post.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Xuande the native official Dao Jingxiang's younger brother Jingbanfa inherited his brother's office.

sentences.zh: 州有流官吏目一員。

translations.literal: The subprefecture had one appointed clerical officer.
translations.idiomatic: The subprefecture maintained one appointed clerical officer.

sentences.zh: 州鄰木邦、順寧，日以侵削。

translations.literal: The subprefecture bordered Mu Bang and Shunning and suffered daily encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: Bordering Mu Bang and Shunning, the subprefecture saw its territory whittled away day by day.

sentences.zh: 成化五年，灣甸州土官舍人景拙法遣使刀胡猛等來朝，貢象馬並金銀器，賜宴並衣服彩幣有差。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chenghua Wandian native chieftain Jingzhuofa sent the envoys Dao Humeng and others to court, presenting elephants, horses, and gold and silver vessels; a banquet was given and clothing and colored silks granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Chenghua the Wandian native chieftain Jingzhuofa sent Dao Humeng and others to court with elephants, horses, and gold and silver vessels. They were feasted and given clothing and colored silks according to rank.

sentences.zh: 萬歷十一年，土官景宗真率弟宗材導木邦叛賊罕虔入寇姚關，宗真死於陣，擒宗材斬之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Wanli the native official Jing Zongzhen led his younger brother Zongcai in guiding the Mu Bang rebel Han Qian to invade Yao Pass; Zongzhen died in battle, Zongcai was captured and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Wanli the native official Jing Zongzhen and his brother Zongcai guided the Mu Bang rebel Han Qian in an attack on Yao Pass. Zongzhen fell in battle; Zongcai was captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 景真子幼，貸死，降為州判官。

translations.literal: Jing Zhen's son was young; his death was commuted, and he was demoted to subprefecture vice-director.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Zhen's son was still a child; his sentence was commuted and he was reduced to subprefecture vice-director.

sentences.zh: 後從討猛廷瑞有功，復舊職。

translations.literal: Later, for meritorious service in the campaign against Meng Tingrui, his former post was restored.
translations.idiomatic: He later earned merit in the campaign against Meng Tingrui and was restored to his former office.

sentences.zh: 灣甸地多瘴。

translations.literal: Wandian's land is much afflicted by miasma.
translations.idiomatic: Much of Wandian's territory is malarial.

sentences.zh: 有黑泉，漲時，飛鳥過之輒墮。

translations.literal: There is a Black Spring; when it rises, birds flying over it invariably fall.
translations.idiomatic: There is a Black Spring whose fumes are so poisonous that birds passing overhead when it swells drop dead.

sentences.zh: 鎮康，蠻名石睒，本黑僰所居。

translations.literal: Zhenkang—the tribal name is Shi shan, originally inhabited by the Hebo.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenkang—the native name is Shi shan, originally the home of the Hebo people.

sentences.zh: 元中統初，內附。

translations.literal: In the early Zhongtong era of Yuan it submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Zhongtong period of Yuan it submitted to the throne.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年立鎮康路軍民總管府，領三甸。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan the Zhenkang Circuit Military-Civilian Chief Office was established, governing three districts.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of the Zhiyuan era the Zhenkang Circuit Military-Civilian Chief Office was established, administering three districts.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年，改為鎮康府，十七年改為州。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu it was changed to Zhenkang Prefecture; in the seventeenth year to a subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu it became Zhenkang Prefecture; in the seventeenth year it was reduced to a subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 永樂二年遣官頒信符及金字紅牌於鎮康州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongle officials were dispatched to issue credential tablets and red plaques with golden characters to Zhenkang Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongle officials were sent to deliver credential tablets and gold-lettered red plaques to Zhenkang Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 七年以灣甸同知曩光為知州。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the Wandian vice-prefect Nang Guang was made subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the Wandian vice-prefect Nang Guang was appointed subprefect of Zhenkang.

sentences.zh: 初，鎮康地隸灣甸，曩光請增設署所，故有是命。

translations.literal: Initially Zhenkang territory was subordinate to Wandian; Nang Guang requested an additional administrative post, hence this appointment.
translations.idiomatic: At first Zhenkang had been under Wandian; Nang Guang petitioned for a separate administrative seat, which led to this appointment.

sentences.zh: 九年以中官徐亮使西南蠻，曩光阻道，詔責之，至是，遣人來朝謝罪。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the eunuch Xu Liang was sent as envoy to the southwestern tribes; Nang Guang blocked the road, was rebuked by imperial edict, and now sent men to court to apologize.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the eunuch Xu Liang was dispatched on a mission to the southwestern tribes. Nang Guang obstructed the route, was rebuked by imperial edict, and now sent envoys to court to submit his apology.

sentences.zh: 十四年，鎮康州長官司遣人貢馬，賜鈔幣。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the Zhenkang Native Official Prefecture sent men to present horses; paper money was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year the Zhenkang native official prefecture sent tribute horses and received paper money.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，知府刀孟廣來朝，貢馬。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the prefect Dao Mengguang came to court and presented horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year the prefect Dao Mengguang came to court with horses.

sentences.zh: 宣德三年賜鎮康州土目刀門淵等鈔幣有差。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuande the Zhenkang native headmen Dao Menyuan and others were granted paper money in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xuande the Zhenkang native headmen Dao Menyuan and others received paper money in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 成化五年，知州刀門戛遣使貢馬及金銀器，賜予如例，及妻。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chenghua subprefect Dao Menge sent envoys to present horses and gold and silver vessels; rewards were granted according to precedent, including to his wife.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Chenghua subprefect Dao Menge sent envoys with horses and gold and silver vessels. Rewards were granted according to precedent, including gifts for his wife.

sentences.zh: 鎮康後亦為木邦、順寧所侵削。

translations.literal: Zhenkang was likewise later encroached upon by Mu Bang and Shunning.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenkang, too, was later stripped of territory by Mu Bang and Shunning.

sentences.zh: 隆慶間，知州悶坎者，罕虔妻以女，因附虔歸緬。

translations.literal: During the Longqing reign subprefect Menkanzhe received Han Qian's daughter in marriage and thereby joined Qian in submitting to Burma.
translations.idiomatic: During the Longqing reign subprefect Menkanzhe married Han Qian's daughter and, through that tie, followed Qian in submitting to Burma.

sentences.zh: 坎敗死，其弟悶恩歸義。

translations.literal: Kan was defeated and died; his younger brother Men'en returned to allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Kan was defeated and killed; his younger brother Men'en returned to the imperial fold.

sentences.zh: 恩死，子悶枳襲，木邦思禮誘之歸緬，不從。

translations.literal: When En died, his son Menzhi succeeded; Si Li of Mu Bang tried to entice him back to Burma, but he refused.
translations.idiomatic: After En's death his son Menzhi inherited the post. Si Li of Mu Bang tried to lure him back to Burma, but he would not go.

sentences.zh: 天啟二年，木邦兵據喳哩江，枳奔姚關，守備遣官撫之，乃退。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianqi Mu Bang troops occupied Zhali River; Zhi fled to Yao Pass; the garrison commander sent an official to pacify him, and the troops withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianqi Mu Bang forces seized the Zhali River. Menzhi fled to Yao Pass; the garrison commander sent an official to reassure him, and the invaders withdrew.

sentences.zh: 大侯，蠻名孟祐，百夷所居。

translations.literal: Dahou—the tribal name is Mengyou, inhabited by the Baiyi.
translations.idiomatic: Dahou—the native name is Mengyou, home to the Baiyi peoples.

sentences.zh: 元中統初內附，屬麓川路。

translations.literal: In the early Zhongtong era of Yuan it submitted and was placed under Luchuan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Zhongtong period of Yuan it submitted and was attached to Luchuan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武二十四年置大侯長官司。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Hongwu the Dahou Native Official Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year of Hongwu the Dahou native official prefecture was established.

sentences.zh: 永樂二年頒給信符、金字紅牌。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongle credential tablets and red plaques with golden characters were issued.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongle credential tablets and gold-lettered red plaques were issued.

sentences.zh: 三年，大侯長官司長官刀奉偶遣子刀奉董貢馬及銀器，賜鈔幣。

translations.literal: In the third year the Dahou native official prefect Dao Feng'ou sent his son Dao Fengdong to present horses and silver vessels; paper money was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the Dahou native prefect Dao Feng'ou sent his son Dao Fengdong with horses and silver vessels; paper money was granted.

sentences.zh: 六年，長官刀奉偶遣弟不納狂來貢，賜予如例。

translations.literal: In the sixth year prefect Dao Feng'ou sent his younger brother Bunakuang to present tribute; rewards were granted according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Dao Feng'ou sent his younger brother Bunakuang with tribute, and rewards were granted according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 宣德四年升大侯長官司為大侯州，以土官刀奉漢為知州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xuande the Dahou Native Official Prefecture was promoted to Dahou Subprefecture, with the native official Dao Fenghan as subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xuande the Dahou native official prefecture was elevated to Dahou Subprefecture under the native official Dao Fenghan.

sentences.zh: 時刀奉漢奏：「大侯蠻民復業者多，歲納差發銀二百五十兩。

translations.literal: At the time Dao Fenghan memorialized: "Many of Dahou's tribal people have returned to their occupations; each year two hundred and fifty taels of silver are paid in lieu of corvée.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Dao Fenghan memorialized: "Many of Dahou's tribespeople have returned to their fields; the district pays two hundred and fifty taels of silver yearly in lieu of corvée labor.

sentences.zh: 灣甸、鎮康二長官民少，歲納差發銀各百兩，永樂中俱升為州，乞援二州例。

translations.literal: Wandian and Zhenkang, the two native official prefectures, have fewer people and each pay one hundred taels of silver yearly in lieu of corvée; both were promoted to subprefectures in Yongle; I beg to cite their precedent."
translations.idiomatic: Wandian and Zhenkang, though once native official prefectures with smaller populations, each paid one hundred taels yearly and were both raised to subprefectures in Yongle. I ask that the same precedent be applied to Dahou."

sentences.zh: 」帝諭吏部曰：「大侯民多復業，亦其長官善撫綏也，宜增秩旌之。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed the Ministry of Personnel: "Many of Dahou's people have returned to their occupations—this too is because their prefect has governed well; his rank should be raised to honor him."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the Ministry of Personnel: "That so many of Dahou's people have returned to their livelihoods reflects their prefect's good governance. His rank should be raised as a mark of honor."

sentences.zh: 」故有是命。

translations.literal: Hence this order was issued.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the promotion.

sentences.zh: 八年，大侯州入貢，遣內官雲仙往撫之，並賜錦綺有差。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Dahou Subprefecture presented tribute; the eunuch Yun Xian was sent to pacify them, and brocades were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Dahou presented tribute. The eunuch Yun Xian was dispatched to reassure the district, and brocades were granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 正統三年，土官刀奉漢子刀奉送來貢，命賫敕並織金文綺絨錦諸物，賜刀奉漢並及其妻。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhengtong the native official Dao Fenghan's son Dao Fengsong came to present tribute; he was ordered to carry back an edict along with brocades woven with gold, velvet, and brocade, to be granted to Dao Fenghan and his wife.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhengtong Dao Fenghan's son Dao Fengsong came with tribute. He was instructed to carry back an edict and gold-woven brocades, velvet, and silk for Dao Fenghan and his wife.

sentences.zh: 初，奉漢令把事傅永瑤來朝，貢馬，奏欲與木邦宣慰罕門法共起土兵十萬，協同征剿麓川，乞賜金牌、信符，以安民心。

translations.literal: Earlier Fenghan had sent the baoshi Fu Yongyao to court to present horses and report that he wished to raise one hundred thousand native troops jointly with Mu Bang Pacification Commissioner Han Menfa to campaign against Luchuan, requesting gold plaques and credential tablets to reassure the people.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Fenghan had sent the baoshi Fu Yongyao to court with horses, reporting that he wished to raise one hundred thousand native troops together with Mu Bang Pacification Commissioner Han Menfa to strike Luchuan, and asking for gold plaques and credential tablets to steady the people's hearts.

sentences.zh: 特賜之，復降敕嘉獎。

translations.literal: These were specially granted, and an edict of commendation was additionally issued.
translations.idiomatic: The request was specially granted, and a commendatory edict followed.

sentences.zh: 七年，敕刀奉漢子刀奉送襲大侯知州，賜冠帶、印章、彩段表裏，以奉送能率土兵助討麓川也。

translations.literal: In the seventh year an edict appointed Dao Fenghan's son Dao Fengsong to succeed as Dahou subprefect, granting him cap and belt, seal, and colored silk for outer and inner garments, because Fengsong had been able to lead native troops in assisting the campaign against Luchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year an edict confirmed Dao Fengsong as heir to the Dahou subprefectship, granting him cap and belt, a seal, and sets of colored silks, in recognition of his leadership of native troops against Luchuan.

sentences.zh: 十一年，大侯知州奉外法等貢銀器、象馬，賜彩幣、衣服有差。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Dahou subprefect Feng Waifa and others presented silver vessels, elephants, and horses; colored silks and clothing were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Dahou subprefect Feng Waifa and others brought silver vessels, elephants, and horses. Colored silks and garments were granted according to rank.

sentences.zh: 十二年敕賜大侯州奉敬法、刀奉送等並其妻彩幣，命來使賫與之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year an edict granted colored silks to Dahou Subprefecture's Feng Jingfa, Dao Fengsong, and others along with their wives, ordering the envoys to carry them back.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year an edict granted colored silks to Feng Jingfa, Dao Fengsong, and others of Dahou Subprefecture, together with their wives, and ordered the envoys to deliver them.

sentences.zh: 萬歷中，土目奉學婿於順寧知府猛廷瑞，後巡撫陳用賓誣奏廷瑞與學反狀，廷瑞斬奉學首以獻，學兄赦守大侯如故。

translations.literal: In the Wanli reign the native headman Feng Xue became son-in-law to Shunning prefect Meng Tingrui; later Grand Coordinator Chen Yongbin falsely reported that Tingrui and Xue were in rebellion; Tingrui beheaded Feng Xue and presented his head; Xue's elder brother was pardoned and continued to hold Dahou as before.
translations.idiomatic: During the Wanli reign the native headman Feng Xue married into the family of Shunning prefect Meng Tingrui. Later Grand Coordinator Chen Yongbin falsely accused Tingrui and Xue of rebellion. Tingrui beheaded Feng Xue and sent his head as proof; Xue's elder brother was pardoned and continued to hold Dahou as before.

sentences.zh: 子奉先與其族舍猛麻、奉恭爭殺抗命，次年討平之，改為雲州，設流官。

translations.literal: Feng Xue's son Feng Xian and his clansmen She Mengma and Feng Gong fought and killed in defiance of orders; the next year they were suppressed, and the district was changed to Yun Subprefecture with appointed officials.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Xue's son Feng Xian, together with his clansmen She Mengma and Feng Gong, feuded and killed in open defiance of authority. They were crushed the following year, and the district was reorganized as Yun Subprefecture under appointed officials.

sentences.zh: 瀾滄，元為北勝州地。

translations.literal: Lancang—in Yuan it was the territory of Beisheng Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Lancang—in Yuan times this was the territory of Beisheng Subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 洪武中，屬鶴慶府。

translations.literal: In the Hongwu reign it was subordinate to Heqing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: During the Hongwu reign it fell under Heqing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十八年置瀾滄衛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year Lancang Guard was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year Lancang Guard was established.

sentences.zh: 二十九年於州南築城，置今衛司。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year a wall was built south of the subprefecture and the present guard headquarters was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year a walled post was built south of the subprefecture and the present guard headquarters was installed.

sentences.zh: 領北勝、浪渠、永寧三州。

translations.literal: It governed Beisheng, Langqu, and Yongning subprefectures.
translations.idiomatic: It administered Beisheng, Langqu, and Yongning subprefectures.

sentences.zh: 永樂四年以永寧州升為府。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongle Yongning Subprefecture was promoted to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yongle Yongning Subprefecture was elevated to a prefecture.

sentences.zh: 正統七年以北勝州直隸布政司，今衛只領州一。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhengtong Beisheng Subprefecture was placed directly under the Provincial Administration Commission; the guard now governs only one subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Zhengtong Beisheng was placed directly under the Provincial Administration Commission, leaving the guard with only one subprefecture under its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 弘治十一年，福建布政李韶以前任雲南參議，知土俗事宜，上疏言四事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Hongzhi Fujian Provincial Administrator Li Shao, having previously served as Yunnan vice-censor and knowing tribal customs, submitted a memorial setting forth four matters.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Hongzhi Li Shao, provincial administrator of Fujian and former Yunnan vice-censor with firsthand knowledge of tribal affairs, submitted a memorial outlining four proposals.

sentences.zh: 一謂瀾滄衛與北勝州同一城，地域廣遠，與四川建昌西番野番相通。

translations.literal: First, he said that Lancang Guard and Beisheng Subprefecture share one walled city; the territory is broad and far-flung, and connects with the wild tribes of western Tibet in Jianchang, Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: First, he argued that Lancang Guard and Beisheng Subprefecture shared one walled city, that the region was vast and remote, and that it adjoined the wild tribes of western Tibet around Jianchang in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 邇年西番土舍章輗等倚恃山險，招服野番千余家為莊戶，遂致各番生拗，動輒殺人，州官無兵不能禁止。

translations.literal: In recent years the western Tibetan tushe Zhang Yi and others, relying on mountainous terrain, recruited and subjugated over a thousand households of wild tribes as estate tenants, causing the various tribes to become unruly and to kill people at the slightest provocation; the subprefecture officials had no troops and could not stop them.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the western Tibetan chieftain Zhang Yi and others, sheltered by the mountains, had brought more than a thousand wild tribal households under their control as estate tenants. The tribes grew defiant and killings became routine, while subprefecture officials lacked troops to stop them.

sentences.zh: 衛官大廢軍政，恬不加意。

translations.literal: The guard officers greatly neglected military administration and remained unconcerned.
translations.idiomatic: Guard officers had badly neglected military discipline and paid no heed.

sentences.zh: 又姚安府、大羅衛、賓川州地方有賊穴六七，軍民受害。

translations.literal: Moreover in the territory of Yao'an Prefecture, Daluo Guard, and Binchuan Subprefecture there were six or seven bandit lairs, and soldiers and civilians suffered harm.
translations.idiomatic: In Yao'an, Daluo Guard, and Binchuan there were six or seven bandit strongholds, and troops and civilians alike suffered.

sentences.zh: 請添設兵備副使於瀾滄衛城，以姚安、大羅、賓川、鶴麗、大理、洱海、景東諸府州衛所，皆令屬之。

translations.literal: He requested that a vice commissioner of military defense be added at Lancang Guard city, and that Yao'an, Daluo, Binchuan, Heli, Dali, Erhai, Jingdong, and other prefectures, subprefectures, guards, and posts all be placed under his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed establishing a vice commissioner of military defense at Lancang Guard city, with Yao'an, Daluo, Binchuan, Heli, Dali, Erhai, Jingdong, and the other prefectures, subprefectures, guards, and posts placed under his authority.

sentences.zh: 於野番則用撫流民法，於賊巢則用立保甲法，朝夕經理，則內外寇患皆可弭矣。

translations.literal: For wild tribes the law of settling displaced people should be applied; for bandit lairs the system of communal defense units should be established; managed morning and evening, then internal and external bandit threats could all be quelled.
translations.idiomatic: Wild tribes would be handled through settlement policy, bandit lairs through the communal defense system; with daily oversight, threats from within and without could be brought under control.

sentences.zh: 因從其議，設兵備副使一員於瀾滄城。

translations.literal: Accordingly his proposal was adopted, and one vice commissioner of military defense was established at Lancang city.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was accepted, and a vice commissioner of military defense was installed at Lancang.

sentences.zh: 麓川 平緬

translations.literal: Luchuan; Pingmian
translations.idiomatic: Luchuan and Pingmian

sentences.zh: 麓川、平緬，元時皆屬緬甸。

translations.literal: Luchuan and Pingmian—in Yuan times both belonged to Burma.
translations.idiomatic: Luchuan and Pingmian had both belonged to Burma under the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 緬甸，古朱波地也。

translations.literal: Burma is the ancient land of Zhupo.
translations.idiomatic: Burma was the ancient territory of Zhupo.

sentences.zh: 宋寧宗時，緬甸、波斯等國進白象，緬甸之名自此始。

translations.literal: In the reign of Emperor Ningzong of Song, Burma, Persia, and other states presented white elephants, and the name Burma began from this.
translations.idiomatic: During the reign of Song Emperor Ningzong, Burma, Persia, and other states sent white elephants as tribute, and the name Burma dates from this time.

sentences.zh: 緬在雲南之西南，最窮遠。

translations.literal: Burma lies southwest of Yunnan, the most remote of all.
translations.idiomatic: Burma lay farthest to the southwest of Yunnan, at the ends of the earth.

sentences.zh: 與八百國、占城接境。

translations.literal: It borders the state of Baiguo and Champa.
translations.idiomatic: It bordered Baiguo and Champa.

sentences.zh: 有城郭室屋，人皆樓居，地產象馬。

translations.literal: It has walled cities, houses, and dwellings; the people all live in elevated houses; the land produces elephants and horses.
translations.idiomatic: Its people lived in walled towns and raised houses on stilts; the region produced elephants and horses.

sentences.zh: 元時最強盛。

translations.literal: In Yuan times it was most powerful.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was at its strongest.

sentences.zh: 元嘗遣使招之，始入貢。

translations.literal: The Yuan once sent envoys to summon it, and only then did it begin paying tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan eventually sent envoys to summon it, after which it began submitting tribute.

sentences.zh: 洪武六年遣使田儼、程鬥南、張祎、錢允恭賫詔往諭。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Hongwu envoys Tian Yan, Cheng Dounan, Zhang Yi, and Qian Yonggong were sent carrying an edict to instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Hongwu Tian Yan, Cheng Dounan, Zhang Yi, and Qian Yonggong were dispatched with an imperial edict.

sentences.zh: 至安南，留二年，以道阻不通。

translations.literal: Reaching Annam, they remained two years because the route was blocked and impassable.
translations.idiomatic: They reached Annam and waited two years, the road blocked and impassable.

sentences.zh: 有詔召之，惟儼還，余皆道卒。

translations.literal: An edict summoned them back; only Yan returned, the rest all died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: An edict recalled them; only Yan returned—the rest died en route.

sentences.zh: 十五年，大兵下雲南，進以大理，下金齒。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the great army descended on Yunnan, advanced with Dali, and took Jinchi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year the imperial army swept into Yunnan, marched through Dali, and seized Jinchi.

sentences.zh: 平緬與金齒壤地相接，土蠻思倫發聞之懼，遂降。

translations.literal: Pingmian and Jinchi shared contiguous territory; the tribal chieftain Si Lunfa, hearing of this, was afraid and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Pingmian bordered Jinchi, and the tribal leader Si Lunfa, alarmed by the advance, surrendered.

sentences.zh: 因置平緬宣慰使司，以倫發為宣慰使。

translations.literal: Accordingly the Pingmian Pacification Commission was established, with Lunfa as pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The court established the Pingmian Pacification Commission and appointed Lunfa its commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十七年八月，倫發遣刀令孟獻方物，並上元所授宣慰使司印。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the seventeenth year Lunfa sent Dao Lingmeng to present local products and also surrendered the seal of the pacification commission granted by the Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the seventeenth year Lunfa sent Dao Lingmeng with local tribute and surrendered the Yuan-era pacification commission seal.

sentences.zh: 詔改平緬宣慰使為平緬軍民宣慰使司，並賜倫發朝服、冠帶及織金文綺、鈔錠。

translations.literal: An edict changed the Pingmian Pacification Commission into the Pingmian Military-Civilian Pacification Commission, and granted Lunfa court robes, cap and belt, gold-woven brocade, and ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: An edict reorganized the commission as the Pingmian Military-Civilian Pacification Commission and granted Lunfa court dress, cap and belt, gold-woven brocade, and paper money.

sentences.zh: 尋改平緬軍民宣慰使司為麓川平緬軍民宣慰使司。

translations.literal: Soon the Pingmian Military-Civilian Pacification Commission was changed to the Luchuan-Pingmian Military-Civilian Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: It was soon renamed the Luchuan-Pingmian Military-Civilian Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 麓川與平緬連境，元時分置兩路以統其所部，至是以倫發遣使貢，命兼統麓川之地。

translations.literal: Luchuan and Pingmian share a border; in Yuan times two circuits were separately established to govern their respective subordinates; at this time because Lunfa sent envoys with tribute, he was ordered to govern Luchuan territory as well.
translations.idiomatic: Luchuan and Pingmian adjoined each other; the Yuan had divided them into two circuits. Now, because Lunfa had sent tribute envoys, he was ordered to govern Luchuan as well.

sentences.zh: 十八年，倫發反，率眾寇景東。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Lunfa rebelled and led his followers to raid Jingdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Lunfa rebelled and led his forces against Jingdong.

sentences.zh: 都督馮誠率兵擊之，值天大霧，猝遇寇，失利，千戶王升戰死。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Feng Cheng led troops to attack him; encountering heavy fog, they suddenly met the bandits, suffered defeat, and chiliarch Wang Sheng died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Feng Cheng attacked him but ran into dense fog, was ambushed, and defeated; chiliarch Wang Sheng was killed.

sentences.zh: 二十年，敕諭西平侯沐英等曰：「近御史李原名歸自平緬，知蠻情詭譎，必為邊患。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year an edict instructed the Prince of Xiping Mu Ying and others, saying: "Recently Censor Li Yuanming returned from Pingmian and knows that tribal sentiment is treacherous and will surely become a border threat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year an edict addressed Mu Ying, Prince of Xiping, and others: "Censor Li Yuanming has just returned from Pingmian and reports that the tribes are treacherous and sure to menace the frontier.

sentences.zh: 符到，可即於金齒、楚雄、品甸及瀾滄江中道，葺壘深池，以固營柵，多置火銃為守備。

translations.literal: When the tally arrives, you may immediately at Jinchi, Chuxiong, Pindian, and along the middle route of the Lancang River repair ramparts and deep moats to strengthen camp palisades, and deploy many firearms as defensive preparations.
translations.idiomatic: "Once this order reaches you, fortify Jinchi, Chuxiong, Pindian, and the middle reaches of the Lancang with ramparts, moats, and palisades, and stock them heavily with firearms.

sentences.zh: 寇來。

translations.literal: When bandits come.
translations.idiomatic: "When the enemy attacks,

sentences.zh: 勿輕與戰。

translations.literal: Do not lightly engage them in battle.
translations.idiomatic: do not engage rashly.

sentences.zh: 又以往歲人至百夷，多貪其財貨，不顧事理，貽笑諸蠻。

translations.literal: Moreover in past years when people went to the Baiyi, many were greedy for their goods and property, heedless of propriety, making themselves a laughingstock among the tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Officials sent to the Baiyi have often been greedy for local goods and behaved disgracefully, making the court a laughingstock among the tribes.

sentences.zh: 繼今不許一人往平緬，即文移亦慎答之，毋忽。

translations.literal: From now on not one person is permitted to go to Pingmian; even for official correspondence reply cautiously—do not neglect this.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth no one is to enter Pingmian at all, and even written communications must be answered with care. Do not ignore this.

sentences.zh: 」明年，倫發誘群蠻入寇馬龍他郎甸之摩沙勒寨。

translations.literal: " The next year Lunfa incited the various tribes to raid the Moshaleshai stockade in Malong Talang Subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Lunfa incited allied tribes to attack the Moshaleshai stockade in Malong Talang.

sentences.zh: 英遣都督寧正擊破之，斬首千五百余級。

translations.literal: Ying dispatched Regional Commander Ning Zheng to defeat them, beheading more than fifteen hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Ying sent Regional Commander Ning Zheng, who routed them and took more than fifteen hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 倫發悉舉其眾，號三十萬，象百余，寇定邊，欲報摩沙勒之役，新附諸蠻皆為盡力。

translations.literal: Lunfa mustered all his followers, claiming three hundred thousand men and more than a hundred elephants, and raided Dingbian to avenge the Moshaleshai campaign; all the newly submitted tribes exerted themselves fully.
translations.idiomatic: Lunfa raised his full strength—he claimed three hundred thousand men and more than a hundred elephants—and attacked Dingbian to avenge Moshaleshai, with every newly submitted tribe fighting at full strength.

sentences.zh: 英選師三萬亟趨至，賊列象陣搏戰。

translations.literal: Ying selected thirty thousand troops and hastened to the scene; the bandits deployed an elephant formation and joined battle.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Ying marched thirty thousand picked troops to the scene; the rebels formed an elephant line and gave battle.

sentences.zh: 英列弩註射，突陣大呼，象多傷，其蠻亦多中矢斃，蠻氣稍縮。

translations.literal: Ying arrayed crossbows for concentrated fire, charged the formation with loud shouts; many elephants were wounded, many tribesmen were also struck by arrows and killed, and tribal morale slackened somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Ying ordered volleys from crossbow lines and charged with loud shouts; many elephants were wounded and many tribesmen killed, and rebel morale began to falter.

sentences.zh: 次日，英率將士，益置火槍、神機箭，更番射，象奔，賊大敗。

translations.literal: The next day Ying led officers and soldiers, additionally deploying fire lances and divine-engine arrows in rotating volleys; the elephants fled and the bandits were utterly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Mu Ying added fire lances and mechanical arrows in rotating fire; the elephants stampeded and the rebels were routed.

sentences.zh: 搗其寨，斬首三萬余級，降卒萬余人。

translations.literal: They stormed their stockade, beheading more than thirty thousand and accepting the surrender of more than ten thousand soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: They overran the stockade, taking more than thirty thousand heads and accepting the surrender of ten thousand men.

sentences.zh: 象死者半，生獲三十有七。

translations.literal: Half the elephants died; thirty-seven were captured alive.
translations.idiomatic: Half the elephants were killed; thirty-seven were taken alive.

sentences.zh: 倫發遁，以捷聞。

translations.literal: Lunfa fled; victory was reported.
translations.idiomatic: Lunfa escaped; victory was reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 帝遣使諭英移師逼景東屯田，固壘以待大軍集，勿輕受其降。

translations.literal: The emperor sent envoys instructing Ying to move his army to press toward Jingdong and establish garrison farms, fortify ramparts and await the gathering of the great army, and not lightly accept their surrender.
