translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Mu Ying to advance toward Jingdong, establish garrison farms, hold his fortifications until the main force assembled, and not accept surrender lightly.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，倫發遣把事招綱等來言：「往者逆謀，皆由把事刀廝郎、刀廝養所為。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year Lunfa sent the baoshi Zhaogang and others to say: "The rebellious plot in the past was entirely the work of the baoshi Dao Silang and Dao Siyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year Lunfa sent the baoshi Zhaogang and others to say, "The past rebellion was entirely the work of the baoshi Dao Silang and Dao Siyang.

sentences.zh: 乞貸死，願輸貢賦。

translations.literal: We beg mercy to spare our lives and wish to pay tribute and taxes.
translations.idiomatic: We beg clemency and offer to resume tribute payments.

sentences.zh: 」雲南守臣以聞。

translations.literal: " The Yunnan frontier officials reported this.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan authorities reported this to the court.

sentences.zh: 乃遣通政司經歷楊大用賫敕往諭思倫發修臣禮，悉償前日兵費，庶免問罪之師。

translations.literal: Thereupon Secretariat Section Chief Yang Dayong was sent carrying an edict to instruct Si Lunfa to observe subject rites and fully repay the previous military expenses, so as to avoid a punitive expedition.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent Yang Dayong of the Secretariat with an edict requiring Si Lunfa to observe his duties as a subject and fully repay war costs, in hope of avoiding a punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 倫發聽命，遂以象、馬、白金、方物入貢謝罪，大用並令獻叛首刀廝郎等一百三十七人，平緬遂平。

translations.literal: Lunfa obeyed; he then presented elephants, horses, white silver, and local products in tribute to express remorse; Dayong also ordered the surrender of the rebel leaders Dao Silang and others, one hundred thirty-seven persons in all, and Pingmian was then pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Lunfa complied, sending elephants, horses, silver, and local tribute in apology; Dayong also required the surrender of 137 rebel leaders including Dao Silang, and Pingmian was pacified.

sentences.zh: 自是，三年每來朝貢。

translations.literal: From this time forth tribute missions came every three years.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter tribute missions came every three years.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，倫發來朝，貢馬、象、方物。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Lunfa came to court, presenting horses, elephants, and local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year Lunfa came to court with horses, elephants, and local tribute.

sentences.zh: 已，遣京衛千戶郭均英往賜思倫發公服、襆頭、金帶、象笏。

translations.literal: Afterwards Capital Guard chiliarch Guo Junying was sent to grant Si Lunfa official robes, a black cap, a gold belt, and an ivory tablet.
translations.idiomatic: The court then sent Capital Guard chiliarch Guo Junying to grant Si Lunfa official dress, a black cap, a gold belt, and an ivory tablet.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，緬國王使來言，百夷屢以兵侵奪其境。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year envoys of the king of Burma came saying that the Baiyi had repeatedly invaded and seized their territory by force.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year Burmese envoys reported repeated armed incursions by the Baiyi into their territory.

sentences.zh: 明年，緬使復來訴。

translations.literal: The next year Burmese envoys came again to lodge complaints.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Burmese envoys lodged complaints again.

sentences.zh: 帝遣行人李思聰等使緬國及百夷。

translations.literal: The emperor dispatched the courier Li Sicong and others as envoys to Burma and the Baiyi.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent the courier Li Sicong and others as envoys to Burma and the Baiyi.

sentences.zh: 思倫發聞詔，俯伏謝罪，願罷兵。

translations.literal: Si Lunfa, hearing the edict, prostrated himself in apology and wished to cease hostilities.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing the edict, Si Lunfa prostrated himself in apology and agreed to halt hostilities.

sentences.zh: 適其部長刀幹孟叛，思聰聽朝廷威德諭其部眾，叛者稍退。

translations.literal: Just then his division chief Dao Ganmeng rebelled; Sicong, hearing of the court's majesty and virtue, instructed his followers, and the rebels gradually withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: At that moment his division chief Dao Ganmeng rebelled; Sicong invoked the court's authority before Ganmeng's followers, and the rebels gradually dispersed.

sentences.zh: 思倫發欲倚使者服其下，強留之，以象、馬、金寶為賂，思聰諭卻之。

translations.literal: Si Lunfa wished to rely on the envoy to subdue his subordinates and forcibly detained him, offering elephants, horses, and gold treasures as bribes; Sicong admonished him and refused them.
translations.idiomatic: Si Lunfa tried to use the envoy to awe his followers and detained him by force, offering elephants, horses, and gold; Sicong refused the bribes.

sentences.zh: 歸述其山川、人物、風俗、道路之詳，為《百夷傳紀》以進，帝褒之。

translations.literal: On his return he related in detail its mountains and rivers, people, customs, and routes, compiling the Record of the Baiyi to present; the emperor praised it.
translations.idiomatic: On returning he wrote a detailed account of the region's geography, peoples, customs, and routes as the Record of the Baiyi and presented it; the emperor commended the work.

sentences.zh: 初，平緬俗不好佛。

translations.literal: At first the custom of Pingmian did not favor Buddhism.
translations.idiomatic: Pingmian had long had little use for Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 有僧至自雲南，善為因果報應之說，倫發信之。

translations.literal: A monk came from Yunnan, skilled at preaching karma and retribution; Lunfa believed him.
translations.idiomatic: A monk from Yunnan arrived, preaching karma and retribution convincingly, and Lunfa came to believe him.

sentences.zh: 又有金齒戍卒逃入其境，能為火硫、火炮之具，倫發喜其技能，俾系金帶，與僧位諸部長上。

translations.literal: Moreover a Jinchi garrison soldier fled into their territory, able to make gunpowder and cannon; Lunfa was pleased with his skill, had him wear a gold belt, and seated him with the monk above the various division chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: A deserter from the Jinchi garrison fled there, skilled at making gunpowder and cannon; Lunfa valued his skills, gave him a gold belt, and ranked him with the monk above the division chiefs.

sentences.zh: 刀幹孟等不服，遂與其屬叛，攻騰沖。

translations.literal: Dao Ganmeng and others were discontented; they then rebelled with their followers and attacked Tengchong.
translations.idiomatic: Dao Ganmeng and others resented this, rebelled with their followers, and attacked Tengchong.

sentences.zh: 倫發率其家走雲南，西平侯沐春遣送至京師。

translations.literal: Lunfa led his family in flight to Yunnan; the Prince of Xiping Mu Chun sent them escorted to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Lunfa fled with his family to Yunnan; Mu Chun, Prince of Xiping, escorted them to the capital.

sentences.zh: 帝憫之，命春為征南將軍，何福、徐凱為副將軍，率雲南、四川諸衛兵往討刀幹孟。

translations.literal: The emperor took pity on him, appointing Chun as the southern expedition general and He Fu and Xu Kai as deputy generals to lead troops from the various guards of Yunnan and Sichuan to campaign against Dao Ganmeng.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took pity on him and appointed Mu Chun southern expedition general, with He Fu and Xu Kai as deputies, to lead Yunnan and Sichuan troops against Dao Ganmeng.

sentences.zh: 並遣倫發歸，駐潞江上，招諭其部眾。

translations.literal: Lunfa was also sent back to encamp on the Lujiang and summon and instruct his followers.
translations.idiomatic: Lunfa was sent back to camp on the Lujiang and rally his followers.

sentences.zh: 賜倫髮黃金百兩、白金百五十兩、鈔五百錠。

translations.literal: Lunfa was granted one hundred taels of gold, one hundred fifty taels of white silver, and five hundred ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted one hundred taels of gold, one hundred fifty taels of silver, and five hundred ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 又敕春曰：「思倫發窮而歸我，當以兵送還。

translations.literal: An edict also told Chun: "Si Lunfa, driven to extremity, has returned to us; he should be escorted back with troops.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also instructed Mu Chun: "Si Lunfa has come to us in desperation; escort him back under arms.

sentences.zh: 若至雲南，先遣人往諭幹孟毋怙終不臣，必歸而主。

translations.literal: If you reach Yunnan, first send someone to instruct Ganmeng not to persist in defiance and refusal to submit; he must restore Lunfa as ruler.
translations.idiomatic: "Once you reach Yunnan, send word ahead to Ganmeng: if he does not persist in rebellion, Lunfa must be restored as ruler.

sentences.zh: 倘不從，則聲罪討之。」

translations.literal: If he does not obey, then proclaim his crimes and punish him."
translations.idiomatic: If he refuses, proclaim his crimes and attack."

sentences.zh: 時幹孟既逐倫發，亦懼朝廷加兵，乃遣人詣西平侯請入貢，春以聞。

translations.literal: At this time Ganmeng, having already driven out Lunfa, also feared that the court would send troops; he therefore sent someone to the Prince of Xiping requesting permission to pay tribute; Chun reported this.
translations.idiomatic: Ganmeng, having expelled Lunfa, feared imperial retaliation and sent envoys to the Prince of Xiping offering tribute; Mu Chun reported this.

sentences.zh: 三十一年奏：「幹孟欲假朝廷威以拒忽都，其言入貢，未可信。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year he memorialized: "Ganmeng wishes to borrow the court's authority to resist Hudu; his words about paying tribute cannot be trusted.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year Mu Chun memorialized: "Ganmeng wants to borrow imperial authority against Hudu; his offer of tribute is not to be trusted.

sentences.zh: 」帝遣人諭春曰：「遠蠻詭詐誠有之，姑從所請，審度其宜，毋失事機。

translations.literal: " The emperor sent someone to instruct Chun: "Remote tribes are indeed treacherous; for the moment comply with his request, judge what is fitting, and do not miss the opportunity.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "Frontier tribes are indeed deceitful; for now accept his request, but weigh the moment carefully.

sentences.zh: 」春以兵送倫發於金齒，使人諭刀幹孟，幹孟不從。

translations.literal: " Chun escorted Lunfa with troops to Jinchi and sent someone to instruct Dao Ganmeng; Ganmeng did not obey.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Chun escorted Lunfa to Jinchi and sent envoys to Dao Ganmeng, who refused.

sentences.zh: 遣左軍都督何福、瞿能等，將兵五千討之。

translations.literal: He dispatched Left Army Regional Commander He Fu, Qu Neng, and others to lead five thousand troops to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched Left Army Regional Commander He Fu, Qu Neng, and others with five thousand men to attack him.

sentences.zh: 逾高良公山，直搗南甸，大破之，殺刀名孟，斬獲甚眾。

translations.literal: Crossing Gaolianggong Mountain, they drove straight at Nandian, inflicted a great defeat, killed Dao Mingmeng, and took many heads and captives.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing Mount Gaolianggong, they drove on Nandian, routed the enemy, killed Dao Mingmeng, and took many heads and captives.

sentences.zh: 回兵擊景罕寨。

translations.literal: Returning, the army attacked the Jinghan stockade.
translations.idiomatic: They turned and attacked the Jinghan stockade.

sentences.zh: 寨憑高據險，堅守不下，官軍糧械俱盡，賊勢益張。

translations.literal: The stockade relied on high ground and strategic terrain and held firm without falling; government troops exhausted both grain and weapons, and bandit power grew ever bolder.
translations.idiomatic: The stockade held the heights and could not be taken; government supplies ran out and rebel strength swelled.

sentences.zh: 福使告急於春，春率五百騎往救，乘夜至潞江，詰旦渡。

translations.literal: Fu's envoy reported urgently to Chun; Chun led five hundred cavalry to the rescue, reaching the Lujiang by night and crossing at dawn.
translations.idiomatic: He Fu sent for help; Mu Chun rode five hundred cavalry to the rescue, reaching the Lujiang by night and crossing at dawn.

sentences.zh: 率騎馳躪，揚塵蔽天。

translations.literal: Leading the cavalry in furious galloping, they raised dust that blotted out the sky.
translations.idiomatic: His horsemen galloped in, raising a dust cloud that blotted out the sky.

sentences.zh: 賊不意大軍至，驚懼，遂破之。

translations.literal: The bandits did not expect the great army to arrive; alarmed and fearful, they were then defeated.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels had not expected the main force; terrified, they broke.

sentences.zh: 乘勝擊崆峒寨，賊夜潰。

translations.literal: Pressing the victory, they attacked the Kongtong stockade; the bandits fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the victory, they attacked the Kongtong stockade; the rebels fled overnight.

sentences.zh: 幹孟遣人乞降，事聞，朝廷以其狡詐，命春俟變討之。

translations.literal: Ganmeng sent someone begging to surrender; when the matter was reported, the court, considering him treacherous, ordered Chun to wait for a change in circumstances and then attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Ganmeng sent envoys to sue for peace; the court, judging him deceitful, ordered Mu Chun to wait for an opening before striking.

sentences.zh: 春尋病卒，幹孟竟不降。

translations.literal: Chun soon died of illness; Ganmeng in the end did not surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Chun soon died of illness, and Ganmeng never surrendered.

sentences.zh: 又命都督何福往討，未幾，擒幹孟歸，倫發始還平緬，逾年卒。

translations.literal: Regional Commander He Fu was again ordered to campaign; before long Ganmeng was captured and brought back; Lunfa only then returned to Pingmian and died the following year.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander He Fu was sent again; Ganmeng was captured before long; Lunfa returned to Pingmian at last and died the following year.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年，思倫發子散朋來朝，貢馬。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongle Si Lunfa's son Sanpeng came to court and presented horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongle Si Lunfa's son Sanpeng came to court with horses.

sentences.zh: 賜絨錦、織金文綺、紗羅並傔從鈔有差。

translations.literal: Velvet brocade, gold-woven brocade, gauze and silk, and paper money for attendants were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: He received velvet brocade, gold-woven silks, gauze and silk, and paper money for his retinue according to rank.

sentences.zh: 二年遣內官張勤等頒賜麓川。

translations.literal: In the second year palace eunuch Zhang Qin and others were sent to distribute grants in Luchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the eunuch Zhang Qin and others were sent to distribute imperial gifts in Luchuan.

sentences.zh: 麓川、平緬、木邦、孟養俱遣人來貢，各賜之鈔幣。

translations.literal: Luchuan, Pingmian, Mubang, and Mengyang all sent people to present tribute; each was granted paper money and silks.
translations.idiomatic: Luchuan, Pingmian, Mubang, and Mengyang all sent tribute missions and received paper money and silks.

sentences.zh: 時麓川平緬宣慰使思行發所遣頭目刀門賴訴孟養、木邦數侵其地。

translations.literal: At that time the headman Dao Menlai sent by Luchuan-Pingmian Pacification Commissioner Si Xingfa complained that Mengyang and Mubang had repeatedly invaded his territory.
translations.idiomatic: Si Xingfa's envoy, the headman Dao Menlai, complained that Mengyang and Mubang had repeatedly encroached on Luchuan-Pingmian territory.

sentences.zh: 禮部請以孟養、木邦朝貢使付法司，正其罪。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites requested that the tribute envoys of Mengyang and Mubang be handed to the judicial authorities to establish their guilt.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites asked that the Mengyang and Mubang tribute envoys be handed to the judicial authorities for prosecution.

sentences.zh: 帝謂蠻眾攻奪常事，執一二人罪之，不足以革其俗，且曲直未明，遽罪其使，失遠人心。

translations.literal: The emperor said that among the tribes raiding and seizing was a common affair; arresting one or two persons and punishing them was insufficient to reform their customs; moreover right and wrong were not yet clear, and hastily punishing their envoys would lose the hearts of distant peoples.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied that tribal raids were commonplace; punishing one or two men would not change their ways, the facts were still unclear, and prosecuting their envoys would alienate distant peoples.

sentences.zh: 命西平侯諭之，遣員外郎左緝使八百國，並使賜麓川平緬宣慰冠帶、襲衣。

translations.literal: The Prince of Xiping was ordered to instruct them; Section Vice-Director Zuo Ji was sent as envoy to Baiguo, and envoys were also sent to grant the Luchuan-Pingmian pacification commissioner cap and belt and ceremonial robes.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Xiping was ordered to admonish them; Section Vice-Director Zuo Ji was sent as envoy to Baiguo, and gifts of cap, belt, and ceremonial robes were sent to the Luchuan-Pingmian pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五年，麓川平緬所隸孟外頭目刀發孟來朝，貢象及金器，散朋亦貢馬，各賜鈔幣。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the Mengwai headman Dao Fameng under Luchuan-Pingmian came to court, presenting elephants and gold vessels; Sanpeng also presented horses; each was granted paper money and silks.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the Mengwai headman Dao Fameng, subordinate to Luchuan-Pingmian, came to court with elephants and gold vessels; Sanpeng also sent horses; each received paper money and silks.

sentences.zh: 六年，思行發貢馬、方物謝，賜金牌、信符。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Si Xingfa presented horses and local products in thanks; golden plaques and credential tablets were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Si Xingfa sent horses and local tribute in gratitude and received golden plaques and credential tablets.

sentences.zh: 黔國公沐晟言：「麓川、平緬所隸孟外、陶孟，土官刀發孟之地，為頭目刀薛孟侵據，請命思行發諭刀薛孟歸侵地。

translations.literal: The Duke of Qian Mu Sheng said: "The territory of native official Dao Fameng in Mengwai and Taomeng under Luchuan-Pingmian has been seized and occupied by the headman Dao Xuemeng; I request that Si Xingfa be ordered to instruct Dao Xuemeng to return the encroached land.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Qian Mu Sheng reported: "Dao Fameng's territory in Mengwai and Taomeng under Luchuan-Pingmian has been seized by the headman Dao Xuemeng; Si Xingfa should be ordered to require Dao Xuemeng to return the stolen land.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 七年，行發來貢，遣中官雲仙等賫敕，賜金織文綺、紗羅。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Xingfa came with tribute; the eunuch Yun Xian and others were sent carrying an edict and granting gold-woven brocade and gauze and silk.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Si Xingfa sent tribute; the eunuch Yun Xian and others were dispatched with an edict and gifts of gold-woven brocade, gauze, and silk.

sentences.zh: 至麓川，行發失郊迎禮，仙責之。

translations.literal: On reaching Luchuan, Xingfa failed to observe the suburban welcoming rite; Xian rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached Luchuan, Si Xingfa failed to perform the proper welcoming ceremony; Yun Xian rebuked him.

sentences.zh: 行發惶懼，九年遣刀門奈來貢謝罪。

translations.literal: Xingfa was fearful; in the ninth year he sent Dao Mennai to present tribute and express remorse.
translations.idiomatic: Si Xingfa was terrified; in the ninth year he sent Dao Mennai with tribute to apologize.

sentences.zh: 帝貸之，仍命宴勞其使，並遣賜行發文錦、金織纻絲紗羅。

translations.literal: The emperor pardoned him, still ordered a banquet to honor his envoys, and also sent grants of patterned brocade, gold-woven ramie silk, gauze, and silk to Xingfa.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor pardoned him, ordered a banquet for his envoys, and sent Si Xingfa patterned brocade, gold-woven ramie silk, gauze, and silk.

sentences.zh: 十一年，行發請以其弟思任發代職，從之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Xingfa requested that his younger brother Si Renfa replace him in office; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Si Xingfa asked that his younger brother Si Renfa succeed him in office, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 任發遣頭目刀弄發貢象六、馬百匹及金銀器皿等物謝恩。

translations.literal: Renfa sent the headman Dao Nongfa to present six elephants, one hundred horses, and gold and silver vessels and other goods in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Si Renfa sent the headman Dao Nongfa with six elephants, one hundred horses, and gold and silver vessels and other gifts to express his gratitude.

sentences.zh: 二十年，任發遣使奉表來貢，並謝侵南甸州罪，遣中官雲仙賫賜並敕戒之。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Renfa sent envoys bearing a memorial to offer tribute and also to apologize for the crime of invading Nandian Prefecture; the eunuch Yun Xian was dispatched with gifts and an admonitory edict.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Si Renfa sent envoys with a memorial offering tribute and apologizing for invading Nandian Prefecture. The eunuch Yun Xian was dispatched with gifts and an edict of admonition.

sentences.zh: 洪熙元年遣內官段忠、徐亮以即位詔諭麓川。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongxi the eunuchs Duan Zhong and Xu Liang were sent with the accession edict to announce it to Luchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongxi the eunuchs Duan Zhong and Xu Liang were sent to Luchuan with the new emperor's accession proclamation.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年遣使諭西南夷，賜麓川錦綺有差，以其勤修職貢也。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuande envoys were sent to instruct the southwestern tribes; Luchuan was granted brocades in varying amounts because it had diligently maintained its tribute duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuande envoys were sent to instruct the southwestern tribes, and Luchuan received brocades in varying amounts in recognition of its faithful tribute.

sentences.zh: 時麓川、木邦爭界，各訴於朝，就令使者諭解之，俾安分毋侵越。

translations.literal: At that time Luchuan and Mu Bang were disputing their boundary, each petitioning the court; the envoys were immediately ordered to mediate and tell them to keep to their own domains and not encroach.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Luchuan and Mu Bang were disputing their border, each appealing to the court. The envoys were instructed on the spot to settle the matter and tell both sides to keep within their bounds and refrain from encroachment.

sentences.zh: 黔國公沐晟奏，麓川所屬思陀甸火頭曲比為亂，請發兵討，帝命姑撫之。

translations.literal: The Duke of Qian Mu Sheng memorialized that Qubi, a huotou of Situo district under Luchuan, was causing trouble and requested troops to suppress him; the emperor ordered that he be pacified for the time being.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Qian Mu Sheng reported that Qubi, a huotou of Situo district under Luchuan, was in rebellion and asked for troops to suppress him. The emperor ordered that he be pacified for the time being.

sentences.zh: 置麓川平緬宣慰司所轄大店地驛丞一員，以土人刀捧怯為之，從宣慰刀暗發奏也。

translations.literal: A post-station assistant for Dadian under Luchuan-Pingmian Pacification Commission was established, with the native Dao Pengqie appointed to it, as requested in a memorial from Pacification Commissioner Dao Anfa.
translations.idiomatic: A post-station assistant was established at Dadian under the Luchuan-Pingmian Pacification Commission, with the native Dao Pengqie appointed to the post, as Pacification Commissioner Dao Anfa had requested.

sentences.zh: 三年，雲南三司奏，麓川宣慰使思任發奪南甸州地，請發兵問罪。

translations.literal: In the third year the three offices of Yunnan memorialized that Luchuan Pacification Commissioner Si Renfa had seized Nandian Prefecture's territory and requested that troops be sent to punish him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the three offices of Yunnan reported that Luchuan Pacification Commissioner Si Renfa had seized territory belonging to Nandian Prefecture and asked that troops be sent to punish him.

sentences.zh: 帝命晟同三司、巡撫詳計以聞。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Sheng to work with the three offices and the grand coordinator to plan in detail and report back.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Mu Sheng, together with the three offices and the grand coordinator, to devise a detailed plan and report back.

sentences.zh: 敕任發保境安民，不得侵鄰疆，陷惡逆，以滋罪咎。

translations.literal: An edict instructed Renfa to protect his borders and pacify his people, not to invade neighboring territories or fall into wicked rebellion and multiply his offenses.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commanded Si Renfa to secure his borders and keep his people at peace, not to invade neighboring lands or sink into rebellion and add to his crimes.

sentences.zh: 晟以任發侵奪南甸、騰沖之罪不可宥，請發官軍五萬及諸土兵討之。

translations.literal: Sheng argued that Renfa's crimes of invading and seizing Nandian and Tengchong could not be forgiven and requested fifty thousand regular troops plus various native soldiers to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Sheng held that Si Renfa's invasions of Nandian and Tengchong could not be pardoned and requested fifty thousand regular troops together with native forces to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 帝以交址、四川方用兵，民勞未息，宜再行招諭。

translations.literal: The emperor noted that Jiaozhi and Sichuan were already at war and the people's labors had not yet subsided; persuasion should be attempted again.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied that Jiaozhi and Sichuan were already at war and the people were still exhausted, and that persuasion should be tried once more.

sentences.zh: 不得已，其調雲南土官軍及木邦宣慰諸蠻兵剿之。

translations.literal: If absolutely necessary, Yunnan native official troops and the barbarian soldiers of Mu Bang Pacification Commission should be mobilized to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Only if there were no alternative should Yunnan native official troops and the tribal soldiers of Mu Bang Pacification Commission be mobilized to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 八年遣內官雲仙賫敕至麓川，賜思任發幣物，諭其勿與木邦爭地抗殺。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the eunuch Yun Xian was sent with an edict to Luchuan, presenting gifts to Si Renfa and instructing him not to fight Mu Bang over territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the eunuch Yun Xian was sent to Luchuan with an edict, presenting gifts to Si Renfa and instructing him not to fight Mu Bang over territory.

sentences.zh: 正統元年，免麓川平緬軍民宣慰司所欠差發銀二千五百兩。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengtong the 2,500 taels of outstanding dispatch silver owed by Luchuan-Pingmian Military-Civilian Pacification Commission was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhengtong the 2,500 taels of outstanding dispatch silver owed by the Luchuan-Pingmian Military-Civilian Pacification Commission was remitted.

sentences.zh: 以任發奏其地為木邦所侵，百姓希少，無從辦納。

translations.literal: Because Renfa had reported that his territory had been invaded by Mu Bang, the population was sparse, and payment could not be made.
translations.idiomatic: Si Renfa had reported that Mu Bang had invaded his territory, that the population was sparse, and that there was no means to meet the levy.

sentences.zh: 部執不可，帝特蠲之。

translations.literal: The ministry insisted it could not be done, but the emperor specially remitted it.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry held that remission was not permitted, but the emperor remitted it as a special favor.

sentences.zh: 初，洪武間，克平雲南，惟百夷部長思倫發未服，後為頭目刀幹孟所逐，赴京陳訴。

translations.literal: Initially, during the Hongwu era, when Yunnan was conquered and pacified, only the Baiyi chieftain Si Lunfa had not submitted; later he was driven out by the headman Dao Ganmeng and came to the capital to petition.
translations.idiomatic: In the beginning, when Yunnan was conquered and pacified in the Hongwu era, only the Baiyi chieftain Si Lunfa had not submitted. Later he was driven out by the headman Dao Ganmeng and came to the capital to plead his case.

sentences.zh: 命為宣慰，回居麓川。

translations.literal: He was appointed Pacification Commissioner and returned to reside at Luchuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Pacification Commissioner and returned to take up residence at Luchuan.

sentences.zh: 分其地，設孟養、木邦、孟定三府，隸雲南；

translations.literal: His territory was divided and the three prefectures of Mengyang, Mu Bang, and Mengding were established, subordinate to Yunnan;
translations.idiomatic: His lands were divided, and the three prefectures of Mengyang, Mu Bang, and Mengding were established under Yunnan;

sentences.zh: 設潞江、幹崖、大侯、灣甸四長官司，隸金齒。

translations.literal: the four native official prefectures of Lujiang, Ganyai, Dahou, and Wandian were established, subordinate to Jinchi.
translations.idiomatic: the four native official prefectures of Lujiang, Ganyai, Dahou, and Wandian were established under Jinchi.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年升孟養、木邦為宣慰司。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongle Mengyang and Mu Bang were promoted to Pacification Commissions.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongle Mengyang and Mu Bang were promoted to pacification commissions.

sentences.zh: 孟養宣慰刀木旦與鄰境仇殺而死，緬甸乘機並其地。

translations.literal: Mengyang Pacification Commissioner Dao Mudan died in a feud with neighboring territory, and Burma seized the opportunity to annex his land.
translations.idiomatic: Mengyang Pacification Commissioner Dao Mudan died in a feud with a neighboring territory, and Burma seized the opportunity to annex his lands.

sentences.zh: 未幾，緬甸宣慰新加斯又為木邦宣慰所殺。

translations.literal: Before long, Burma Pacification Commissioner Xin Jiasi was also killed by the Mu Bang Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Burma Pacification Commissioner Xin Jiasi was also killed by the Mu Bang Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時倫發已死，子行發襲，亦死。

translations.literal: By then Lunfa had died; his son Xingfa succeeded and also died.
translations.idiomatic: By then Si Lunfa had died. His son Si Xingfa succeeded him and also died.

sentences.zh: 次子任發襲為麓川宣慰，狡獪愈於父兄，差發金銀，不以時納，朝廷稍優容之。

translations.literal: The second son Renfa succeeded as Luchuan Pacification Commissioner, more cunning than his father and elder brother; he failed to deliver dispatched gold and silver on schedule, but the court showed him some forbearance.
translations.idiomatic: The second son, Si Renfa, succeeded as Luchuan Pacification Commissioner. He was even more cunning than his father and elder brother, and though he failed to deliver dispatched gold and silver on time, the court showed him a measure of forbearance.

sentences.zh: 會緬甸之危，任發侵有其地，遂欲盡復其故地，稱兵擾邊，侵孟定府及灣甸等州，殺掠人民。

translations.literal: When Burma was in crisis, Renfa invaded and seized its territory, then sought to recover all his former lands, raised troops to harass the frontier, invaded Mengding Prefecture and Wandian and other districts, killing and plundering the people.
translations.idiomatic: When Burma fell into crisis, Si Renfa invaded and seized its territory, then set out to recover all his former lands. He raised troops to harass the frontier, invaded Mengding Prefecture and districts such as Wandian, and killed and plundered the people.

sentences.zh: 而南甸知州刀貢罕亦奏麓川奪其所轄羅卜思莊等二百七十八村。

translations.literal: Nandian subprefect Dao Gonghan also memorialized that Luchuan had seized two hundred seventy-eight villages under his jurisdiction including Luobusizhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Nandian Subprefect Dao Gonghan also reported that Luchuan had seized two hundred seventy-eight villages under his jurisdiction, including Luobusizhuang.

sentences.zh: 於是晟奏：「思任發連年累侵孟定、南甸、幹崖、騰沖、潞江、金齒等處，自立頭目刀珍罕、土官早亨等相助為暴，叛形已著。

translations.literal: Thereupon Sheng memorialized: "Si Renfa has for years repeatedly invaded Mengding, Nandian, Ganyai, Tengchong, Lujiang, Jinchi, and other places, installing the headman Dao Zhenhan, the native official Zaoheng, and others to assist him in violence; the signs of rebellion are already clear.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Sheng then memorialized: "Si Renfa has for years repeatedly invaded Mengding, Nandian, Ganyai, Tengchong, Lujiang, Jinchi, and other places. He has installed the headman Dao Zhenhan, the native official Zaoheng, and others to assist him in violence, and the signs of rebellion are already plain.

sentences.zh: 近又侵及金齒，勢甚猖獗。

translations.literal: Recently he has again invaded Jinchi, and his power is extremely rampant.
translations.idiomatic: Recently he has invaded Jinchi as well, and his forces have become extremely aggressive.

sentences.zh: 已遣諸衛馬步官軍至金齒守禦，乞調大兵進討。

translations.literal: I have already dispatched cavalry and infantry from the various guards to Jinchi for defense; I beg that a large force be mobilized to advance and suppress him."
translations.idiomatic: I have already sent cavalry and infantry from the various guards to defend Jinchi. I request that a large army be mobilized to advance against him."

sentences.zh: 」朝命選將，廷臣舉右都督方政、都督僉事張榮往雲南，協同鎮守右都督昂率兵討之。

translations.literal: The court ordered generals to be selected; court officials recommended Right Commander Fang Zheng and Assistant Commander-in-Chief Zhang Rong to go to Yunnan and, together with Frontier Commander Right Commander Mu Ang, lead troops to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered generals to be chosen. Court officials recommended Right Commander Fang Zheng and Assistant Commander-in-Chief Zhang Rong for Yunnan, to join Frontier Commander Mu Ang in leading troops against him.

sentences.zh: 任發方修貢冀緩師，而晟遽信其降，無渡江意。

translations.literal: Renfa was then preparing tribute in hope of delaying the army, but Sheng hastily believed his surrender and had no intention of crossing the river.
translations.idiomatic: Si Renfa was then preparing tribute in the hope of delaying the army, but Mu Sheng hastily accepted his surrender and showed no intention of crossing the river.

sentences.zh: 任發乃遣眾萬余奪潞江，沿江造船三百艘，欲取雲龍，又殺死甸順、江東等處軍余殆盡。

translations.literal: Renfa then sent more than ten thousand men to seize Lujiang, built three hundred boats along the river, sought to take Yunlong, and also killed nearly all the soldiers at Dian Shun, Jiangdong, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Si Renfa then sent more than ten thousand men to seize Lujiang, built three hundred boats along the river with the aim of taking Yunlong, and slaughtered nearly all the garrison troops at Dian Shun, Jiangdong, and other posts.

sentences.zh: 帝以賊勢日甚，責晟等玩寇養患。

translations.literal: The emperor, seeing that the rebels grew stronger daily, rebuked Sheng and the others for indulging the enemy and nurturing disaster.
translations.idiomatic: As the rebels grew stronger by the day, the emperor rebuked Mu Sheng and his colleagues for indulging the enemy and allowing the threat to fester.

sentences.zh: 政亦至軍，欲出戰，晟不可。

translations.literal: Zheng also reached the army and wished to give battle, but Sheng would not allow it.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Zheng also reached the army and wished to engage the enemy, but Mu Sheng refused.

sentences.zh: 政造舟欲濟師，晟又不許。

translations.literal: Zheng built boats intending to ferry troops across, but Sheng again would not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Zheng built boats intending to ferry troops across the river, but Mu Sheng again refused.

sentences.zh: 政不勝憤，乃獨率麾下與賊將緬簡戰，破賊舊大寨。

translations.literal: Unable to contain his anger, Zheng then led his own followers alone to fight the rebel general Mian Jian, breaking the rebels' old main stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to contain his anger, Fang Zheng led his own followers alone against the rebel general Mian Jian and broke the rebels' old main stockade.

sentences.zh: 賊奔景罕，指揮唐清復擊破之。

translations.literal: The rebels fled to Jinghan, and Commander Tang Qing again attacked and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled to Jinghan, where Commander Tang Qing attacked and routed them again.

sentences.zh: 又追之高黎共山下，共斬三千余級。

translations.literal: They pursued them to the foot of Gaoligong Mountain and together cut down more than three thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: They pursued the enemy to the foot of Gaoligong Mountain and together cut down more than three thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 乘勝深入，逼任發上江。

translations.literal: Pressing their victory, they advanced deep into enemy territory and pressed Renfa at Upper River.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing their victory, they advanced deep into enemy territory and closed in on Si Renfa at Upper River.

sentences.zh: 上江，賊重地也。

translations.literal: Upper River was a vital rebel stronghold.
translations.idiomatic: Upper River was a vital rebel stronghold.

sentences.zh: 政遠攻疲甚，求援於晟，晟怒其違節制渡江，不遣。

translations.literal: Zheng, exhausted from the distant attack, asked Sheng for reinforcements; Sheng, angry that he had crossed the river in defiance of orders, sent none.
translations.idiomatic: Exhausted by the distant campaign, Fang Zheng asked Mu Sheng for reinforcements. Mu Sheng, angry that he had crossed the river in defiance of orders, sent none.

sentences.zh: 久之，以少兵往，至夾象石，又不進。

translations.literal: After a long time he sent a small force, but when it reached Elephant Pass it advanced no farther.
translations.idiomatic: After a long delay he sent a small force, but when it reached Elephant Pass it went no farther.

sentences.zh: 政追至空泥，知晟不救，賊出象陣沖擊，軍殲，政死焉。

translations.literal: Zheng pursued to Kongni; knowing Sheng would not rescue him, the rebels deployed an elephant formation and charged; the army was annihilated and Zheng died there.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Zheng pursued the enemy to Kongni. Realizing that Mu Sheng would not come to his aid, he was overwhelmed when the rebels deployed an elephant formation. His army was annihilated and he was killed.

sentences.zh: 晟聞敗，乃請益軍。

translations.literal: When Sheng heard of the defeat, he then requested additional troops.
translations.idiomatic: When Mu Sheng heard of the defeat, he requested reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 帝遣使者責狀，仍調湖廣官軍三萬一千五百人、貴州一萬人、四川八千五百人，令吳亮、馬翔統之，至雲南，聽晟節制，仍敕晟豫籌糧糒。

translations.literal: The emperor sent envoys to demand an accounting, and also mobilized thirty-one thousand five hundred regular troops from Huguang, ten thousand from Guizhou, and eight thousand five hundred from Sichuan, placing them under Wu Liang and Ma Xiang to go to Yunnan and obey Sheng's command, while also ordering Sheng to prepare provisions in advance.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent envoys to demand an accounting and mobilized thirty-one thousand five hundred regular troops from Huguang, ten thousand from Guizhou, and eight thousand five hundred from Sichuan. Wu Liang and Ma Xiang were placed in command and sent to Yunnan under Mu Sheng's orders, and Mu Sheng was also instructed to prepare provisions in advance.

sentences.zh: 而晟懼罪，暴卒。

translations.literal: But Sheng, fearing punishment, died suddenly.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Sheng, fearing punishment, died suddenly.

sentences.zh: 時任發兵愈橫，犯景東，剽孟定，殺大侯知州刀奉漢等千余人，破孟賴諸寨，孟璉長官司諸處皆降之。

translations.literal: At that time Renfa's forces grew ever more aggressive, invading Jingdong, raiding Mengding, killing more than a thousand people including Dahou subprefect Dao Fenghan, breaking the stockades of Menglai and others, and receiving the submission of Menglian Native Official Prefecture and other places.
translations.idiomatic: By then Si Renfa's forces had grown ever bolder. They invaded Jingdong, raided Mengding, killed more than a thousand people including Dahou Subprefect Dao Fenghan, overran the stockades of Menglai and others, and received the submission of Menglian Native Official Prefecture and other districts.

sentences.zh: 任發仍遣人以象馬金銀來修貢，復致番書於雲南總兵官，謂：「始因潞江安撫司線舊法相邀報仇，其後線舊法乃誣己為入寇，致大軍壓境，惶恐無地。

translations.literal: Renfa still sent men with elephants, horses, gold, and silver to renew tribute, and also sent a letter in the local script to the commander-in-chief of Yunnan, saying: "At first the Lujiang Pacification Commissioner Xian Jiufa invited me to join in revenge; afterward Xian Jiufa falsely accused me of invasion, bringing the great army to my borders, and I am terrified beyond measure.
translations.idiomatic: Si Renfa still sent envoys with elephants, horses, gold, and silver to renew tribute, and also sent a letter in the local script to the commander-in-chief of Yunnan, saying: "At first Lujiang Pacification Commissioner Xian Jiufa invited me to join him in revenge. Later Xian Jiufa falsely accused me of invasion, bringing the great army to my borders, and I am terrified beyond measure.

sentences.zh: 今欲遣使謝罪，乞為導奏。

translations.literal: Now I wish to send envoys to apologize; I beg that you guide my memorial to the throne."
translations.idiomatic: I now wish to send envoys to apologize and beg that you guide my memorial to the throne."

sentences.zh: 」帝降敕許赦其罪。

translations.literal: The emperor issued an edict granting pardon for his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor issued an edict granting pardon for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 時刑部侍郎何文淵疏請罷麓川師，命下廷臣議。

translations.literal: At that time Vice Minister of Justice He Wenyuan memorialized requesting that the Luchuan campaign be halted; the order was sent down for court officials to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Vice Minister of Justice He Wenyuan memorialized asking that the Luchuan campaign be halted, and the matter was referred to the court for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 於是行在兵部尚書王驥及英國公張輔等，皆以為「麓川負恩怙惡，在所必誅，須更選將練兵，以昭天討。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Minister of War at the mobile court Wang Ji and the Duke of Ying Zhang Fu and others all held that "Luchuan has betrayed grace and clung to wickedness; it must be punished, and generals must be chosen anew and troops trained to manifest Heaven's chastisement.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of War Wang Ji at the mobile court, Duke of Ying Zhang Fu, and others all argued that "Luchuan has betrayed imperial favor and clung to wickedness. Punishment is unavoidable. New generals must be chosen and troops trained to carry out Heaven's chastisement.

sentences.zh: 如思任發早自悔禍，縛詣軍門，生全之恩，取自上裁。

translations.literal: If Si Renfa repents early and binds himself to appear at the army gate, the grace of sparing his life will be decided by the throne."
translations.idiomatic: If Si Renfa repents in time and binds himself to appear at the army gate, whether his life is spared will be for the throne to decide."

sentences.zh: 」帝然之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 已而侍講劉球復以息兵請如文淵議。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Lecturer Liu Qiu again requested a halt to the campaign in accordance with Wenyuan's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Lecturer Liu Qiu again petitioned to halt the campaign along the lines of He Wenyuan's proposal.

sentences.zh: 部覆以麓川之征，已有成命，報聞。

translations.literal: The ministry replied that the Luchuan expedition already had a finalized order, and reported this back.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry replied that the Luchuan expedition already had a finalized order and reported this back to the throne.

sentences.zh: 六年以定西伯蔣貴為平蠻將軍，都督李安、劉聚副之，以兵部尚書王驥總督雲南軍務，大會諸道兵十五萬討之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the Marquis of Dingxi Jiang Gui was made General for Pacifying the Barbarians, with Commanders-in-Chief Li An and Liu Ju as his deputies; Minister of War Wang Ji was made grand coordinator of Yunnan military affairs, and a great force of one hundred fifty thousand troops from all routes was assembled to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Marquis of Dingxi Jiang Gui was appointed General for Pacifying the Barbarians, with Commanders-in-Chief Li An and Liu Ju as his deputies. Minister of War Wang Ji was made grand coordinator of Yunnan military affairs, and a combined force of one hundred fifty thousand troops from all routes was assembled to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 時任發遣賊將刀令道等十二人，率眾三萬余，象八十只，抵大侯州，欲奪景東、威遠。

translations.literal: At that time Renfa sent twelve rebel generals including Dao Lingdao leading more than thirty thousand men and eighty elephants to Dahou Prefecture, intending to seize Jingdong and Weiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Si Renfa sent twelve rebel generals including Dao Lingdao with more than thirty thousand men and eighty elephants to Dahou Prefecture, intending to seize Jingdong and Weiyuan.

sentences.zh: 而驥將抵金齒，任發遣人乞降，驥受之，密令諸將分道入。

translations.literal: Ji was about to reach Jinchi when Renfa sent men to beg surrender; Ji accepted and secretly ordered the generals to enter by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji was about to reach Jinchi when Si Renfa sent envoys to sue for surrender. Wang Ji accepted and secretly ordered his generals to advance by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 右參將冉保從東路攻細甸、灣甸水寨，入鎮康，趨孟定。

translations.literal: Right Assistant Commander Ran Bao attacked from the eastern route against the water stockades of Xidian and Wandian, entered Zhenkang, and pressed toward Mengding.
translations.idiomatic: Right Assistant Commander Ran Bao advanced from the east against the water stockades of Xidian and Wandian, entered Zhenkang, and pressed toward Mengding.

sentences.zh: 驥與貴由中路至上江，會騰沖。

translations.literal: Ji and Gui took the central route to Upper River and joined forces at Tengchong.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji and Jiang Gui took the central route to Upper River and joined forces at Tengchong.

sentences.zh: 左參將宮聚自下江據夾象石。

translations.literal: Left Assistant Commander Gong Ju advanced from Lower River and seized Elephant Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Left Assistant Commander Gong Ju advanced from Lower River and seized Elephant Pass.

sentences.zh: 至期，合攻之。

translations.literal: When the appointed day came, they attacked together.
translations.idiomatic: On the appointed day they attacked together.

sentences.zh: 賊拒守嚴，銃弩飛石，交下如雨。

translations.literal: The rebels defended sternly; muskets, crossbows, and flying stones rained down together.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels defended fiercely. Muskets, crossbows, and flying stones rained down together.

sentences.zh: 次日，乘風焚其柵，火竟夜不息。

translations.literal: The next day, taking advantage of the wind, they burned the palisades, and the fire blazed through the night without ceasing.
translations.idiomatic: The next day they set the palisades ablaze with the wind at their backs, and the fire burned through the night.

sentences.zh: 官軍力戰，拔上江寨，斬刀放戛父子，擒刀孟項，前後斬馘五萬余，以捷聞。

translations.literal: The regular army fought hard, captured the Upper River stockade, beheaded Dao Fang'a and his son, captured Dao Mengxiang, and in all cut down more than fifty thousand heads; victory was reported.
translations.idiomatic: The regular army fought hard, captured the Upper River stockade, beheaded Dao Fang'a and his son, captured Dao Mengxiang, and in all cut down more than fifty thousand heads. News of victory was received.

sentences.zh: 七年，驥率兵渡下江，通高黎貢山道。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Ji led troops across Lower River and opened the route through Gaoligong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Wang Ji led troops across Lower River and opened the route through Gaoligong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 至騰沖，留都督李安領兵提備。

translations.literal: Reaching Tengchong, he left Commander-in-Chief Li An in charge of troops for defense.
translations.idiomatic: At Tengchong he left Commander-in-Chief Li An in charge of troops for defense.

sentences.zh: 驥由南甸至羅卜思莊，前軍抵杉木籠。

translations.literal: Ji went from Nandian to Luobusizhuang, and the vanguard reached Shanmulong.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji advanced from Nandian to Luobusizhuang, and the vanguard reached Shanmulong.

sentences.zh: 時任發率眾二萬余據高山，立硬寨，連環七營，首尾相應。

translations.literal: At that time Renfa led more than twenty thousand men occupying the high mountains, establishing fortified stockades in seven linked camps that supported one another from front to rear.
translations.idiomatic: Si Renfa then held the high mountains with more than twenty thousand men, establishing fortified stockades in seven linked camps that supported one another from front to rear.

sentences.zh: 驥遣宮聚、劉聚分左右翼緣嶺上，驥將中軍橫擊之，賊遁。

translations.literal: Ji sent Gong Ju and Liu Ju along the ridges as left and right wings while he led the center in a flanking attack; the rebels fled.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji sent Gong Ju and Liu Ju along the ridges as left and right wings while he led the center in a flanking attack, and the rebels fled.

sentences.zh: 軍進馬鞍山，搗賊寨。

translations.literal: The army advanced to Ma'anshan and stormed the rebel stockade.
translations.idiomatic: The army advanced to Ma'anshan and stormed the rebel stockade.

sentences.zh: 寨兩面拒江壁立，周回三十里皆立柵開塹，軍不可進，而賊從間道潛師出馬鞍山後。

translations.literal: The stockade faced the river on two sides with cliffs rising sheer; for thirty li around palisades and ditches had been built, and the army could not advance, while the rebels sent troops secretly by hidden paths to emerge behind Ma'anshan.
translations.idiomatic: The stockade faced the river on two sides with cliffs rising sheer. For thirty li around, palisades and ditches blocked every approach, and the army could not advance. Meanwhile the rebels sent troops secretly by hidden paths to emerge behind Ma'anshan.

sentences.zh: 驥戒中軍毋動，命指揮方瑛率精騎六千突入賊寨，斬首數百級，復誘敗其象陣。

translations.literal: Ji ordered the center not to move and commanded Commander Fang Ying to lead six thousand elite cavalry in a sudden charge into the rebel stockade, cutting down several hundred heads and then luring and defeating their elephant formation.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji ordered the center to hold firm and commanded Commander Fang Ying to lead six thousand elite cavalry in a sudden charge into the rebel stockade, cutting down several hundred heads and then luring and breaking their elephant formation.

sentences.zh: 而從東路者，合木邦人馬，招降孟通諸寨。

translations.literal: Those advancing from the eastern route combined with Mu Bang men and horses and received the surrender of the stockades of Mengtong and others.
translations.idiomatic: The force advancing from the east combined with Mu Bang troops and received the surrender of Mengtong and other stockades.

sentences.zh: 元江同知杜凱等亦率車裏及大侯蠻兵五萬，招降孟璉長官司並攻破烏木弄、戛邦等寨，斬首二千三百余級。

translations.literal: Yuanjiang Assistant Prefect Du Kai and others also led fifty thousand tribal soldiers from Chelai and Dahou, received the surrender of Menglian Native Official Prefecture, and broke the stockades of Wumunong, Jiabang, and others, cutting down more than two thousand three hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjiang Assistant Prefect Du Kai and others also led fifty thousand tribal soldiers from Chelai and Dahou, received the surrender of Menglian Native Official Prefecture, and overran the stockades of Wumunong, Jiabang, and others, cutting down more than two thousand three hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 齊集麓川，守西峨渡，就通木邦信息。

translations.literal: They assembled at Luchuan, guarded the Xi'e crossing, and thereby maintained contact with Mu Bang.
translations.idiomatic: They assembled at Luchuan, guarded the Xi'e crossing, and thereby maintained contact with Mu Bang.

sentences.zh: 百道環攻，復縱火焚其營，賊死不可勝算。

translations.literal: Attacking from every direction, they again set fire to the camps; rebel dead were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Attacking from every direction, they again set fire to the camps, and rebel dead were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 任發父子三人並挈其妻孥數人，從間道渡江，奔孟養。

translations.literal: Renfa, his three sons, and several wives and children crossed the river by a hidden path and fled to Mengyang.
translations.idiomatic: Si Renfa, his three sons, and several wives and children crossed the river by a hidden path and fled to Mengyang.

sentences.zh: 搜獲原給虎符、金牌、信符、宣慰司印及所掠騰沖千戶等印三十二。

translations.literal: They searched out and recovered the originally issued tiger tally, gold plaque, credential tablets, Pacification Commission seal, and thirty-two seals seized from Tengchong chiliarchs and others.
translations.idiomatic: They recovered the originally issued tiger tally, gold plaque, credential tablets, Pacification Commission seal, and thirty-two seals seized from Tengchong chiliarchs and others.

sentences.zh: 麓川平。

translations.literal: Luchuan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Luchuan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，命還師。

translations.literal: When victory was reported, the army was ordered to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: When news of victory arrived, the army was ordered to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 時任發敗走孟蒙，復為木邦宣慰所擊，追過金沙江，走孟廣。

translations.literal: At that time Renfa, defeated, fled to Mengmeng, was again struck by the Mu Bang Pacification Commissioner, pursued across the Jinsha River, and fled to Mengguang.
translations.idiomatic: Si Renfa, defeated, fled to Mengmeng, was struck again by the Mu Bang Pacification Commissioner, pursued across the Jinsha River, and fled to Mengguang.

sentences.zh: 緬甸宣慰卜剌當亦起兵攻之。

translations.literal: Burma Pacification Commissioner Bo Ladang also raised troops to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Burma Pacification Commissioner Bo Ladang also raised troops to attack him.

sentences.zh: 帝命木邦、緬甸能效命擒任發獻者，即以麓川地與之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered that whichever of Mu Bang and Burma could effectively capture Renfa and present him would receive Luchuan's territory.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor decreed that whichever of Mu Bang or Burma could capture Si Renfa and deliver him would receive the lands of Luchuan.

sentences.zh: 未幾，任發為緬人擒，緬人挾之求地。

translations.literal: Before long Renfa was captured by the Burmese, who held him hostage to demand territory.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Si Renfa was captured by the Burmese, who held him hostage to demand territory.

sentences.zh: 其子思機發窮困，乞來朝謝罪，先遣其弟招賽入貢，帝命遣還雲南安置。

translations.literal: His son Si Jifa, in desperate straits, begged to come to court to apologize; he first sent his younger brother Zhao Sai to offer tribute, and the emperor ordered him sent back to Yunnan for settlement.
translations.idiomatic: His son Si Jifa, reduced to desperate straits, begged to come to court to apologize. He first sent his younger brother Zhao Sai with tribute, and the emperor ordered him sent back to Yunnan for settlement.

sentences.zh: 機發窺大兵歸，圖恢復，據麓川出兵侵擾。

translations.literal: Jifa, seeing that the great army had withdrawn, plotted recovery, occupied Luchuan, and sent troops to raid and disturb.
translations.idiomatic: Si Jifa, seeing that the great army had withdrawn, plotted to recover his lands, occupied Luchuan, and sent troops to raid the frontier.

sentences.zh: 於是復命王驥、蔣貴等統大軍再征麓川。

translations.literal: Thereupon Wang Ji, Jiang Gui, and others were again ordered to command a great army in a second campaign against Luchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji, Jiang Gui, and others were then ordered to command a great army in a second campaign against Luchuan.

sentences.zh: 驥率師至金齒，機發遣頭目刀籠肘偕其子詣軍門求降。

translations.literal: Ji led the army to Jinchi; Jifa sent the headman Dao Longzhou together with his son to the army gate to beg surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji led the army to Jinchi. Si Jifa sent the headman Dao Longzhou together with his son to the army gate to sue for surrender.

sentences.zh: 驥遣人至緬甸索任發，緬佯諾不遣。

translations.literal: Ji sent men to Burma to demand Renfa; the Burmese pretended to agree but did not hand him over.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji sent envoys to Burma to demand Si Renfa. The Burmese pretended to agree but did not hand him over.

sentences.zh: 驥至騰沖，與蔣貴、沐昂分五營進，緬人亦聚眾待。

translations.literal: Ji reached Tengchong and, together with Jiang Gui and Mu Ang, advanced in five camps; the Burmese also gathered their forces to await him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji reached Tengchong and, together with Jiang Gui and Mu Ang, advanced in five camps. The Burmese also gathered their forces to meet him.

sentences.zh: 驥欲乘大師攻之，見其眾盛，未易拔，又恐多一麓川敵，乃宣言犒師，而命貴潛焚其舟數百艘，進師薄之。

translations.literal: Ji wished to take advantage of the great army to attack them, but seeing their forces were strong and not easily overcome, and fearing to add another Luchuan enemy, he proclaimed a reward for the troops while secretly ordering Gui to burn several hundred of their boats and advance to press close against them.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji wished to strike while his great army was at full strength, but seeing that the Burmese forces were strong and not easily overcome, and fearing to create another Luchuan-style enemy, he proclaimed a feast for the troops while secretly ordering Jiang Gui to burn several hundred of their boats and advance to press close against them.

sentences.zh: 緬甸堅執前詔，必予地乃出任發，復詭以機發致仇為解。

translations.literal: Burma stubbornly held to the earlier edict, insisting that territory must be granted before Renfa would be handed over, and again excused itself by claiming that Jifa had provoked enmity.
translations.idiomatic: Burma stubbornly held to the earlier edict, insisting that territory must be granted before Si Renfa would be handed over, and again excused itself by claiming that Si Jifa had provoked the conflict.

sentences.zh: 驥乃趨者藍，搗機發巢，破之。

translations.literal: Ji then pressed toward Zhelan, stormed Jifa's stronghold, and broke it.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji then pressed toward Zhelan, stormed Si Jifa's stronghold, and broke it.

sentences.zh: 機發脫走，俘其妻子部眾，立隴川宣慰司而歸。

translations.literal: Jifa escaped; his wife, children, followers, and troops were captured; the Longchuan Pacification Commission was established, and they returned.
translations.idiomatic: Si Jifa escaped, but his wife, children, followers, and troops were captured. The Longchuan Pacification Commission was established, and the army returned.

sentences.zh: 時思機發竊據孟養，負固不服，自如也。

translations.literal: At that time Si Jifa secretly occupied Mengyang, clung stubbornly to resistance, and remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Si Jifa had secretly occupied Mengyang, clung stubbornly to resistance, and remained defiant as before.

sentences.zh: 十一年，緬甸始以任發及其妻孥三十二人獻至雲南。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Burma at last presented Renfa together with his wife, children, and thirty-two persons to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Burma finally delivered Si Renfa, his wife and children, and thirty-two people in all to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 任發於道中不食，垂死。

translations.literal: Renfa ate nothing on the road and was near death.
translations.idiomatic: Si Renfa refused food on the journey and was near death.

sentences.zh: 千戶王政斬之，函首京師。

translations.literal: Company Commander Wang Zheng beheaded him and sent the head in a box to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Company Commander Wang Zheng beheaded him and sent his head to the capital in a box.

sentences.zh: 其子機發屢乞降，遣頭目刀孟永等修朝貢，獻金銀。

translations.literal: His son Jifa repeatedly begged to surrender, sending the headman Dao Mengyong and others to renew court tribute and present gold and silver.
translations.idiomatic: His son Si Jifa repeatedly sued for surrender, sending the headman Dao Mengyong and others to renew tribute to the court with gifts of gold and silver.

sentences.zh: 言蒙朝廷調兵征討，無地逃死，乞貸余生，詞甚哀。

translations.literal: He said that because the court had mobilized troops for a punitive campaign, he had nowhere to flee or die, and begged that his life be spared; his words were very plaintive.
translations.idiomatic: He pleaded that the court's mobilization had left him nowhere to flee or die, and begged that his life be spared in terms heartbreakingly abject.

sentences.zh: 帝命受其貢，因敕總兵官沐斌及參贊軍務侍郎楊寧等，以朝廷既貸思機發以不死，經畫善後長策以聞，並賜敕諭思機發。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered that his tribute be accepted and instructed the supreme commander Mu Bin and Vice Minister Yang Ning, who participated in military affairs, that since the court had spared Si Jifa with his life, they should devise long-term measures for the aftermath and report, and also granted an edict admonishing Si Jifa.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the tribute accepted and instructed Supreme Commander Mu Bin and Vice Minister Yang Ning, who oversaw military affairs, to devise a long-term plan for the aftermath now that the court had spared Si Jifa's life, and also sent Si Jifa an admonitory edict.

sentences.zh: 十二年，總兵官黔國公沐斌奏：「臣遣千戶明庸賫敕招諭思機發，以所遣弟招賽未歸，疑懼不敢出。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the supreme commander, Duke of Qian Mu Bin, memorialized: "Your subject sent Company Commander Ming Yong bearing an edict to summon and instruct Si Jifa; because the younger brother Zhaosai whom he had sent had not returned, Jifa was suspicious and afraid and did not dare come out.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Supreme Commander Duke of Qian Mu Bin memorialized: "I sent Company Commander Ming Yong with an edict to summon Si Jifa, but because the younger brother Zhaosai whom he had dispatched had not returned, Jifa grew suspicious and fearful and dared not emerge.

sentences.zh: 近緬甸以機發掠其牛馬、金銀，欲進兵攻取。

translations.literal: Recently Burma, because Jifa had plundered its cattle, horses, gold, and silver, wished to advance troops to attack and seize him.
translations.idiomatic: Recently Burma, angered that Si Jifa had plundered its cattle, horses, gold, and silver, was preparing to march against him.

sentences.zh: 臣等議遣人分諭木邦、緬甸諸宣慰司，令集蠻兵，克期過江，分道討機發。

translations.literal: Your subject and others propose sending men separately to instruct the Mubang, Burma, and other pacification commissions, ordering them to gather tribal troops, fix a date to cross the river, and campaign against Jifa by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: We propose sending envoys to instruct the pacification commissions of Mubang, Burma, and the others, ordering them to gather tribal troops, fix a date to cross the river, and attack Si Jifa by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 臣等率官軍萬人駐騰沖，以助其勢。

translations.literal: Your subject and others will lead ten thousand government troops stationed at Tengchong to augment their strength.
translations.idiomatic: We will lead ten thousand government troops stationed at Tengchong to strengthen their hand.

sentences.zh: 賊四面受敵，必成擒矣。

translations.literal: The rebel will be attacked on four sides and is sure to be captured.
translations.idiomatic: With enemies closing in from every side, he is sure to be taken.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 已，命授機發弟招賽為頭目，給冠帶、月糧、房屋，隸錦衣衛，其從人俱令於馴象所供役。

translations.literal: Thereafter Jifa's younger brother Zhaosai was appointed a headman, granted official cap and belt, monthly rations, and a house, placed under the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and all his followers were ordered to serve at the elephant-training depot.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Si Jifa's younger brother Zhaosai was appointed a headman, given cap and belt, monthly rations, and housing under the Embroidered Uniform Guard, and all his followers were assigned to service at the elephant-training depot.

sentences.zh: 先是，招賽安置雲南，其黨有欲稱亂者，乃命招賽來京，且冀以招徠機發也。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Zhaosai had been resettled in Yunnan, some of his party wished to rebel; he was therefore ordered to come to the capital, in the hope also of winning over Jifa.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Zhaosai had been resettled in Yunnan, some of his followers had plotted rebellion, so he was summoned to the capital in the hope of also winning Si Jifa over.

sentences.zh: 帝既命雲南出兵剿機發，及沐斌等至騰沖，督諸軍追捕，機發終不出，潛匿孟養，遣其徒來貢。

translations.literal: After the emperor had ordered Yunnan to dispatch troops to suppress Jifa, when Mu Bin and others reached Tengchong and directed the various armies in pursuit, Jifa still did not come out but hid secretly in Mengyang and sent his followers to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: After the emperor ordered Yunnan to send troops against Si Jifa, Mu Bin and the others reached Tengchong and directed the pursuit, but Si Jifa never emerged, hiding in Mengyang while sending followers with tribute.

sentences.zh: 許以恩貸，復不至。

translations.literal: He was promised mercy and a reprieve, but again did not come.
translations.idiomatic: He was promised mercy, but still did not come.

sentences.zh: 斌以春瘴作，江漲不可渡，糧亦乏，引兵還。

translations.literal: Bin, because spring miasma had set in, the river had risen and could not be crossed, and provisions were also lacking, withdrew his troops.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Bin withdrew his troops when spring miasma set in, the river rose and became impassable, and provisions ran short.

sentences.zh: 帝以斌師出無功，復命兵部尚書靖遠伯王驥總督軍務，都督同知宮聚佩平蠻將軍印，率南京、雲南、湖廣、四川、貴州官軍、土軍十三萬人往討之。

translations.literal: The emperor, because Bin's expedition had achieved nothing, again appointed Minister of War and Earl of Jingyuan Wang Ji grand coordinator of military affairs, and Regional Commander Gong Ju, wearing the seal of General Who Pacifies the Tribes, to lead one hundred thirty thousand government and native troops from Nanjing, Yunnan, Huguang, Sichuan, and Guizhou to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: Because Mu Bin's campaign had failed, the emperor again appointed Minister of War and Earl of Jingyuan Wang Ji grand coordinator of military affairs and Regional Commander Gong Ju, bearing the seal of General Who Pacifies the Tribes, to lead one hundred thirty thousand regular and native troops from Nanjing, Yunnan, Huguang, Sichuan, and Guizhou against him.

sentences.zh: 至是，驥凡三征麓川矣。

translations.literal: By this time Ji had campaigned against Luchuan three times in all.
translations.idiomatic: By then Wang Ji had campaigned against Luchuan three times in all.

sentences.zh: 帝密諭驥曰：「萬一思機發遠遁，則先擒刀變蠻，平其巢穴。

translations.literal: The emperor secretly instructed Ji: "If by any chance Si Jifa flees far away, then first capture Dao Bianman and level his nest.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor secretly instructed Wang Ji: "If Si Jifa should flee far away, first capture Dao Bianman and destroy his stronghold.

sentences.zh: 或遁入緬地，緬人黨蔽，亦相機擒之。

translations.literal: Or if he flees into Burmese territory and the Burmese shield him, also seize him when the opportunity arises.
translations.idiomatic: If he flees into Burma and the Burmese shield him, seize him when the opportunity arises.

sentences.zh: 庶蠻眾知懼，大軍不為徒出。

translations.literal: Thus the tribal masses may know fear, and the great army will not have marched in vain.
translations.idiomatic: Then the tribes will learn fear, and the great army will not have marched in vain.

sentences.zh: 」又敕諭斌，軍事悉與驥會議而行。

translations.literal: " He also instructed Bin that all military affairs were to be carried out in consultation with Ji.
translations.idiomatic: He also instructed Mu Bin to confer with Wang Ji on all military matters.

sentences.zh: 又敕諭木邦、緬甸、南甸、幹崖、隴川等宣慰司罕蓋發等，各整兵備船，積糧以俟調度。

translations.literal: He further instructed the pacification commissions of Mubang, Burma, Nandian, Ganya, Longchuan, and others, including Hangai Fa, each to ready troops, prepare boats, and store grain awaiting orders.
translations.idiomatic: He further instructed the pacification commissions of Mubang, Burma, Nandian, Ganya, Longchuan, and others, including Hangai Fa, to ready troops, prepare boats, and store grain against the day they would be called.

sentences.zh: 十四年，驥率諸將自騰沖會師，由幹崖造舟，至南牙山舍舟陸行，抵沙壩，復造舟至金沙江。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Ji led the generals from Tengchong in rendezvous, built boats at Ganya, reached Nanya Mountain and left the boats to march overland to Shaba, then built boats again to reach the Jinsha River.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Wang Ji assembled his generals at Tengchong, built boats at Ganya, marched overland from Nanya Mountain to Shaba, and built boats again to reach the Jinsha River.

sentences.zh: 機發於西岸埋柵拒守。

translations.literal: Jifa on the west bank buried palisades and defended against them.
translations.idiomatic: Si Jifa entrenched palisades on the west bank to resist them.

sentences.zh: 大軍順流下至管屯，適木邦、緬甸兩宣慰兵十余萬亦列於沿江兩岸，緬甸備舟二百余為浮梁濟師，並力攻破其柵寨，得積谷四十萬余石。

translations.literal: The great army went downstream to Guantun; just then more than one hundred thousand troops of the two pacification commissions of Mubang and Burma also lined both banks along the river; Burma prepared more than two hundred boats as a floating bridge to ferry the army; together they broke through his palisades and stockades and obtained more than four hundred thousand piculs of stored grain.
translations.idiomatic: The main army descended to Guantun just as more than one hundred thousand men from the Mubang and Burma pacification commissions lined both banks; Burma bridged the river with two hundred boats, and together they stormed Si Jifa's palisades and stockades, seizing more than four hundred thousand piculs of stored grain.

sentences.zh: 軍飽，銳氣增倍。

translations.literal: The army was fed and their fighting spirit doubled.
translations.idiomatic: With full bellies the army's fighting spirit doubled.

sentences.zh: 賊領眾至鬼哭山，築大寨於兩峰上，築二寨為兩翼，又築七小寨，綿亙百餘里。

translations.literal: The rebels led their forces to Guikushan, built a great stockade on two peaks, built two stockades as wings, and also built seven small stockades stretching over more than a hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels withdrew to Guikushan, building a great stockade across two peaks, two flank stockades, and seven smaller stockades stretching more than a hundred li.

sentences.zh: 官軍分道並進，皆攻拔之，斬獲無算，而思機發、思卜發復奔遁。

translations.literal: Government troops advanced together by separate routes, stormed them all, and killed and captured beyond counting; Si Jifa and Si Tabfa again fled.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops advanced on every route, stormed them all, and killed and captured beyond counting, while Si Jifa and Si Tabfa fled again.

sentences.zh: 時王師逾孟養至孟那。

translations.literal: At that time the imperial army crossed beyond Mengyang to Mengna.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial army had now marched beyond Mengyang to Mengna.

sentences.zh: 孟養在金沙江西，去麓川千餘里，諸部皆震詟曰：「自古，漢人無渡金沙江者，今王師至此，真天威也。

translations.literal: Mengyang lies west of the Jinsha River, more than a thousand li from Luchuan; all the tribes trembled in awe and said: "Since antiquity Han people have never crossed the Jinsha River; now that the imperial army has reached here, it is truly Heaven's majesty.
translations.idiomatic: Mengyang lay west of the Jinsha River, more than a thousand li from Luchuan, and every tribe trembled in awe: "Since antiquity no Han army has crossed the Jinsha River; that the imperial army has come this far is truly Heaven's majesty.

sentences.zh: 」驥還兵，其部眾復擁任發少子思祿據孟養地為亂。

translations.literal: " Ji withdrew his troops; his followers again rallied Renfa's youngest son Si Lu to occupy Mengyang territory and rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji withdrew his army, but his followers rallied Si Renfa's youngest son Si Lu to seize Mengyang and rebel.

sentences.zh: 驥等慮師老，度賊不可滅，乃與思祿約，許土目得部勒諸蠻，居孟養如故，立石金沙江為界，誓曰「石爛江枯，爾乃得渡」。

translations.literal: Ji and others, fearing the army was weary and judging the rebels could not be destroyed, then made a pact with Si Lu, permitting the native chieftain to command the various tribes and dwell in Mengyang as before; they set a stone at the Jinsha River as boundary and swore: "Only when the stone rots and the river dries may you cross."
translations.idiomatic: Fearing his army was exhausted and the rebels could not be destroyed, Wang Ji made a pact with Si Lu, allowing the native chieftain to command the tribes and remain in Mengyang as before; they set a stone on the Jinsha River as boundary and swore: "Only when the stone rots and the river runs dry may you cross."

sentences.zh: 思祿亦懼，聽命，乃班師。

translations.literal: Si Lu also was afraid and obeyed; the army then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Si Lu, frightened, submitted, and the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，帝為告廟雲。

translations.literal: When victory was reported, the emperor made announcement at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: When victory was reported, the emperor announced it at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 景泰元年，雲南總兵官沐璘奏：「緬甸宣慰已擒獲思機發，又將思卜發放歸孟養，恐緬人復挾為奇貨，不若緩之，聽其自獻便。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingtai, Yunnan supreme commander Mu Lin memorialized: "The Burma Pacification Commissioner has already captured Si Jifa and has also released Si Tabfa back to Mengyang; we fear the Burmese will again hold him as a bargaining chip; it would be better to proceed slowly and let them present him of their own accord.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jingtai Yunnan Supreme Commander Mu Lin memorialized: "Burma has already captured Si Jifa and has released Si Tabfa back to Mengyang; I fear the Burmese will again hold him hostage for gain; it would be better to proceed patiently and let them deliver him in their own time.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 五年，緬人索舊地，左參將胡誌等諭以銀戛等處地方與之，乃送思機發及其妻孥六人至金沙江村，誌等檻送京師。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the Burmese demanded their old territory; Left Assistant Regional Commander Hu Zhi and others instructed them that the territory at Yinga and other places would be granted them; they then sent Si Jifa and six of his wives and children to Jinshajiang Village; Zhi and others escorted them in a cage to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the Burmese demanded their old lands; Left Assistant Regional Commander Hu Zhi and others agreed to grant them territory at Yinga and elsewhere, and they delivered Si Jifa with six wives and children to Jinshajiang Village; Hu Zhi and the others sent them to the capital in a cage.

sentences.zh: 南寧伯毛福壽以聞，乃誅思機發於京師。

translations.literal: Baron of Nanning Mao Fushou reported accordingly, and Si Jifa was executed in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Baron of Nanning Mao Fushou reported the matter, and Si Jifa was executed in the capital.

sentences.zh: 七年，任發子思卜發奏：「臣父兄犯法，時臣幼無知。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Renfa's son Si Tabfa memorialized: "Your subject's father and elder brothers violated the law when your subject was young and ignorant.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Si Renfa's son Si Tabfa memorialized: "My father and elder brothers broke the law when I was young and knew no better.

sentences.zh: 今不敢如父兄所為，甚畏朝廷法，謹備差發銀五百兩、象三、馬六及方物等，遣使人入貢，惟天皇帝主哀憐。

translations.literal: Now I dare not do as my father and elder brothers did; I greatly fear the court's law; I respectfully prepare five hundred taels of silver for corvée levies, three elephants, six horses, and local products, and send envoys to present tribute; may the Son of Heaven in his mercy take pity.
translations.idiomatic: I dare not repeat my family's crimes and greatly fear the law of the court; I respectfully send five hundred taels of corvée silver, three elephants, six horses, and local products with envoys to present tribute, and beg the Son of Heaven to show mercy.

sentences.zh: 」因賜敕戒諭，並賚思卜發與妻錦幣及其使鈔幣有差。

translations.literal: " Thereupon an admonitory edict was granted, and brocades were bestowed on Si Tabfa and his wife and paper money on his envoys in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In response the court sent an admonitory edict and granted brocades to Si Tabfa and his wife and graded gifts of paper money to his envoys.

sentences.zh: 成化元年，總兵官沐瓚等以思任發之孫思命發至京師，乃逆賊遺孽，不可留，請發沿海登州衛安置，月給米二石，從之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chenghua the supreme commander Mu Zhan and others, because Si Renfa's grandson Si Mingfa had come to the capital, held that as offspring of a rebellious bandit he could not be kept and requested that he be resettled at the coastal Dengzhou Guard with two shi of rice granted monthly; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chenghua Supreme Commander Mu Zhan and others reported that Si Renfa's grandson Si Mingfa had come to the capital; as scion of a rebel house he could not remain, and they asked that he be resettled at the coastal Dengzhou Guard with two shi of rice monthly; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 麓川亡。

translations.literal: Luchuan perished.
translations.idiomatic: Luchuan was extinguished.

sentences.zh: 先是，麓川之初平也，分其地立隴川宣撫使司，因以恭項為宣撫使。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Luchuan was first pacified, its territory was divided and the Longchuan Pacification Superintendent's office was established, with Gong Xiang appointed pacification superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: When Luchuan was first pacified, its territory was partitioned and the Longchuan Pacification Superintendent's office was established, with Gong Xiang appointed superintendent.

sentences.zh: 恭項者，故麓川部長，首先歸順效力有功，因命於麓川故地開設宣撫。

translations.literal: Gong Xiang was a former headman of Luchuan who had been the first to submit and serve meritoriously; he was therefore ordered to establish a pacification superintendency in the old Luchuan territory.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Xiang had been a Luchuan headman who was first to submit and serve with merit, and was therefore established as superintendent in the old Luchuan lands.

sentences.zh: 已，頭目曩渙等復來歸，願捕賊自效。

translations.literal: Thereafter the headmen Nang Huan and others again came to submit and wished to capture rebels to prove their worth.
translations.idiomatic: Later the headmen Nang Huan and others returned to allegiance and offered to capture rebels to prove their loyalty.

sentences.zh: 帝命還守本土，有功，即加敘。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered them to return and guard their native territory; if they achieved merit, promotion would follow at once.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered them back to their native lands with the promise of immediate promotion for meritorious service.

sentences.zh: 諸凡來歸者視此例。

translations.literal: All who came to submit were treated by this precedent.
translations.idiomatic: All who returned to allegiance were treated by this precedent.

sentences.zh: 遂以刀歪孟為本司同知，刀落曩為副使，隴帚為僉事，俱賜冠帶，從宣撫恭項請也。

translations.literal: Thereupon Dao Waimeng was made vice superintendent of the office, Dao Luonang deputy superintendent, and Longzhou commissioner, all granted caps and belts, at Pacification Superintendent Gong Xiang's request.
translations.idiomatic: At Gong Xiang's request Dao Waimeng was appointed vice superintendent, Dao Luonang deputy superintendent, and Longzhou commissioner, all granted caps and belts.

sentences.zh: 恭項子恭立來貢，給賜如例，並授恭立為長史。

translations.literal: Gong Xiang's son Gong Li came to present tribute; grants were given as usual, and Gong Li was also appointed chief secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Xiang's son Gong Li came with tribute and received the usual grants; Gong Li was also appointed chief secretary.

sentences.zh: 未幾，隴川宣撫失印，請再給。

translations.literal: Before long the Longchuan pacification superintendent lost his seal and requested a replacement.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Longchuan superintendent lost his seal and asked for a replacement.

sentences.zh: 帝責恭項以不能宣揚國威，反失印，罪應不宥，姑從寬頒給。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked Gong Xiang for failing to display national majesty and instead losing the seal; the offense should not be pardoned, but for the time being a replacement was granted with leniency.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked Gong Xiang for failing to uphold imperial prestige and losing the seal instead; though the offense deserved no pardon, a replacement was granted for the present as an act of leniency.

sentences.zh: 時板蹇據者藍寨，侵擾隴川，百夫長刀門線、刀木立進兵圍之，斬板蹇等二十三人。

translations.literal: At that time Ban Jian occupied Zhelan Stockade and raided Longchuan; Centurions Dao Menxian and Dao Muli advanced troops to besiege it and beheaded Ban Jian and twenty-two others.
translations.idiomatic: Ban Jian then held Zhelan Stockade and harassed Longchuan; centurions Dao Menxian and Dao Muli besieged it and beheaded Ban Jian and twenty-two others.

sentences.zh: 命賜有功者皆為冠帶把事，並賚織金文綺。

translations.literal: Those who had merit were all granted the title of capped belt attendant, and brocades woven with gold patterns were also bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: The meritorious were all made capped attendants and given brocades woven with gold patterns.

sentences.zh: 正統十一年，木邦宣慰罕蓋發來求麓川故地。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhengtong Mubang Pacification Commissioner Hangai Fa came to request the old Luchuan territory.
