translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Zhengtong Mubang Pacification Commissioner Hangai Fa petitioned for the old lands of Luchuan.

sentences.zh: 有司以已設隴川宣撫司，建官分管，以孟止地予之，報可。

translations.literal: The responsible offices, because the Longchuan Pacification Superintendent's office had already been established with officials appointed to administer separate districts, granted the territory of Mengzhi; the reply approved.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices, noting that Longchuan already had its own superintendent's office with officials administering separate districts, granted the territory of Mengzhi; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 十二年敕諭恭項，言：「比者，總兵奏爾與百夫長刀木立相仇殺，人民懷怨，欲謀害爾父子。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year an edict admonished Gong Xiang, saying: "Recently the supreme commander memorialized that you and Centurion Dao Muli have killed each other in feud; the people harbor resentment and wish to plot against you and your son.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year an edict admonished Gong Xiang: "The supreme commander has recently reported that you and Centurion Dao Muli have been feuding to the death; the people resent you and wish to destroy you and your son.

sentences.zh: 今遷爾於雲南，俾不失所，且遣官護爾家屬完聚，其體憫恤，無懷疑懼。

translations.literal: Now you are to be relocated to Yunnan so that you shall not be left without a place; officials will also be sent to escort your family members so they may reunite; accept this compassion and do not harbor suspicion or fear.
translations.idiomatic: You are now to be moved to Yunnan so that you shall not be homeless; officials will escort your family so you may reunite; accept this compassion and do not live in fear or suspicion.

sentences.zh: 」既而總兵官言：「隴川致亂，皆由恭項暴殺無辜，刻虐蠻人。

translations.literal: " Soon afterward the supreme commander stated: "The disorder in Longchuan arose entirely because Gong Xiang violently killed the innocent and cruelly oppressed the tribal people.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the supreme commander reported: "Longchuan's disorder owes entirely to Gong Xiang's slaughter of innocents and cruel oppression of the tribes.

sentences.zh: 同知刀歪孟為蠻眾信服，乞安置項於別衛，以刀歪孟代。

translations.literal: Vice Superintendent Dao Waimeng is trusted by the tribal masses; we beg that Xiang be resettled in another guard and Dao Waimeng replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Superintendent Dao Waimeng is trusted by the tribes; we ask that Gong Xiang be resettled in another guard and Dao Waimeng replace him.

sentences.zh: 」帝以恭項來歸，屈法宥之，命於曲靖安置，並遣敕往諭。

translations.literal: " The emperor, because Gong Xiang had come to submit, bent the law to pardon him and ordered him resettled at Qujing, and also sent an edict to instruct him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, because Gong Xiang had submitted, bent the law to pardon him, ordered him resettled at Qujing, and sent an edict of instruction.

sentences.zh: 景泰七年，隴川宣撫多外悶遣人貢象、馬及金銀器皿、方物，賜彩幣、襲衣如例。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jingtai Longchuan Pacification Superintendent Duo Waimen sent men to present elephants, horses, gold and silver vessels, and local products; colored silks and ceremonial robes were granted as usual.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Jingtai Longchuan Superintendent Duo Waimen sent tribute of elephants, horses, gold and silver vessels, and local products, and received the usual colored silks and ceremonial robes.

sentences.zh: 仍命賫敕賜之，以多外悶初修朝貢故也。

translations.literal: He was also ordered to carry an edict granting gifts, because Duo Waimen was for the first time renewing court tribute.
translations.idiomatic: An edict with gifts was also sent, because Duo Waimen was renewing court tribute for the first time.

sentences.zh: 成化十九年，以隴川宣撫司多歪孟子亨法代職。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Chenghua Duo Waimeng's son Zi Hengfa succeeded to the office of Longchuan Pacification Superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Chenghua Duo Waimeng's son Zi Hengfa succeeded as Longchuan superintendent.

sentences.zh: 初，隴川與木邦相鄰，爭地仇殺，構兵不息。

translations.literal: Earlier Longchuan bordered Mubang; they disputed territory and killed in feud; armed conflict never ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Longchuan bordered Mubang, and the two feuded over land and blood without end.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖中，土舍多鯨刃兄自襲，下鎮巡官按問，伏辜，還職兄子多參。

translations.literal: In the Jiajing era the local officer Duo Jing killed his elder brother and seized the post himself; he was tried by the regional inspector and grand coordinator, confessed guilt, and the office was restored to his elder brother's son Duo Can.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiajing era the local officer Duo Jing murdered his elder brother and seized his post; tried by the regional inspector, he confessed, and the office passed to his brother's son Duo Can.

sentences.zh: 詔貰其罪，並戒木邦罕孟毋得復黨鯨爭職。

translations.literal: An edict pardoned his crime and also admonished Mubang's Han Meng not again to abet Jing in contending for the office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict pardoned his crime and warned Mubang's Han Meng not to abet Duo Jing again in the struggle for office.

sentences.zh: 萬歷初，緬甸莽瑞體叛，來招隴川宣撫多士寧，士寧不從。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Wanli Burma's Mang Ruitti rebelled and came to win over Longchuan Pacification Superintendent Duo Shining; Shining did not comply.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Wanli reign Burma's Mang Ruitti rebelled and tried to win Longchuan Superintendent Duo Shining, but Shining refused.

sentences.zh: 其記室嶽鳳者，江西撫州人，黠而多智，商於隴川，士寧信任之，妻以妹。

translations.literal: His secretary Yue Feng was a man of Fuzhou in Jiangxi, crafty and clever; he traded in Longchuan; Shining trusted him and gave him his younger sister in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: His secretary Yue Feng, a merchant from Fuzhou in Jiangxi, was clever and cunning; Duo Shining trusted him and gave him his younger sister in marriage.

sentences.zh: 鳳曲媚士寧，陰奪其權，與三宣六慰各土舍罕拔等歃血盟，誘士寧往擺古，歸附緬酋。

translations.literal: Feng flattered Shining and secretly seized his power; with the native officers of the Three Pacifications and Six Comforts, including Han Ba, he swore a blood oath, lured Shining to Baigu, and submitted to the Burmese chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Feng fawned on Duo Shining while secretly usurping his authority; with the native officers of the Three Pacifications and Six Comforts, including Han Ba, he swore a blood oath, lured Shining to Baigu, and submitted to the Burmese chieftain.

sentences.zh: 陰使其子曩烏鴆士寧並殺其妻女，奪印投緬，受緬偽命，代士寧為宣撫。

translations.literal: Secretly he had his son Nang Wu poison Shining and also kill his wife and daughters; he seized the seal and defected to Burma, received a false Burmese appointment, and replaced Shining as pacification superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: Secretly he had his son Nang Wu poison Duo Shining and murder his wife and daughters; he seized the seal, defected to Burma, received a false appointment from the Burmese, and replaced Shining as superintendent.

sentences.zh: 及瑞體死，子應裏嗣，鳳父子臣服之。

translations.literal: When Ruitti died his son Yingli succeeded, and Feng and his son submitted to him.
translations.idiomatic: When Mang Ruitti died his son Yingli succeeded, and the Fengs submitted to him.

sentences.zh: 誘敗官軍，獻士寧母胡氏及親族六百余人於應裏，盡殺之，多氏之宗幾盡。

translations.literal: He lured and defeated government troops, presented Shining's mother Lady Hu and more than six hundred kinsmen to Yingli, and all were killed; the Duo clan was nearly exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: He lured government troops to defeat, delivered Duo Shining's mother Lady Hu and more than six hundred kinsmen to Yingli, and all were slaughtered; the Duo clan was all but exterminated.

sentences.zh: 初，鳳之附於緬也，為瑞體招諸部，拒中國，傷官軍，逆勢浸成，緬深倚之。

translations.literal: At first, when Feng submitted to Burma, he rallied the various tribes for Ruitti, resisted China, and wounded government troops; the rebellious momentum gradually formed, and Burma relied deeply on him.
translations.idiomatic: At first, in allying with Burma Yue Feng rallied the tribes for Mang Ruitti, defied the empire, and struck government troops; rebellion gathered strength, and Burma came to rely on him deeply.

sentences.zh: 久之，以緬不足恃。

translations.literal: After a long time he considered Burma unreliable.
translations.idiomatic: In time he decided Burma could not be trusted.

sentences.zh: 而鄧川土知州何鈺，鳳友婿也，初使人招鳳，鳳執使獻緬。

translations.literal: Dengchuan Native Prefect He Yu was Feng's friend and son-in-law; at first he sent men to summon Feng, but Feng seized the envoys and presented them to Burma.
translations.idiomatic: Dengchuan Native Prefect He Yu, Yue Feng's friend and son-in-law, first sent envoys to summon him, but Feng seized them and handed them over to the Burmese.

sentences.zh: 及是，鈺復開示百方，與之盟誓。

translations.literal: At this time Yu again opened every avenue of persuasion and made a covenant with him.
translations.idiomatic: Then He Yu opened every avenue of persuasion and bound Yue Feng with solemn oaths.

sentences.zh: 時官軍亦大集，諸將劉綎、鄧子龍各率勁師至，環壁四面。

translations.literal: At that time government troops also gathered in force; the generals Liu Ting and Deng Zilong each led elite armies to the scene and encircled them on four sides.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops had meanwhile massed; Generals Liu Ting and Deng Zilong each led crack troops to the scene and closed a ring of camps around them.

sentences.zh: 鳳懼，乃令妻子及部曲來降。

translations.literal: Feng was afraid and then ordered his wife, children, and followers to come and surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Frightened, Yue Feng sent his wife, children, and followers to surrender.

sentences.zh: 綎責令獻金牌、符印及蠻莫、猛密地。

translations.literal: Ting ordered him to present the golden plaque, credential seals, and the territories of Manmo and Mengmi.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ting demanded the golden plaque, credential seals, and the territories of Manmo and Mengmi.

sentences.zh: 乃以送鳳妻子還隴川為名，分兵趨沙木籠山，先據其險，而自領大兵馳入隴川。

translations.literal: Then, under the pretext of escorting Feng's wife and children back to Longchuan, he divided troops to hurry to Shambulong Mountain, first seizing its strategic point, while he himself led the main force in a dash into Longchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Under pretext of escorting Feng's family back to Longchuan, he sent detachments to seize the heights of Shambulong Mountain while he himself led the main force in a dash into Longchuan.

sentences.zh: 鳳度無可脫，遂詣軍門降。

translations.literal: Feng judged that there was no escape and then came to the army gate to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing no escape, Yue Feng came to the army gate and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 綎復率兵進緬，緬將先遁，留少兵隴川，綎攻之，鳳子曩烏亦降，綎乃攜鳳父子往攻蠻莫，蠻莫賊知鳳降，馳報應裏，發兵圖隴川。

translations.literal: Ting again led troops against Burma; the Burmese generals fled first, leaving a small force in Longchuan; Ting attacked them; Feng's son Nang Wu also surrendered; Ting then took Feng and his son to attack Manmo; the Manmo rebels, learning Feng had surrendered, sent word swiftly to Yingli and raised troops to seize Longchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ting marched on Burma; the Burmese generals fled, leaving only a small force in Longchuan, which he attacked; Nang Wu also surrendered; Ting then took the Fengs to attack Manmo, whose rebels, learning of the surrender, alerted Yingli and sent troops to retake Longchuan.

sentences.zh: 綎乘機掩殺，賊窘，乞降，縛緬人及象馬來獻。

translations.literal: Ting seized the opportunity for a surprise slaughter; the rebels were hard pressed and begged to surrender, binding Burmese and presenting elephants and horses.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ting struck by surprise; the rebels, cornered, sued for surrender and presented bound Burmese with elephants and horses.

sentences.zh: 遂招撫孟養賊，賊將乘象走，追獲之。

translations.literal: He then conciliated the Mengyang rebels; a rebel general fled on an elephant and was pursued and captured.
translations.idiomatic: He then pacified the Mengyang rebels; a rebel commander fled on an elephant and was pursued and captured.

sentences.zh: 復移師圍孟璉，生擒其魁，隴川平。

translations.literal: He again moved his army to besiege Menglian, captured its leader alive, and Longchuan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: He then besieged Menglian, captured its leader alive, and Longchuan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 獻俘於朝，帝為告謝郊廟，時萬歷十二年九月也。

translations.literal: Captives were presented at court; the emperor made offerings of thanks at the suburban altar and ancestral temple; it was the ninth month of the twelfth year of Wanli.
translations.idiomatic: Captives were presented at court and the emperor offered thanks at the suburban altar and ancestral temple; it was the ninth month of the twelfth year of Wanli.

sentences.zh: 逾年復鑄隴川宣撫司及孟定府印，升孟密安撫為宣撫司。

translations.literal: The following year the seals of the Longchuan Pacification Superintendent's office and Mengding Prefecture were recast, and the Mengmi Pacification Commission was promoted to a Pacification Superintendent's office.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the seals of the Longchuan superintendent's office and Mengding Prefecture were recast, and the Mengmi Pacification Commission was raised to a superintendent's office.

sentences.zh: 添設安撫司二，曰蠻莫，曰耿馬；

translations.literal: Two pacification commissions were added, called Manmo and Gengma;
translations.idiomatic: Two pacification commissions were added, at Manmo and Gengma;

sentences.zh: 長官司二，曰孟璉，曰孟養；

translations.literal: two native offices were added, called Menglian and Mengyang;
translations.idiomatic: two native offices at Menglian and Mengyang;

sentences.zh: 千戶所二，一居姚關，一居孟淋砦，皆名之曰鎮安；

translations.literal: two company commands, one at Yaoguan and one at Menglin Stockade, all named Zhen'an;
translations.idiomatic: and two company commands, one at Yaoguan and one at Menglin Stockade, all named Zhen'an;

sentences.zh: 並鑄印記，建大將行署於蠻莫。

translations.literal: seals were all cast, and a general's field headquarters was established at Manmo.
translations.idiomatic: New seals were cast and a general's field headquarters established at Manmo.

sentences.zh: 從雲南巡撫劉世曾之議也。

translations.literal: This followed the proposal of Yunnan Grand Coordinator Liu Shizeng.
translations.idiomatic: This followed the proposal of Yunnan Grand Coordinator Liu Shizeng.

sentences.zh: 於是，多士寧之子思順襲隴川宣撫使。

translations.literal: Thereupon Duo Shining's son Sisun succeeded as Longchuan Pacification Superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: Duo Shining's son Si Shun then succeeded as Longchuan Pacification Superintendent.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，莽應裏分道入犯，一入遮放、芒市，一入臘撒蠻顙，一入杉木籠，並出隴川。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Mang Yingli invaded by separate routes: one force entered Zhefang and Mangshi, one entered Lasabaman, one entered Shanmulong, and all emerged at Longchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Mang Yingli invaded on three routes—through Zhefang and Mangshi, through Lasabaman, and through Shanmulong—all converging on Longchuan.

sentences.zh: 多思順不敵，奔猛卯。

translations.literal: Duo Sisun could not resist and fled to Mengmao.
translations.idiomatic: Duo Si Shun could not hold them and fled to Mengmao.

sentences.zh: 緬初以猛卯同知多俺為向導，寇東路。

translations.literal: At first Burma used Mengmao Vice Prefect Duo An as guide to raid the eastern route.
translations.idiomatic: Burma had first used Mengmao Vice Prefect Duo An as guide for the eastern route.

sentences.zh: 至是大軍遣木邦罕欽擒多俺殺之。

translations.literal: At this time the great army dispatched Mubang's Han Qin to capture Duo An and kill him.
translations.idiomatic: The main army then sent Mubang's Han Qin to capture and kill Duo An.

sentences.zh: 未幾，思順死，蠻莫思正乘喪襲隴川，據其妻罕氏。

translations.literal: Before long, Sishun died; Manmo Sizheng took advantage of the mourning to attack Longchuan and seized his wife Lady Han.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Sishun died, and Manmo Sizheng exploited the funeral to strike Longchuan and seize his widow Lady Han.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，思順子安民以守將索賂，叛入緬。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year, Sishun's son Anmin, because the garrison commander demanded bribes, rebelled and fled into Burma.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year Sishun's son Anmin rebelled and fled to Burma after the garrison commander extorted bribes from him.

sentences.zh: 已而緬聽撫，遣安民歸。

translations.literal: Soon Burma accepted pacification and sent Anmin back.
translations.idiomatic: Burma soon submitted to pacification and returned Anmin.

sentences.zh: 安民久據蠻灣，桀驁甚，署永騰參將周會遣二指揮襲之，敗績。

translations.literal: Anmin had long held Manyuan and was extremely arrogant and defiant; Acting Yongteng Deputy Commander Zhou Hui sent two commanders to raid him and suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Anmin had long entrenched himself at Manyuan and grown wildly insubordinate; Acting Deputy Commander Zhou Hui of Yongteng sent two commanders against him and was beaten.

sentences.zh: 王師亟討，其族人挾其弟多安靖誅之以獻。

translations.literal: Imperial troops pressed the attack; his clansmen took his younger brother Duo Anjing, executed him, and presented his head.
translations.idiomatic: As imperial forces closed in, his kinsmen seized his younger brother Duo Anjing, killed him, and offered his head in submission.

sentences.zh: 時安靖尚幼，勢孤，詔俟其長給之印。

translations.literal: At the time Anjing was still young and isolated in power; an edict ordered that the seal be given when he came of age.
translations.idiomatic: Anjing was still a child and without support, so the court decreed that his seal would be issued when he reached maturity.

sentences.zh: 安民弟安邦治亦附緬，後寄居蠻莫。

translations.literal: Anmin's younger brother Anbangzhi also attached himself to Burma and later took refuge in Manmo.
translations.idiomatic: Anmin's brother Anbangzhi likewise threw in his lot with Burma and later lived in exile at Manmo.

sentences.zh: 其地有馬安、摩黎、羅木等山，極險峻，麓川之所恃為巢穴者也。

translations.literal: In that region are Mount Ma'an, Mount Moli, Mount Luomu, and others, extremely steep and rugged—the lairs on which Luchuan relied as its strongholds.
translations.idiomatic: The region holds such mountains as Ma'an, Moli, and Luomu, precipitous beyond measure—the very fastnesses in which Luchuan had rooted its power.
